5.197.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminneva kāle tu daśārṇādhipatistadā ..
ratnavatyā vivāhārthaṃ tatra sthāne samāgataḥ .. 1 ..
5.197.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दशार्णाधिपतिस्तदा ..
रत्नवत्या विवाहार्थं तत्र स्थाने समागतः .. 1 ..
5.197.m: Sūta said: / At that very time, the lord of Daśārṇa / came to that place for the sake of wedding Ratnāvatī. 1

5.197.s:
sa śrutvā tatra vṛttāṃtaṃ ratnavatyāḥ samudbhavam ..
viraktiṃ paramāṃ kṛtvā prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati .. 2 ..
5.197.d:
स श्रुत्वा तत्र वृत्तांतं रत्नवत्याः समुद्भवम् ..
विरक्तिं परमां कृत्वा प्रस्थितः स्वपुरं प्रति .. 2 ..
5.197.m: Having heard there the news concerning Ratnāvatī, / he felt supreme aversion and set out toward his own city. 2

5.197.s:
taṃ śrutvā prasthitaṃ bhūpamānartaḥ svapuraṃ prati ..
pṛṣṭhato'nuyayau tasya vyāgho ṭanakṛte tadā ..4 3 ..
5.197.d:
तं श्रुत्वा प्रस्थितं भूपमानर्तः स्वपुरं प्रति ..
पृष्ठतोऽनुययौ तस्य व्याघो टनकृते तदा ..4 3 ..
5.197.m: Hearing that the king had departed toward his own city, Ānarta / then followed behind him in order to turn him back. 3

5.197.s:
athābravīcca taṃ prāpya kasmāttvaṃ prasthito nṛpa ..
pāṇigrahamakṛtvā tu mama kanyāsamudbhavam .. 4 ..
5.197.d:
अथाब्रवीच्च तं प्राप्य कस्मात्त्वं प्रस्थितो नृप ..
पाणिग्रहमकृत्वा तु मम कन्यासमुद्भवम् .. 4 ..
5.197.m: And reaching him, he said: "Why have you departed, O king, / without taking the hand of my daughter?" 4

5.197.s:
.. daśārṇa uvāca .. ..
dūṣiteyaṃ tava sutā kanyakātvavivarjitā ..
yasyāḥ pīto'dharo'nyena marditau ca tathā stanau .. 5 ..
5.197.d:
.. दशार्ण उवाच .. ..
दूषितेयं तव सुता कन्यकात्वविवर्जिता ..
यस्याः पीतोऽधरोऽन्येन मर्दितौ च तथा स्तनौ .. 5 ..
5.197.m: The lord of Daśārṇa said: / "This daughter of yours has been defiled; she is devoid of maidenhood, / whose lower lip was drunk by another, and likewise her breasts rubbed. 5

5.197.s:
punarbhūriti saṃjñā sā sañjātā duhitā tava ..
punarbhūrjanayetputraṃ yaṃ kadācitkathaṃcana .. 6 ..
5.197.d:
पुनर्भूरिति संज्ञा सा सञ्जाता दुहिता तव ..
पुनर्भूर्जनयेत्पुत्रं यं कदाचित्कथंचन .. 6 ..
5.197.m: Your daughter has acquired the designation 'remarried woman' (punarbhū). / If a remarried woman should ever, somehow, give birth to a son, 6

5.197.s:
sa pātayatyasaṃdigdhaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān ..
ekaviṃśatimaṃ caiva tathaivātmānameva ca .. 7 ..
5.197.d:
स पातयत्यसंदिग्धं दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् ..
एकविंशतिमं चैव तथैवात्मानमेव च .. 7 ..
5.197.m: he undoubtedly brings down ten ancestors and ten descendants, / and himself as the twenty-first. 7

5.197.s:
na variṣyāmyahaṃ tena sutāṃ te'haṃ narasipa ..
nirdākṣiṇyamiti procya daśārṇādhipatistadā .. 8 ..
5.197.d:
न वरिष्याम्यहं तेन सुतां तेऽहं नरसिप ..
निर्दाक्षिण्यमिति प्रोच्य दशार्णाधिपतिस्तदा .. 8 ..
5.197.m: Therefore, I will not choose your daughter, O ruler of men!" / Having spoken thus without courtesy, the lord of Daśārṇa then, 8

5.197.s:
chaṃdyamāno'pi vividhairhastyaśvarathapūrvakaiḥ ..
avajñāya mahīpālaṃ prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati .. 9 ..
5.197.d:
छंद्यमानोऽपि विविधैर्हस्त्यश्वरथपूर्वकैः ..
अवज्ञाय महीपालं प्रस्थितः स्वपुरं प्रति .. 9 ..
5.197.m: although entreated with various [gifts] headed by elephants, horses, and chariots, / disregarded the king and set out toward his own city. 9

5.197.s:
athānartto gṛhaṃ prāpya mṛgāvatyāḥ samākulaḥ ..
tadvṛttaṃ kathayāmāsa yaduktaṃ tena bhūbhujā ..
svabhāryāyāḥ sutāyāśca mantriṇāṃ duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ .. 6.198.10 ..
5.197.d:
अथानर्त्तो गृहं प्राप्य मृगावत्याः समाकुलः ..
तद्वृत्तं कथयामास यदुक्तं तेन भूभुजा ..
स्वभार्यायाः सुतायाश्च मन्त्रिणां दुःखसंयुतः .. 6.198.10 ..
5.197.m: Then Ānarta, reaching the house of Mṛgāvatī, was deeply distressed; / and, filled with sorrow, he reported to his wife, his daughter, and his ministers / what had been said by that king. 10

5.197.s:
te procuḥ saṃti bhūpālāḥ saṃkhyāhīnā mahītale ..
rūpāḍhyā yauvanopetā hastyaśvarathasaṃyutāḥ .. 11 ..
5.197.d:
ते प्रोचुः संति भूपालाः संख्याहीना महीतले ..
रूपाढ्या यौवनोपेता हस्त्यश्वरथसंयुताः .. 11 ..
5.197.m: They said: "There are countless kings on the surface of the earth, / endowed with beauty, possessed of youth, and equipped with elephants, horses, and chariots. 11

5.197.s:
teṣāmekatamasya tvaṃ dehi kanyāṃ nijāṃ vibho ..
mā viṣāde manaḥ kṛtvā duḥkhasya vaśago bhava .. 12 ..
5.197.d:
तेषामेकतमस्य त्वं देहि कन्यां निजां विभो ..
मा विषादे मनः कृत्वा दुःखस्य वशगो भव .. 12 ..
5.197.m: Give your maiden to one among them, O lord! / Do not fix your mind on despair and fall under the sway of sorrow!" 12

5.197.s:
ānarto'pi ca tacchrutvā teṣāṃ vākyaṃ suduḥkhitam ..
tataḥ prāha prahṛṣṭātmā tānsarvānmantripūrvakān.. 13 ..
5.197.d:
आनर्तोऽपि च तच्छ्रुत्वा तेषां वाक्यं सुदुःखितम् ..
ततः प्राह प्रहृष्टात्मा तान्सर्वान्मन्त्रिपूर्वकान्.. 13 ..
5.197.m: Ānarta, hearing that sorrowful speech of theirs, / then with a delighted heart spoke to all of them, headed by the ministers, 13

5.197.s:
tāṃ ca kanyāṃ sthitāṃ tatra sāmnā paramavalgunā ..
putri dṛṣṭā mahīpālāḥ sarve citragatāstvayā .. .. 14 ..
5.197.d:
तां च कन्यां स्थितां तत्र साम्ना परमवल्गुना ..
पुत्रि दृष्टा महीपालाः सर्वे चित्रगतास्त्वया .. .. 14 ..
5.197.m: and to that maiden standing there, with exceedingly gentle words of conciliation: / "Daughter, all the kings depicted in pictures have been seen by you. 14

5.197.s:
teṣāṃ madhyānnṛpaṃ cānyaṃ kañcidvaraya śobhane ..
yaste cittasya santoṣaṃ kurute dṛkpathaṃ gataḥ .. 15 ..
5.197.d:
तेषां मध्यान्नृपं चान्यं कञ्चिद्वरय शोभने ..
यस्ते चित्तस्य सन्तोषं कुरुते दृक्पथं गतः .. 15 ..
5.197.m: From among them, choose another king, O lovely one, / who brings satisfaction to your heart upon entering your sight." 15

5.197.s:
.. ratnāvatyuvāca .. ..
na cāhaṃ varayiṣyāmi patimanyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
daśārṇādhipatiṃ muktvā śrūyatāmatra kāraṇam .. 16 ..
5.197.d:
.. रत्नावत्युवाच .. ..
न चाहं वरयिष्यामि पतिमन्यं कथंचन ..
दशार्णाधिपतिं मुक्त्वा श्रूयतामत्र कारणम् .. 16 ..
5.197.m: Ratnāvatī said: / "I shall never choose another husband / other than the lord of Daśārṇa; hear the reason for this: 16

5.197.s:
sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti ca dvijāḥ ..
sakṛtkanyāḥ pradīyaṃte trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt .. 17 ..
5.197.d:
सकृज्जल्पंति राजानः सकृज्जल्पंति च द्विजाः ..
सकृत्कन्याः प्रदीयंते त्रीण्येतानि सकृत्सकृत् .. 17 ..
5.197.m: Kings speak but once; brahmins speak but once; / maidens are given away but once—these three occur only once. 17

5.197.s:
evaṃ jñātvā na māṃ tāta tvamanyasminmahīpatau ..
dātumarhasi dharmo'yaṃ na bhavecchāśvato yataḥ ..18.. ..
5.197.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा न मां तात त्वमन्यस्मिन्महीपतौ ..
दातुमर्हसि धर्मोऽयं न भवेच्छाश्वतो यतः ..18.. ..
5.197.m: Knowing this, father, you should not give me to another king, / for then this righteousness would not be eternal." 18

5.197.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
vāṅmātreṇa pradattā tvaṃ daśārṇādhipatermayā ..
na te hastagrahaṃ prāpto viprāgnigurusannidhau .. 19 ..
5.197.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
वाङ्मात्रेण प्रदत्ता त्वं दशार्णाधिपतेर्मया ..
न ते हस्तग्रहं प्राप्तो विप्राग्निगुरुसन्निधौ .. 19 ..
5.197.m: Ānarta said: / "You were promised to the lord of Daśārṇa by me by mere word of mouth; / he did not clasp your hand in the presence of brahmins, fire, and the preceptor. 19

5.197.s: tatkathaṃ sa patirjātastavaḥ putri vadasva me .. 6.198.20 ..
5.197.d: तत्कथं स पतिर्जातस्तवः पुत्रि वदस्व मे .. 6.198.20 ..
5.197.m: Then how has he become your husband, my daughter? Tell me!" 20

5.197.s:
.. ratnāvatyuvāca .. ..
manasā ciṃtyate kāryaṃ sakṛttātapurā yataḥ ..
vācayā procyate paścāt karmaṇā kriyate tataḥ .. 21 ..
5.197.d:
.. रत्नावत्युवाच .. ..
मनसा चिंत्यते कार्यं सकृत्तातपुरा यतः ..
वाचया प्रोच्यते पश्चात् कर्मणा क्रियते ततः .. 21 ..
5.197.m: Ratnāvatī said: / "Because, father, a deed is first conceived in the mind, / thereafter it is uttered in speech, and then it is performed in action. 21

5.197.s:
tanmayā manasā dattastasyātmā'yaṃ purā kila ..
tvayā ca vācayā cāsmai pradattāsmi tathā vibho ..
tatkathaṃ na patirme syādbrūhi vā yadi manyase..22..
5.197.d:
तन्मया मनसा दत्तस्तस्यात्माऽयं पुरा किल ..
त्वया च वाचया चास्मै प्रदत्तास्मि तथा विभो ..
तत्कथं न पतिर्मे स्याद्ब्रूहि वा यदि मन्यसे..22..
5.197.m: Therefore, this self of mine was indeed formerly given to him in my mind. / And by speech, O lord, I was likewise given to him by you. / How then could he not be my husband? Speak, if you think [otherwise].

5.197.s:
sāhaṃ tapaścariṣyāmi kaumāravratadhāriṇī ..
nānyaṃ patiṃ kariṣyāmi niścayo'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ .. 23 ..
5.197.d:
साहं तपश्चरिष्यामि कौमारव्रतधारिणी ..
नान्यं पतिं करिष्यामि निश्चयोऽयं मया कृतः .. 23 ..
5.197.m: As such, I shall practice austerity, keeping the vow of maidenhood. / I shall take no other husband; this is the resolve I have made.

5.197.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ raudraṃ mātā tasyā mṛgāvatī ..
aśrupūrṇekṣaṇā dīnā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 24 ..
5.197.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं रौद्रं माता तस्या मृगावती ..
अश्रुपूर्णेक्षणा दीना वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 24 ..
5.197.m: Hearing those dread words, her mother, Mṛgāvatī, / with eyes filled with tears, dejected, spoke this speech:

5.197.s:
mā putri sāhasaṃ kārṣīstapo'rthaṃ tvaṃ kathañcana ..
bālā tvaṃ sukumārāṃgī sadaiva sukhabhāginī ..25..
5.197.d:
मा पुत्रि साहसं कार्षीस्तपोऽर्थं त्वं कथञ्चन ..
बाला त्वं सुकुमारांगी सदैव सुखभागिनी ..25..
5.197.m: "Do not, daughter, rashly undertake austerity in any way! / You are a girl of delicate limbs, accustomed always to comfort alone.

5.197.s:
kathaṃ tapaḥ samarthāsi vidhātuṃ tvamaniṃdite ..
kandamūlaphalāhārā cīravalkaladhāriṇī ..26 ..
5.197.d:
कथं तपः समर्थासि विधातुं त्वमनिंदिते ..
कन्दमूलफलाहारा चीरवल्कलधारिणी ..26 ..
5.197.m: How can you be capable of performing austerity, O blameless one, / subsisting on roots and fruits, wearing ragged bark garments?

5.197.s: tasmānmukhyasya bhūpasya kasyacitvāṃ dadāmyaham.. .. 27 ..
5.197.d: तस्मान्मुख्यस्य भूपस्य कस्यचित्वां ददाम्यहम्.. .. 27 ..
5.197.m: Therefore, I shall give you [in marriage] to some foremost king.

5.197.s:
eṣā te brāhmaṇīnāma sakhī paramasaṃmatā ..
pratīkṣate vivāhaṃ te kaumāraṃ bhāvamāśritā .. 28 ..
5.197.d:
एषा ते ब्राह्मणीनाम सखी परमसंमता ..
प्रतीक्षते विवाहं ते कौमारं भावमाश्रिता .. 28 ..
5.197.m: This brahmin girl, your most cherished companion, / remains in maidenhood awaiting your wedding.

5.197.s:
yasya bhūpasya tvaṃ harmye prayāsyasi vivāhi tā ..
purodhāstasya yo rājño bhāryeyaṃ tasya bhāvinī .. 29 ..
5.197.d:
यस्य भूपस्य त्वं हर्म्ये प्रयास्यसि विवाहि ता ..
पुरोधास्तस्य यो राज्ञो भार्येयं तस्य भाविनी .. 29 ..
5.197.m: To whichever king's mansion you go in marriage, / she will become the wife of that king's family priest."

5.197.s:
.. ratnāvatyuvāca .. ..
na ca bhūyastvayā vācyaṃ vākyamevaṃvidhaṃ kvacit ..
madarthe yadi me prāṇāstvaṃ vāṃchasi sutaiṣiṇī .. 6.198.30 ..
5.197.d:
.. रत्नावत्युवाच .. ..
न च भूयस्त्वया वाच्यं वाक्यमेवंविधं क्वचित् ..
मदर्थे यदि मे प्राणास्त्वं वांछसि सुतैषिणी .. 6.198.30 ..
5.197.m: Ratnāvatī said: / "Never speak such words again / on my account, if you desire my life, wishing [well] for your daughter.

5.197.s: athavā tvaṃ haṭhārthaṃ ca tapovighnaṃ kariṣyasi .. 31 ..
5.197.d: अथवा त्वं हठार्थं च तपोविघ्नं करिष्यसि .. 31 ..
5.197.m: If, however, out of obstinacy, you create an obstacle to my austerity,

5.197.s:
tatastyakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ bhakṣayitvā mahadviṣam..
khaṃḍayiṣyāmyahaṃ jihvāṃ pravekṣyāmi ca vā jalam..32..
5.197.d:
ततस्त्यक्ष्याम्यहं देहं भक्षयित्वा महद्विषम्..
खंडयिष्याम्यहं जिह्वां प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वा जलम्..32..
5.197.m: then I shall abandon my body after consuming deadly poison, / or I shall cut out my tongue, or enter into the water."

5.197.s: evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā procya tāṃ jananīṃ tadā..33..
5.197.d: एवं सा निश्चयं कृत्वा प्रोच्य तां जननीं तदा..33..
5.197.m: Having thus made her resolve and spoken to her mother at that time,

5.197.s:
tataḥ provāca tāṃ kanyāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ saṃmatāṃ sakhīm..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhūtvā samāliṃgya ca sādaram..34..
5.197.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तां कन्यां ब्राह्मणीं संमतां सखीम्..
कृतांजलिपुटा भूत्वा समालिंग्य च सादरम्..34..
5.197.m: she then addressed that maiden, her cherished brahmin friend, / after folding her hands in supplication and embracing her affectionately:

5.197.s:
gaccha tvaṃ svapiturharmyaṃ preṣitāsi mayā śubhe..
yena te yacchati pitā nāgarāya mahātmane .. 35 ..
5.197.d:
गच्छ त्वं स्वपितुर्हर्म्यं प्रेषितासि मया शुभे..
येन ते यच्छति पिता नागराय महात्मने .. 35 ..
5.197.m: "Go to your father's mansion, O auspicious one, dismissed by me, / so that your father may give you to a noble Nāgara brahmin.

5.197.s:
kṣamasva yanmayā proktā kadācitparuṣaṃ vacaḥ ..
tvayāpi yanmama proktaṃ kṣāṃtaṃ caitanmayā dhruvam .. 36 .. ..
5.197.d:
क्षमस्व यन्मया प्रोक्ता कदाचित्परुषं वचः ..
त्वयापि यन्मम प्रोक्तं क्षांतं चैतन्मया ध्रुवम् .. 36 .. ..
5.197.m: Forgive whatever harsh word I may have spoken at any time; / and whatever was spoken by you to me, I have certainly forgiven it."

5.197.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī ..
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā .. 37 ..
5.197.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
अष्टवर्षा भवेद्गौरी नववर्षा तु रोहिणी ..
दशवर्षा भवेत्कन्या अत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला .. 37 ..
5.197.m: The brahmin woman said: / "At eight years she is Gaurī; at nine years, Rohiṇī; / at ten years she is a kanyā; beyond that, she has reached puberty.

5.197.s:
kaumāryaṃ ca praṇaṣṭaṃ me tvatsaṃparkādvarānane ..
jātaṃ ṣoḍaśakaṃ varṣaṃ strīdharmeṇa samanvitam .. 38 ..
5.197.d:
कौमार्यं च प्रणष्टं मे त्वत्संपर्काद्वरानने ..
जातं षोडशकं वर्षं स्त्रीधर्मेण समन्वितम् .. 38 ..
5.197.m: My girlhood is gone, O fair-faced one, in association with you; / my sixteenth year has arrived, accompanied by the condition of womanhood.

5.197.s:
na me pāṇigrahaṃ kaścinnāgaro'tra kariṣyati ..
budhyamānastu smṛtyarthaṃ vakṣya māṇaṃ varānane .. 39 ..
5.197.d:
न मे पाणिग्रहं कश्चिन्नागरोऽत्र करिष्यति ..
बुध्यमानस्तु स्मृत्यर्थं वक्ष्य माणं वरानने .. 39 ..
5.197.m: No Nāgara here will take my hand [in marriage], / knowing the sense of the traditional law that is proclaimed, O fair-faced one:

5.197.s:
rajasvalāṃ ca yaḥ kanyāmudvāhayati nirghṛṇaḥ ..
tasyāḥ santānamāsādya pātayetpuruṣāndaśa .. 6.198.40 ..
5.197.d:
रजस्वलां च यः कन्यामुद्वाहयति निर्घृणः ..
तस्याः सन्तानमासाद्य पातयेत्पुरुषान्दश .. 6.198.40 ..
5.197.m: 'A pitiless man who marries a girl who has reached puberty / causes ten generations [of ancestors] to fall, having obtained offspring from her.

5.197.s:
rajasvalā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ pitā yacchati nirghṛṇaḥ ..
sa pātayedasaṃdigdhaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān .. 41 ..
5.197.d:
रजस्वला तु यः कन्यां पिता यच्छति निर्घृणः ..
स पातयेदसंदिग्धं दश पूर्वान्दशापरान् .. 41 ..
5.197.m: And a pitiless father who gives away a girl who has reached puberty / undoubtedly causes ten previous and ten future [generations] to fall.'

5.197.s:
tasmādahaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ tapaḥ śubhe ..
pitrā naiva hi me kāryaṃ na ca mātrā kathaṃcana .. 42 ..
5.197.d:
तस्मादहं करिष्यामि त्वया सार्धं तपः शुभे ..
पित्रा नैव हि मे कार्यं न च मात्रा कथंचन .. 42 ..
5.197.m: Therefore, I shall perform austerity together with you, O auspicious one. / I have no need of a father, nor of a mother in any way."

5.197.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā kanyake dve dvijotamāḥ ..
gate yatra sthitaḥ sākṣādbhartṛyajño mahāmuniḥ .. 43 ..
5.197.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ते निश्चयं कृत्वा कन्यके द्वे द्विजोतमाः ..
गते यत्र स्थितः साक्षाद्भर्तृयज्ञो महामुनिः .. 43 ..
5.197.m: Sūta said: / Having thus made their resolve, O best of brahmins, those two maidens / went to the place where the great sage Bhartṛyajña was present in person.

5.197.s:
sthito vāstupade ramye sarvatīrthamaye śubhe ..
tasya tapaḥprabhāvena jātu kopo na dṛśyate .. 44 ..
5.197.d:
स्थितो वास्तुपदे रम्ये सर्वतीर्थमये शुभे ..
तस्य तपःप्रभावेन जातु कोपो न दृश्यते .. 44 ..
5.197.m: He dwelt at a delightful site, filled with all sacred fords and auspicious. / By the power of his austerity, anger was never seen there

5.197.s:
kasyacitkvāpi martyasya tiryagyoniga tasya ca ..
krīḍaṃti nakulāḥ sarpairmārjārāḥ saha mūṣakaiḥ .. 46 ..
sāraṃgā dvīpibhiḥ sārdhaṃ kākāśca saha kauśikaiḥ ..
bhartṛyajñaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ tatra gatvā tu te śubhe ..
procaturvinayopete kṛtāṃjalipuṭe sthite .. 46 ..
5.197.d:
कस्यचित्क्वापि मर्त्यस्य तिर्यग्योनिग तस्य च ..
क्रीडंति नकुलाः सर्पैर्मार्जाराः सह मूषकैः .. 46 ..
सारंगा द्वीपिभिः सार्धं काकाश्च सह कौशिकैः ..
भर्तृयज्ञं सुखासीनं तत्र गत्वा तु ते शुभे ..
प्रोचतुर्विनयोपेते कृतांजलिपुटे स्थिते .. 46 ..
5.197.m:
in any mortal or animal born of a beastly womb. / Mongooses played with serpents, and cats with mice,
deer with leopards, and crows with owls. / Having gone there to Bhartṛyajña as he sat comfortably, those auspicious [maidens], / standing endowed with modesty and with folded hands, addressed [him]:

5.197.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ sakhyā samaṃ yātā hyanayā rājakanyayā ..
tapo'rthe tava pādāṃte tadbrūhi tapaso vidhim .. 47 ..
5.197.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
अहं सख्या समं याता ह्यनया राजकन्यया ..
तपोऽर्थे तव पादांते तद्ब्रूहि तपसो विधिम् .. 47 ..
5.197.m: The brahmin woman said: / "I have come with this friend, a princess, / to the proximity of your feet for the sake of austerity; so tell us the rules of austerity.

5.197.s: vadasva yena tatkṛtsnaṃ prakaromi mahāmate .. 48 ..
5.197.d: वदस्व येन तत्कृत्स्नं प्रकरोमि महामते .. 48 ..
5.197.m: Speak, so that I may perform it entirely, O wise one!"

5.197.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi tapaścaryāvidhiṃ pṛthak ..
yena saṃprāpyate mokṣaḥ ki punastridaśālayaḥ .. 49 ..
5.197.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
अहं ते कथयिष्यामि तपश्चर्याविधिं पृथक् ..
येन संप्राप्यते मोक्षः कि पुनस्त्रिदशालयः .. 49 ..
5.197.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / "I shall explain to you each rule for the practice of austerity, / by which liberation is attained—what need to speak of the realm of the thirty [gods]?

5.197.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ..
ṣaṣṭhe kāle tathā bhojyaṃ dināṃtaritameva ca .. 6.198.50 ..
5.197.d:
चांद्रायणानि कृच्छ्राणि तथा सांतपनानि च ..
षष्ठे काले तथा भोज्यं दिनांतरितमेव च .. 6.198.50 ..
5.197.m: The cāndrāyaṇa penances, the kṛcchra penances, and likewise the sāṃtapanas; / eating only at the sixth mealtime, and also on alternate days;

5.197.s:
brahmakūrcaṃ trirātraṃ ca ekabhaktamayācitam ..
tapodvārāṇi sarvāṇi kṛtānyetāni vedhasā .. 51 ..
5.197.d:
ब्रह्मकूर्चं त्रिरात्रं च एकभक्तमयाचितम् ..
तपोद्वाराणि सर्वाणि कृतान्येतानि वेधसा .. 51 ..
5.197.m: the brahmakūrca, fasting for three nights, eating once a day, and eating only unasked food: / all these gateways of austerity were created by the Creator.

5.197.s:
svaśaktyā caiva kāryāṇi rāgadveṣavivarjitaiḥ ..
vāṃchitavyaṃ phalaṃ caiva sarveṣāmeva putrike ..
tataḥ siddhimavāpnoti yā sadā manasi sthitā .. 52 ..
5.197.d:
स्वशक्त्या चैव कार्याणि रागद्वेषविवर्जितैः ..
वांछितव्यं फलं चैव सर्वेषामेव पुत्रिके ..
ततः सिद्धिमवाप्नोति या सदा मनसि स्थिता .. 52 ..
5.197.m: They must be performed according to one's capacity, free from attachment and aversion. / And the desired fruit of all [these penances] must be sought, O daughter; / then one obtains the perfection that is ever set in one's mind.

5.197.s:
samatvaṃ śatrumitrābhyāṃ tathā pā ṣāṇaratnayoḥ ..
yadā saṃjāyate citte tadā mokṣamavāpnuyāt .. 53 ..
5.197.d:
समत्वं शत्रुमित्राभ्यां तथा पा षाणरत्नयोः ..
यदा संजायते चित्ते तदा मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् .. 53 ..
5.197.m: When sameness toward enemy and friend, / and likewise toward stone and jewel, arises in the mind, then one may attain liberation.

5.197.s:
yo liṃgagrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kopaparo bhavet ..
tasya vṛthā hi tatsarvaṃ yathā bhasmahutaṃ tathā .. 54 ..
5.197.d:
यो लिंगग्रहणं कृत्वा ततः कोपपरो भवेत् ..
तस्य वृथा हि तत्सर्वं यथा भस्महुतं तथा .. 54 ..
5.197.m: He who, having taken up the marks [of an ascetic], then becomes prone to anger— / for him all of that is in vain, just like an oblation poured into ashes."

5.197.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sā tathetipratijñāya brāhmaṇī sahitā tayā ..
ratnāvatyā jagāmātha kiṃciccaiva jalāśayam .. 55 ..
5.197.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सा तथेतिप्रतिज्ञाय ब्राह्मणी सहिता तया ..
रत्नावत्या जगामाथ किंचिच्चैव जलाशयम् .. 55 ..
5.197.m: Sūta said: / Having agreed with 'So be it,' that brahmin woman, accompanied by / that Ratnāvatī, then went to a certain reservoir of water

5.197.s:
svacchodakena saṃpūrṇaṃ padminīṣaṃḍamaṃḍitam ..
tataścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ cakre tapasaḥ prathamaṃ vratam .. 56 ..
5.197.d:
स्वच्छोदकेन संपूर्णं पद्मिनीषंडमंडितम् ..
ततश्चांद्रायणं चक्रे तपसः प्रथमं व्रतम् .. 56 ..
5.197.m: filled with clear water and adorned with clusters of lotuses. / Then she undertook the cāndrāyaṇa, the first vow of austerity.

5.197.s:
tataḥ kṛcchravrataṃ cakre tataḥ sāṃtapanaṃ ca sā ..
ṣaṣṭhānnakālabhojyā ca sā cābhūdvatsaratrayam .. 57 ..
5.197.d:
ततः कृच्छ्रव्रतं चक्रे ततः सांतपनं च सा ..
षष्ठान्नकालभोज्या च सा चाभूद्वत्सरत्रयम् .. 57 ..
5.197.m: Then she performed the kṛcchra vow, and then the sāṃtapana vow; / and she ate only at the sixth mealtime for three years.

5.197.s:
trirātropoṣaṇaṃ paścādyāvadvarṣatrayaṃ tathā ..
ekāntaropavāsaiśca sā'nayadvatsaratrayam .. 58 ..
5.197.d:
त्रिरात्रोपोषणं पश्चाद्यावद्वर्षत्रयं तथा ..
एकान्तरोपवासैश्च साऽनयद्वत्सरत्रयम् .. 58 ..
5.197.m: Then she fasted for three nights [at a time] for up to three years; / and by fasts on alternate days she spent three years.

5.197.s:
hemaṃte jalamadhyasthā sā babhūva tapasvinī ..
paṃcāgnisādhakā grīṣme sā babhūva yaśasvinī .. 59 ..
5.197.d:
हेमंते जलमध्यस्था सा बभूव तपस्विनी ..
पंचाग्निसाधका ग्रीष्मे सा बभूव यशस्विनी .. 59 ..
5.197.m: In winter, that female ascetic stood in the midst of water; / in summer, that glorious woman practiced the five-fire penance.

5.197.s:
nirāśrayā'bhavatsādhvī varṣākāla upasthite ..
dhyāyamānā divānaktaṃ devadevaṃ janārdanam..6.198.60...
5.197.d:
निराश्रयाऽभवत्साध्वी वर्षाकाल उपस्थिते ..
ध्यायमाना दिवानक्तं देवदेवं जनार्दनम्..6.198.60...
5.197.m: When the rainy season arrived, the virtuous woman remained without shelter, / meditating day and night upon the god of gods, Janārdana.

5.197.s:
yadyadvrataṃ purā cakre brāhmaṇī sā ca suvratā ..
anyaṃ jalāśayaṃ prāpya sā taccakre nṛpātmajā ..
prītyā paramayā yuktā tadā sā dvijasa ttamāḥ .. 61 ..
5.197.d:
यद्यद्व्रतं पुरा चक्रे ब्राह्मणी सा च सुव्रता ..
अन्यं जलाशयं प्राप्य सा तच्चक्रे नृपात्मजा ..
प्रीत्या परमया युक्ता तदा सा द्विजस त्तमाः .. 61 ..
5.197.m: Whatever vow that pious brahmin woman performed first, / the king's daughter, having reached another reservoir of water, performed it [too], / filled with supreme joy at that time, O best of brahmins.

5.197.s:
tato varṣaśataṃ sārdhaṃ phalāhārā babhūva sā ..
śīrṇaparṇāśanā paścāttāvanmātraṃ vyavasthitā .. 62 ..
5.197.d:
ततो वर्षशतं सार्धं फलाहारा बभूव सा ..
शीर्णपर्णाशना पश्चात्तावन्मात्रं व्यवस्थिता .. 62 ..
5.197.m: Then she subsisted on fruits for a hundred and fifty years. / Afterward, she remained for just as long, eating [only] fallen leaves.

5.197.s:
tataścaiva jalāhārā yāvadvarṣaśatāni ṣaṭ ..
vāyubhakṣā babhūvātha sahasraṃ parivatsarān .. 63 ..
5.197.d:
ततश्चैव जलाहारा यावद्वर्षशतानि षट् ..
वायुभक्षा बभूवाथ सहस्रं परिवत्सरान् .. 63 ..
5.197.m: And then she subsisted on water for six hundred years; / then she fed on air for a thousand years.

5.197.s:
yathāyathā tapaścakre sā kumārī dvijottamāḥ ..
tathātathā'bhavattasyāstejovṛddhiranuttamā..64..
5.197.d:
यथायथा तपश्चक्रे सा कुमारी द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तथातथाऽभवत्तस्यास्तेजोवृद्धिरनुत्तमा..64..
5.197.m: In proportion as that maiden performed tapas, O best of brahmins, / in that same measure the incomparable increase of her fiery energy occurred.

5.197.s: etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ .. 65 ..
5.197.d: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवाञ्छशिशेखरः .. 65 ..
5.197.m: At that very time, however, the Lord, crowned with the crescent moon,

5.197.s:
gauryā saha prasannātmā tasyā gocaramāgataḥ ..
meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā tatovacanamabravīt .. 66 ..
5.197.d:
गौर्या सह प्रसन्नात्मा तस्या गोचरमागतः ..
मेघगंभीरया वाचा ततोवचनमब्रवीत् .. 66 ..
5.197.m: accompanied by Gaurī, his mind pleased, came within her sight. / With a voice deep as a thundercloud, he then spoke [these] words:

5.197.s:
vatse taponivṛttiṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva vacanānmama ..
prārthayasva mano'bhīṣṭaṃ yena sarvaṃ dadāmi te .. 67 ..
5.197.d:
वत्से तपोनिवृत्तिं त्वं कुरुष्व वचनान्मम ..
प्रार्थयस्व मनोऽभीष्टं येन सर्वं ददामि ते .. 67 ..
5.197.m: "Child, cease from tapas at my word. / Ask for whatever your heart desires, so that I may grant you all."

5.197.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
abhīṣṭametadevaṃ me yattvaṃ dṛṣṭo'si śaṃkara ..
svapne'pi darśanaṃ deva durlabhaṃ te nṛṇāṃ yataḥ .. 68 ..
5.197.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
अभीष्टमेतदेवं मे यत्त्वं दृष्टोऽसि शंकर ..
स्वप्नेऽपि दर्शनं देव दुर्लभं ते नृणां यतः .. 68 ..
5.197.m: The brahmin girl said: / "My desire is just this: that you have been seen by me, O Śaṃkara, / for even in a dream, O God, your darśana is difficult for mortals to attain."

5.197.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
na me syāddarśanaṃ vyarthaṃ kathaṃcitsutapasvini ..
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yena dadāmyaham .. 69 ..
5.197.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
न मे स्याद्दर्शनं व्यर्थं कथंचित्सुतपस्विनि ..
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते वरं येन ददाम्यहम् .. 69 ..
5.197.m: The Lord said: / "My darśana may not in any way be in vain, O great ascetic lady; / therefore, choose a boon—blessing upon you—so that I may bestow it."

5.197.s:
.. brāhmaṇyuvāca .. ..
eṣā me susakhī sādhvī rājaputrī yaśasvinī ..
khyātā ratnāvatīnāma prāṇebhyo'pigarīyasī .. 6.198.70 ..
5.197.d:
.. ब्राह्मण्युवाच .. ..
एषा मे सुसखी साध्वी राजपुत्री यशस्विनी ..
ख्याता रत्नावतीनाम प्राणेभ्योऽपिगरीयसी .. 6.198.70 ..
5.197.m: The brahmin girl said: / "This good female friend of mine, virtuous, an illustrious king’s daughter, / renowned by the name Ratnāvatī, is dearer [to me] even than life.

5.197.s:
mama tulyaṃ tapaścakre śūdrayonāvapi sthitā ..
nivartate tu yadyeṣā tapasastu nivartanam ..
karomyadya jagannātha tadahaṃ saṃśayaṃ vinā .. 71 ..
5.197.d:
मम तुल्यं तपश्चक्रे शूद्रयोनावपि स्थिता ..
निवर्तते तु यद्येषा तपसस्तु निवर्तनम् ..
करोम्यद्य जगन्नाथ तदहं संशयं विना .. 71 ..
5.197.m: Though born in a śūdra womb, she performed tapas equal to mine. / If she ceases her tapas, then without doubt, / O Lord of the universe, I shall cease mine today.

5.197.s:
asyāḥ snehena saṃtyakto mayā bhartā sureśvara ..
tasmāddeva varaṃ dehi tvamasyā manasi sthitam .. 72 ..
5.197.d:
अस्याः स्नेहेन संत्यक्तो मया भर्ता सुरेश्वर ..
तस्माद्देव वरं देहि त्वमस्या मनसि स्थितम् .. 72 ..
5.197.m: Out of affection for her, my husband was abandoned by me, O Lord of the gods. / Therefore, O God, grant her the boon that rests in her heart."

5.197.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ..
abravīdrājaputrīṃ tāṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ..
vatse madvacanādadya tapastvaṃ tyaktumarhasi .. 73 ..
5.197.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवाञ्छशिशेखरः ..
अब्रवीद्राजपुत्रीं तां मेघगंभीरया गिरा ..
वत्से मद्वचनादद्य तपस्त्वं त्यक्तुमर्हसि .. 73 ..
5.197.m: Sūta said: / Hearing her words, the Lord crowned with the crescent moon / addressed that princess with a voice deep as a thundercloud: / "Child, at my word you ought to abandon your tapas today.

5.197.s:
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi nityaṃ manasi saṃsthitam ..
adeyamapi dāsyāmi sāṃprataṃ tava bhāmini .. 74 ..
5.197.d:
वरं वरय कल्याणि नित्यं मनसि संस्थितम् ..
अदेयमपि दास्यामि सांप्रतं तव भामिनि .. 74 ..
5.197.m: Choose a boon, O auspicious lady, that has constantly dwelled in your heart; / even what should not be given, I will now grant to you, O lovely lady."

5.197.s:
.. ratnāvatyuvāca .. ..
etajjalāśayaṃ puṇyaṃ padminīṣaṇḍa maṇḍitam .. 75 ..
5.197.d:
.. रत्नावत्युवाच .. ..
एतज्जलाशयं पुण्यं पद्मिनीषण्ड मण्डितम् .. 75 ..
5.197.m: Ratnāvatī said: / "This sacred reservoir of water, adorned with clusters of lotuses,

5.197.s:
yatraiṣā brāhmaṇī sādhvī nityaṃ ca tapasi sthitā ..
asyā nāmnā ca vikhyātiṃ tīrthametatprapadyatām .. 76 ..
5.197.d:
यत्रैषा ब्राह्मणी साध्वी नित्यं च तपसि स्थिता ..
अस्या नाम्ना च विख्यातिं तीर्थमेतत्प्रपद्यताम् .. 76 ..
5.197.m: where this virtuous brahmin girl has constantly stood in tapas, / let this tīrtha obtain renown by her name.

5.197.s:
atra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
tasya bhūyātsadā vāso devadeva triviṣṭape au. 77 ..
5.197.d:
अत्र यः कुरुते स्नानं श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
तस्य भूयात्सदा वासो देवदेव त्रिविष्टपे औ. 77 ..
5.197.m: Whoever performs a ritual ablution here, endowed with supreme faith, / let his dwelling always be in heaven, O God of gods!

5.197.s:
madīyaṃ mama nāmnā tu śūdrāsaṃjñaṃ tu jāyatām ..
tasya tulyaprabhāvaṃ tu tīrthasya pratipadyatām .. 78 ..
5.197.d:
मदीयं मम नाम्ना तु शूद्रासंज्ञं तु जायताम् ..
तस्य तुल्यप्रभावं तु तीर्थस्य प्रतिपद्यताम् .. 78 ..
5.197.m: And let my own [tīrtha] be known by my name as Śūdrā, / and let it attain a power equal to that tīrtha.

5.197.s:
āvābhyāṃ nityaśaḥ kāryaṃ kumāratve mahattapaḥ ..
ārādhyastvaṃ suraśreṣṭho vāṅmanaḥkarmabhistathā .. 79 ..
5.197.d:
आवाभ्यां नित्यशः कार्यं कुमारत्वे महत्तपः ..
आराध्यस्त्वं सुरश्रेष्ठो वाङ्मनःकर्मभिस्तथा .. 79 ..
5.197.m: May great tapas be performed perpetually by both of us in maidenhood, / and may you, the foremost of gods, be worshipped [by us] with speech, mind, and deeds."

5.197.s:
etasminneva kāle tu nirbhidya dharaṇītalam ..
liṃgaṃ māheśvaraṃ viprā niṣkrāṃtaṃ sūryasaṃnibham .. 6.198.80 ..
5.197.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु निर्भिद्य धरणीतलम् ..
लिंगं माहेश्वरं विप्रा निष्क्रांतं सूर्यसंनिभम् .. 6.198.80 ..
5.197.m: At that very time, bursting through the surface of the earth, / a Māheśvara liṅga, resembling the sun, came forth, O brahmins.

5.197.s:
tataḥ provāca te devaḥ svayameva maheśvaraḥ ..
tābhyāṃ sutapasā tuṣṭaḥ sādaraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ .. 81 ..
5.197.d:
ततः प्रोवाच ते देवः स्वयमेव महेश्वरः ..
ताभ्यां सुतपसा तुष्टः सादरं भक्तवत्सलः .. 81 ..
5.197.m: Then the God, Maheśvara himself, said to the two of them, / pleased with their excellent tapas, respectful, affectionate toward his devotees:

5.197.s:
etattīrthadvayaṃ khyātaṃ trailokyepi bhaviṣyati ..
śūdrīnāma tvadīyaṃ tu brāhmaṇī ca sakhī tava .. 82 ..
5.197.d:
एतत्तीर्थद्वयं ख्यातं त्रैलोक्येपि भविष्यति ..
शूद्रीनाम त्वदीयं तु ब्राह्मणी च सखी तव .. 82 ..
5.197.m: "This pair of tīrthas shall become famous even in the three worlds, / yours by the name Śūdrī, and [the other named after] your friend Brāhmaṇī.

5.197.s:
tīrthadvaye'pi yaḥ snātvā etasmiñchraddhayā'nvitaḥ ..
tvattaḥ padmāni saṃgṛhya asyāstoyaṃ ca nirmalam ..
etacca māmakaṃ liṃgaṃ snāpayitvā'rcayiṣyati .. 83 ..
5.197.d:
तीर्थद्वयेऽपि यः स्नात्वा एतस्मिञ्छ्रद्धयाऽन्वितः ..
त्वत्तः पद्मानि संगृह्य अस्यास्तोयं च निर्मलम् ..
एतच्च मामकं लिंगं स्नापयित्वाऽर्चयिष्यति .. 83 ..
5.197.m: Whoever, having bathed in both these tīrthas with faith, / taking lotuses from you and clear water from her, / shall bathe and worship this liṅga of mine,

5.197.s:
paścātpadmaiścaturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ somavāsare ..
caitre māsi ca saṃprāpte cirāyuḥ sa bhaviṣyati .. 84 ..
5.197.d:
पश्चात्पद्मैश्चतुर्दश्यां शुक्लायां सोमवासरे ..
चैत्रे मासि च संप्राप्ते चिरायुः स भविष्यति .. 84 ..
5.197.m: and then [worship it] with lotuses on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight on a Monday, / when the month of Caitra has arrived, he will become long-lived,

5.197.s: sarvapāpavinirmukto yadyapi syātsupāpakṛt .. 85 ..
5.197.d: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो यद्यपि स्यात्सुपापकृत् .. 85 ..
5.197.m: freed from all sins, even if he were a perpetrator of great sin."

5.197.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
tatra nityaṃ ca tapasi sthite sakhyāvubhāvapi .. 86 ..
5.197.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
तत्र नित्यं च तपसि स्थिते सख्यावुभावपि .. 86 ..
5.197.m: Having spoken thus, that Lord then vanished. / And both female friends remained there constantly engaged in tapas,

5.197.s:
yāvatkalpaśataṃ tāvajjarāmaraṇavarji te ..
adyāpi gagane te ca dṛśyete tārakātmake .. 87 ..
5.197.d:
यावत्कल्पशतं तावज्जरामरणवर्जि ते ..
अद्यापि गगने ते च दृश्येते तारकात्मके .. 87 ..
5.197.m: free from old age and death for up to a hundred kalpas; / even today the two of them are seen in the sky in the form of stars.

5.197.s:
tataḥprabhṛti tatkhyātaṃ tīrthayugmaṃ dharātale ..
āgatyātha naro dūrāttābhyāṃ kṛtvā nimajjanam .. 88 ..
5.197.d:
ततःप्रभृति तत्ख्यातं तीर्थयुग्मं धरातले ..
आगत्याथ नरो दूरात्ताभ्यां कृत्वा निमज्जनम् .. 88 ..
5.197.m: From that time forward, that pair of tīrthas became famous on the earth’s surface. / Having come from afar, a man who takes a bath in both of them,

5.197.s:
pūjayitvā tu talliṃgaṃ tato yāti divālayam ..
mahāpātakayukto'pi tatprabhāvādasaṃśayam .. 89 ..
5.197.d:
पूजयित्वा तु तल्लिंगं ततो याति दिवालयम् ..
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि तत्प्रभावादसंशयम् .. 89 ..
5.197.m: and then worships that liṅga, goes to the abode of the gods; / even if he is yoked to great heinous sins, by its power, without doubt.

5.197.s:
etasminnaṃtare martye naṣṭā dharmasya ca kriyā ..
yajñadānakṛtā yā ca devārcanasamudbhavā .. 6.198.90 ..
5.197.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मर्त्ये नष्टा धर्मस्य च क्रिया ..
यज्ञदानकृता या च देवार्चनसमुद्भवा .. 6.198.90 ..
5.197.m: Meanwhile, in the mortal world, the performance of righteousness was lost— / that which is produced by sacrifice and gift, and that which arises from worship of the gods.

5.197.s:
vyāptastathākhilaḥ svargo mānavaiḥ spardhayānvitaiḥ ..
sārdhaṃ devairvimānasthairapsarogaṇasevitaiḥ .. 91 ..
5.197.d:
व्याप्तस्तथाखिलः स्वर्गो मानवैः स्पर्धयान्वितैः ..
सार्धं देवैर्विमानस्थैरप्सरोगणसेवितैः .. 91 ..
5.197.m: Likewise, the entire heaven was filled with mortals contending for rivalry / alongside the gods seated in aerial chariots and attended by multitudes of apsarases.

5.197.s:
etasminneva kāle tu dharmarājaḥ samāyayau ..
yatra vedadhvanirbrahmā brahmalokaṃ samāśritaḥ .. .. 92 ..
5.197.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु धर्मराजः समाययौ ..
यत्र वेदध्वनिर्ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मलोकं समाश्रितः .. .. 92 ..
5.197.m: At that very time, the King of Dharma came / to where Brahmā, accompanied by the sound of the Vedas, resided in Brahmaloka.

5.197.s:
abravīdduḥkhito dīnaḥ kṣiptvāgre patrakadvayam ..
ekaṃ pāpasamudbhūtamanyaddharmasamudbhavam .. 93 ..
5.197.d:
अब्रवीद्दुःखितो दीनः क्षिप्त्वाग्रे पत्रकद्वयम् ..
एकं पापसमुद्भूतमन्यद्धर्मसमुद्भवम् .. 93 ..
5.197.m: Miserable and distressed, throwing down two leaves before him— / one arisen from sin, the other arisen from righteousness,

5.197.s:
citreṇa likhitaṃ yacca vicitreṇa tathā param ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre devatīrthayugaṃ sthitam .. 94 ..
5.197.d:
चित्रेण लिखितं यच्च विचित्रेण तथा परम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे देवतीर्थयुगं स्थितम् .. 94 ..
5.197.m: the one written by Citra and the other by Vicitra—he said: / "In the kṣetra born of Hāṭakeśvara, there is a pair of divine tīrthas:

5.197.s:
śūdrākhyaṃ brāhmaṇīnāma tathānyatpadmamaṃḍitam ..
tathā tatrāsti liṃgaṃ ca puṇyaṃ māheśvaraṃ mahat .. 95 ..
5.197.d:
शूद्राख्यं ब्राह्मणीनाम तथान्यत्पद्ममंडितम् ..
तथा तत्रास्ति लिंगं च पुण्यं माहेश्वरं महत् .. 95 ..
5.197.m: one named Śūdrā, the other named Brāhmaṇī and adorned with lotuses; / and there is also a holy, great Māheśvara liṅga there.

5.197.s:
trayāṇāmatha teṣāṃ ca prabhāvātsarvamānavāḥ ..
api pāpasamāyuktāḥ prayāṃti tridaśālayam .. 96 ..
5.197.d:
त्रयाणामथ तेषां च प्रभावात्सर्वमानवाः ..
अपि पापसमायुक्ताः प्रयांति त्रिदशालयम् .. 96 ..
5.197.m: By the power of those three, all mortals, / even when yoked to sin, go to the abode of the thirty [gods].

5.197.s: śūnyā me narakā jātāḥ sarve te rauravādayaḥ .. 97 ..
5.197.d: शून्या मे नरका जाताः सर्वे ते रौरवादयः .. 97 ..
5.197.m: My hells, Raurava and all the others, have become empty.

5.197.s:
na kaścidyajanaṃ cakre na dānaṃ na ca tarpaṇam ..
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 98 ..
5.197.d:
न कश्चिद्यजनं चक्रे न दानं न च तर्पणम् ..
देवतानां पितॄणां च मनुष्याणां विशेषतः .. 98 ..
5.197.m: No one performs sacrifice, nor giving, nor the offering of water / to the gods, the ancestors, and especially to human beings.

5.197.s:
tasmānmukto mayā sarvo yo'dhikārastavodbhavaḥ ..
niyojayasva tatrānyaṃ kañcicchaktatamaṃ tataḥ .. 99 ..
5.197.d:
तस्मान्मुक्तो मया सर्वो योऽधिकारस्तवोद्भवः ..
नियोजयस्व तत्रान्यं कञ्चिच्छक्ततमं ततः .. 99 ..
5.197.m: Therefore, all this office derived from you has been relinquished by me; / appoint someone else there, who is most capable.

5.197.s:
apramāṇaṃ sthitaṃ sarvametatpatradvayaṃ mama ..
tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha samānīya śatakratum .. 6.198.100 ..
5.197.d:
अप्रमाणं स्थितं सर्वमेतत्पत्रद्वयं मम ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजः प्राह समानीय शतक्रतुम् .. 6.198.100 ..
5.197.m: Both these leaves of mine have become void of authority." / Hearing that, the lotus-born [Brahmā] summoned Śatakratu and said:

5.197.s:
gatvā śīghratamaṃ martye tvaṃ śakra vacanānmama ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tīrthadvayamanuttamam .. 101 ..
5.197.d:
गत्वा शीघ्रतमं मर्त्ये त्वं शक्र वचनान्मम ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे तीर्थद्वयमनुत्तमम् .. 101 ..
5.197.m: "Having gone to the mortal world as swiftly as possible, O Śakra, at my word, / in the kṣetra born of Hāṭakeśvara, the incomparable pair of tīrthas—

5.197.s:
śūdryākhyaṃ brāhmaṇītyeva yacca liṃgamanuttamam ..
tatrasthaṃ nāśaya kṣipraṃ kṛtvā pāṃsupravarṣaṇam .. 102 ..
5.197.d:
शूद्र्याख्यं ब्राह्मणीत्येव यच्च लिंगमनुत्तमम् ..
तत्रस्थं नाशय क्षिप्रं कृत्वा पांसुप्रवर्षणम् .. 102 ..
5.197.m: the one named Śūdrī and that called Brāhmaṇī—and the incomparable liṅga / situated there, destroy them quickly by causing a shower of dust."

5.197.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ śakro gatvā bhūmitalaṃ tataḥ ..
pāṃsubhiḥ pūrayāmāsa te tīrthe liṃgameva ca .. 103 ..
5.197.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सत्वरं शक्रो गत्वा भूमितलं ततः ..
पांसुभिः पूरयामास ते तीर्थे लिंगमेव च .. 103 ..
5.197.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that, Śakra quickly went to the earth's surface then, / and filled those two tīrthas and the liṅga with dust.

5.197.s:
adyāpi kalikāle'smindvābhyāṃ gṛhya sumṛttikām ..
snātvā ca tilakaṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye .. 104 ..
5.197.d:
अद्यापि कलिकालेऽस्मिन्द्वाभ्यां गृह्य सुमृत्तिकाम् ..
स्नात्वा च तिलकं कार्यं सर्वपापविशुद्धये .. 104 ..
5.197.m: Even today, in this Kali age, having taken good clay from both, / bathed, and applied a tilaka, it serves for purification from all sins.

5.197.s:
caturdaśīdine prāpte somavāre ca saṃsthite ..
dvābhyāṃ yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
gayāśrāddhena kiṃ tasya manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt .. 105 ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
yathā sā brāhmaṇī jātā śūdrī cāpi tathāparā..1 06..
5.197.d:
चतुर्दशीदिने प्राप्ते सोमवारे च संस्थिते ..
द्वाभ्यां यः कुरुते श्राद्धं श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
गयाश्राद्धेन किं तस्य मनुः स्वायंभुवोऽब्रवीत् .. 105 ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
यथा सा ब्राह्मणी जाता शूद्री चापि तथापरा..1 06..
5.197.m:
When the day of the fourteenth falls on a Monday, / whoever performs a śrāddha with the two [clays] endowed with supreme faith— / what need has he of a śrāddha at Gayā? Thus spoke Manu Svāyambhuva.
All this has been recounted to you, best of brahmins, which I was asked, / how that woman became a brahmin woman and how the other became a Śūdra woman.

5.197.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā dvijasattamāḥ ..
so'pi taddinajātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 107 ..
5.197.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या पठेद्वा द्विजसत्तमाः ..
सोऽपि तद्दिनजात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 107 ..
5.197.m: And whoever hears this with devotion or recites it, best of brahmins, / he too is freed from the sin born on that day; of this there is no doubt.

5.197.s:
evaṃ naro na kaḥ siddhastasya liṃgasya pūjanāt..
cirāyuśca tathā jāto yathānyo nātra vidyate..108..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śūdrībrāhmaṇītīrthadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyuttaraśatatamamo'dhyāyaḥ..
5.197.d:
एवं नरो न कः सिद्धस्तस्य लिंगस्य पूजनात्..
चिरायुश्च तथा जातो यथान्यो नात्र विद्यते..108..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शूद्रीब्राह्मणीतीर्थद्वयमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टनवत्युत्तरशततममोऽध्यायः..
5.197.m:
Thus, what man has not attained perfection from the worship of that liṅga, / and has become long-lived as none other is known to be here?
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Two Sacred Fords of the Śūdra Woman and the Brahmin Woman,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.198.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
tisraḥkoṭyordhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale..
śrūyate sūta kārtsnyena kīrtyamānā munīśvaraiḥ..1..
5.198.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
तिस्रःकोट्योर्धकोटी च तीर्थानामिह भूतले..
श्रूयते सूत कार्त्स्न्येन कीर्त्यमाना मुनीश्वरैः..1..
5.198.m: The seers said: / Three and a half crores of sacred fords here on the earth's surface / are heard of, Sūta, being proclaimed in full by the lords of sages.

5.198.s:
kathaṃ labhyeta sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ phalam..
alpāyurbhirmahābhāga kalikāla upasthite..2..
..sūta uvāca..
kṣetratrayamihākhyātaṃ tathāraṇyatrayaṃ mahat..
purītrayaṃ vanānyeva trīṇi grāmāstathātrayaḥ .. 3 ..
5.198.d:
कथं लभ्येत सर्वेषां तीर्थानां स्नानजं फलम्..
अल्पायुर्भिर्महाभाग कलिकाल उपस्थिते..2..
..सूत उवाच..
क्षेत्रत्रयमिहाख्यातं तथारण्यत्रयं महत्..
पुरीत्रयं वनान्येव त्रीणि ग्रामास्तथात्रयः .. 3 ..
5.198.m: How can the fruit born of ritual ablution in all the sacred fords be obtained / by those of short life, O highly fortunate one, now that the Kali age has arrived? / Sūta said: / Three sacred fields have been declared here, likewise three great forests; / three cities, three groves indeed, and likewise three villages;

5.198.s:
tathā tīrthatrayaṃ cānyatparvatatritayānvitam ..
mahānadītrayaṃ caiva sarvapātakanāśanam .. 4 ..
5.198.d:
तथा तीर्थत्रयं चान्यत्पर्वतत्रितयान्वितम् ..
महानदीत्रयं चैव सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 4 ..
5.198.m: likewise another triad of sacred fords along with a triad of mountains, / and a triad of great rivers that destroys all sins;

5.198.s:
martyalokesthitaṃ viprāḥ sarvatīrthaphalapradam ..
sarveṣveteṣu yaḥ snāti sa sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 5 ..
5.198.d:
मर्त्यलोकेस्थितं विप्राः सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदम् ..
सर्वेष्वेतेषु यः स्नाति स सर्वेषां फलं लभेत् .. 5 ..
5.198.m: situated in the mortal world, O brahmins, bestowing the fruit of all sacred fords. / Whoever performs ritual ablution in all these receives the fruit of all.

5.198.s:
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyānāmidamāha prajāpatiḥ ..
ya ekasmiṃstrike snāti sarva trikaphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
5.198.d:
चतुर्विंशतिसंख्यानामिदमाह प्रजापतिः ..
य एकस्मिंस्त्रिके स्नाति सर्व त्रिकफलं लभेत् .. 6 ..
5.198.m: Prajāpati declared this concerning these twenty-four in number: / one who bathes in a single triad obtains the fruit of the whole triad.

5.198.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
trīṇi kṣetrāṇi kānīha tathāraṇyāni kāni ca ..
puryastisro mahābhāga kāḥkhyātāśca vanāni ca .. 7 ..
5.198.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
त्रीणि क्षेत्राणि कानीह तथारण्यानि कानि च ..
पुर्यस्तिस्रो महाभाग काःख्याताश्च वनानि च .. 7 ..
5.198.m: The seers said: / Which are the three sacred fields here, and which are the forests? / Which are proclaimed to be the three cities, O highly fortunate one, and which the groves?

5.198.s:
ke grāmāḥ kāni tīrthāni ke nagāḥ saritaśca kāḥ ..
nāmabhirvada naḥ sūta sarvāṇyetāni vistarāt .. 8 ..
5.198.d:
के ग्रामाः कानि तीर्थानि के नगाः सरितश्च काः ..
नामभिर्वद नः सूत सर्वाण्येतानि विस्तरात् .. 8 ..
5.198.m: Which are the villages? Which the sacred fords? Which the mountains and which the rivers? / Tell us all these by name, O Sūta, in detail.

5.198.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kurukṣetramiti khyātaṃ prathamaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam .. 9 ..
5.198.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कुरुक्षेत्रमिति ख्यातं प्रथमं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं द्वितीयं परिकीर्तितम् .. 9 ..
5.198.m: Sūta said: / Kurukṣetra is known as the first, supreme sacred field; / the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara is celebrated as the second;

5.198.s:
prābhāsikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu kṣetraṃ hi dvijasattamāḥ ..
etatkṣetratrayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 6.199.10 ..
5.198.d:
प्राभासिकं तृतीयं तु क्षेत्रं हि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
एतत्क्षेत्रत्रयं पुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 6.199.10 ..
5.198.m: and the third sacred field is Prabhāsa, O best of brahmins. / This triad of sacred fields is holy and destroys all sins.

5.198.s:
yathoktavidhinā dṛṣṭvā naraḥ pāpātpramucyate ..
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyankṣetreṣveteṣu bhaktitaḥ .. 11 ..
5.198.d:
यथोक्तविधिना दृष्ट्वा नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते ..
यो यं काममभिध्यायन्क्षेत्रेष्वेतेषु भक्तितः .. 11 ..
5.198.m: Having seen [them] according to the prescribed rule, a man is freed from sin. / Meditating with devotion on whatever desire one wishes in these sacred fields,

5.198.s:
snānaṃ karoti tasyeṣṭaṃ manaso jāyate phalam ..
caturviṃśatimāneṣu snāto bhavati sa dvijāḥ..12..
5.198.d:
स्नानं करोति तस्येष्टं मनसो जायते फलम् ..
चतुर्विंशतिमानेषु स्नातो भवति स द्विजाः..12..
5.198.m: if he performs ritual ablution, the fruit cherished by his mind comes to pass. / He becomes [as if] bathed in the twenty-four [places], O brahmins.

5.198.s:
ekaṃ tu puṣkarāraṇyaṃ naimiṣāraṇyameva ca ..
dharmāraṇyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu teṣāṃ saṃkīrtyate dvijāḥ .. 13 ..
5.198.d:
एकं तु पुष्करारण्यं नैमिषारण्यमेव च ..
धर्मारण्यं तृतीयं तु तेषां संकीर्त्यते द्विजाः .. 13 ..
5.198.m: Puṣkarāraṇya is one forest, and Naimiṣāraṇya indeed [the second]; / the third among them is proclaimed to be Dharmāraṇya, O brahmins.

5.198.s: triṣveteṣu ca yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 14 ..
5.198.d: त्रिष्वेतेषु च यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 14 ..
5.198.m: And whoever performs ritual ablution in these three becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
vārāṇasī purītyekā dvitīyā dvārakāpurī ..
avantyākhyā tṛtīyā ca viśrutā bhuvanatraye .. 15 ..
5.198.d:
वाराणसी पुरीत्येका द्वितीया द्वारकापुरी ..
अवन्त्याख्या तृतीया च विश्रुता भुवनत्रये .. 15 ..
5.198.m: The city of Vārāṇasī is one, Dvārakā is the second city, / and the third is called Avantī, renowned in the three worlds.

5.198.s: etāsu yo naraḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 16 ..
5.198.d: एतासु यो नरः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 16 ..
5.198.m: A man who performs ritual ablution in these becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
vṛndāvanaṃ vanaṃ caikaṃ dvitīyaṃ khāṃḍavaṃ vanam ..
khyātaṃ dvaitavanaṃ cānyattṛtīyaṃ dharaṇītale .. 17 ..
5.198.d:
वृन्दावनं वनं चैकं द्वितीयं खांडवं वनम् ..
ख्यातं द्वैतवनं चान्यत्तृतीयं धरणीतले .. 17 ..
5.198.m: Vṛndāvana is one grove, and Khāṇḍava is the second grove; / another is celebrated as Dvaitavana, the third on the earth's surface.

5.198.s: triṣveteṣu ca yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet ..18..
5.198.d: त्रिष्वेतेषु च यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् ..18..
5.198.m: And whoever performs ritual ablution in these three becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
kalpagrāmaḥ smṛtaścaikaḥ śāligrāmo dvitīyakaḥ ..
naṃdigrāmastṛtīyastu viśruto dvijasattamāḥ ..19..
5.198.d:
कल्पग्रामः स्मृतश्चैकः शालिग्रामो द्वितीयकः ..
नंदिग्रामस्तृतीयस्तु विश्रुतो द्विजसत्तमाः ..19..
5.198.m: Kalpagrāma is remembered as one, Śāligrāma as the second, / and Nandigrāma is the renowned third, O best of brahmins.

5.198.s: triṣveteṣu ca yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 6.199.20 ..
5.198.d: त्रिष्वेतेषु च यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 6.199.20 ..
5.198.m: And whoever performs ritual ablution in these three becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
agnitīrthaṃ smṛtaṃ caikaṃ śuklatīrthamathāparam..
tṛtīyaṃ pitṛtīrthaṃ tu pitṝṇāmativallabham .. 21 ..
5.198.d:
अग्नितीर्थं स्मृतं चैकं शुक्लतीर्थमथापरम्..
तृतीयं पितृतीर्थं तु पितॄणामतिवल्लभम् .. 21 ..
5.198.m: Agnitīrtha is remembered as one, and Śuklatīrtha as the next; / and the third is Pitṛtīrtha, exceedingly dear to the ancestors.

5.198.s: triṣveteṣu ca yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 22 ..
5.198.d: त्रिष्वेतेषु च यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 22 ..
5.198.m: And whoever performs ritual ablution in these three becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
śrīparvataḥ smṛtaścaiko dvitīyaścārbudastathā ..
tṛtīyo raivatākhyo'tra vikhyātaḥ parvatottamāḥ .. 23 ..
5.198.d:
श्रीपर्वतः स्मृतश्चैको द्वितीयश्चार्बुदस्तथा ..
तृतीयो रैवताख्योऽत्र विख्यातः पर्वतोत्तमाः .. 23 ..
5.198.m: Śrīparvata is remembered as one, and Arbuda likewise as the second; / the third here is named Raivata, renowned as the best of mountains.

5.198.s: triṣveteṣu ca yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 24 ..
5.198.d: त्रिष्वेतेषु च यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 24 ..
5.198.m: And whoever performs ritual ablution in these three becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
gaṃgā nadī smṛtā pūrvā narmadākhyā tathā parā ..
sarasvatī tṛtīyā tu nadī plakṣasamudbhavā .. 25 ..
5.198.d:
गंगा नदी स्मृता पूर्वा नर्मदाख्या तथा परा ..
सरस्वती तृतीया तु नदी प्लक्षसमुद्भवा .. 25 ..
5.198.m: The river Gaṅgā is remembered as the first, and another is named Narmadā; / the third is Sarasvatī, the river arising from the Plakṣa tree.

5.198.s: āsu sarvāsu yaḥ snāti caturviṃśatibhāgbhavet .. 26 ..
5.198.d: आसु सर्वासु यः स्नाति चतुर्विंशतिभाग्भवेत् .. 26 ..
5.198.m: Whoever performs ritual ablution in all these becomes a sharer in the twenty-four.

5.198.s:
eteṣveva hi sarveṣu yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
sārdhakoṭitrayasyātra sa kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnuyāt .. 27 ..
5.198.d:
एतेष्वेव हि सर्वेषु यः स्नानं कुरुते नरः ..
सार्धकोटित्रयस्यात्र स कृत्स्नं फलमाप्नुयात् .. 27 ..
5.198.m: A man who performs ritual ablution in all these indeed / obtains the complete fruit of the three and a half crores [of sacred fords] here.

5.198.s: yaścaikasminnaraḥ snāti sa trikasya phalaṃ labhet .. 28 ..
5.198.d: यश्चैकस्मिन्नरः स्नाति स त्रिकस्य फलं लभेत् .. 28 ..
5.198.m: And a man who performs ritual ablution in one [of them] receives the fruit of the triad.

5.198.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
saṃkṣepāttīrthajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhyate yannarairbhuvi .. 29 ..
5.198.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
संक्षेपात्तीर्थजं पुण्यं लभ्यते यन्नरैर्भुवि .. 29 ..
5.198.m: All this has been recounted to you, which I was asked, O best of brahmins: / the religious merit born of sacred fords that is obtained in brief by men on earth.

5.198.s: sāṃprataṃ kiṃ nu vo vacmi yattadvadata mā ciram .. 6.199.30 ..
5.198.d: सांप्रतं किं नु वो वच्मि यत्तद्वदत मा चिरम् .. 6.199.30 ..
5.198.m: What now shall I say to you? Speak of that without delay.

5.198.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre yāni tīrthāni sūtaja ..
tāni proktāni sarvāṇi tvayā'smākaṃ suvistarāt .. 31 ..
5.198.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे यानि तीर्थानि सूतज ..
तानि प्रोक्तानि सर्वाणि त्वयाऽस्माकं सुविस्तरात् .. 31 ..
5.198.m: The seers said: / All those sacred fords that exist in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, O son of Sūta, / have been declared by you to us in great detail,

5.198.s:
tathā cāyatanānyeva saṃkhyayā rahitāni ca ..
api varṣaśatenātra snānaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate .. 32 ..
5.198.d:
तथा चायतनान्येव संख्यया रहितानि च ..
अपि वर्षशतेनात्र स्नानं कर्तुं न शक्यते .. 32 ..
5.198.m: and likewise shrines beyond number. / Even in a hundred years it is not possible to perform ritual ablution here,

5.198.s:
teṣu sarveṣu martyena yathoktavidhinā sphuṭam ..
devatāyatanānyeva tathā draṣṭuṃ mahā mate .. 33 ..
5.198.d:
तेषु सर्वेषु मर्त्येन यथोक्तविधिना स्फुटम् ..
देवतायतनान्येव तथा द्रष्टुं महा मते .. 33 ..
5.198.m: clearly, by a mortal in all of them according to the prescribed rule, / and likewise to see the shrines of the deities, O wise one.

5.198.s:
yasminsnāto dine caiva tasya vyuṣṭiḥ prakīrtitā ..
alpāyuṣastadā martyāḥ kṛte'pi parikīrtitāḥ .. 34 ..
5.198.d:
यस्मिन्स्नातो दिने चैव तस्य व्युष्टिः प्रकीर्तिता ..
अल्पायुषस्तदा मर्त्याः कृतेऽपि परिकीर्तिताः .. 34 ..
5.198.m: The reward is proclaimed [only] for the day on which one has bathed in it. / Mortals were declared to have short lives even in the Kṛta age;

5.198.s:
tretāyāṃ dvāpare cāpi kimu prāpte kalau yuge ..
evamalpāyuṣo jñātvā mānavānsūtanaṃdana .. 35 ..
5.198.d:
त्रेतायां द्वापरे चापि किमु प्राप्ते कलौ युगे ..
एवमल्पायुषो ज्ञात्वा मानवान्सूतनंदन .. 35 ..
5.198.m: in the Tretā and in the Dvāpara as well, how much more so when the Kali age has arrived! / Knowing that human beings have such short lives, O son of Sūta,

5.198.s:
labheraṃśca kathaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ phalam ..
devadarśanajaṃ vāpi viśeṣānnirdhanāśca ye .. 36 ..
5.198.d:
लभेरंश्च कथं सर्वतीर्थानां स्नानजं फलम् ..
देवदर्शनजं वापि विशेषान्निर्धनाश्च ये .. 36 ..
5.198.m: how might they obtain the fruit born of ritual ablution in all the sacred fords, / or that born of seeing the deities, especially those who are penniless?

5.198.s:
asti kaścidupāyo'tra daivo vā mānuṣo'pi vā ..
yena teṣāṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ sarveṣāmeva helayā .. 37 ..
5.198.d:
अस्ति कश्चिदुपायोऽत्र दैवो वा मानुषोऽपि वा ..
येन तेषां भवेत्पुण्यं सर्वेषामेव हेलया .. 37 ..
5.198.m: Is there any means here, whether divine or human, / by which religious merit may come to all of them easily?

5.198.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
asminnarthe purā pṛṣṭo viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
samupetyāśramaṃ tasya ānartena mahībhujā .. 38 ..
5.198.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अस्मिन्नर्थे पुरा पृष्टो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ..
समुपेत्याश्रमं तस्य आनर्तेन महीभुजा .. 38 ..
5.198.m: Sūta said: / Regarding this matter, the great sage Viśvāmitra was asked in the past / by the king Ānarta, having approached his hermitage.

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
bhagavannatra tīrthāni saṃkhyayā rahitāni ca ..
teṣu snānavidhiḥ proktaḥ sarveṣveva pṛthakpṛthak .. 39 ..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
भगवन्नत्र तीर्थानि संख्यया रहितानि च ..
तेषु स्नानविधिः प्रोक्तः सर्वेष्वेव पृथक्पृथक् .. 39 ..
5.198.m: The king said: / O venerable one, the sacred fords here are beyond number, / and the rule of ritual ablution has been proclaimed in each and every one separately,

5.198.s:
māse vāre dine caiva kutracinmunisattamaiḥ ..
dānāni ca tathoktāni yathā snāna vidhistathā .. 6.199.40 ..
5.198.d:
मासे वारे दिने चैव कुत्रचिन्मुनिसत्तमैः ..
दानानि च तथोक्तानि यथा स्नान विधिस्तथा .. 6.199.40 ..
5.198.m: in a particular month, weekday, and lunar day by the best of sages; / gifts have likewise been stated, just as the rule of ritual ablution.

5.198.s:
devānāṃ darśanaṃ cāpi pṛthaktena prakīrtitam ..
na śakyate phalaṃ prāptuṃ sarveṣāṃ kenacinmune .. 41 ..
5.198.d:
देवानां दर्शनं चापि पृथक्तेन प्रकीर्तितम् ..
न शक्यते फलं प्राप्तुं सर्वेषां केनचिन्मुने .. 41 ..
5.198.m: The darśana of the deities has also been declared separately. / It is not possible for anyone to obtain the fruit of all of them, O sage,

5.198.s:
api varṣaśatenāpi kiṃ punaḥ stokavāsaraiḥ..
tasmādvada mahābhāga sukhopāyaṃ ca dehinām ..42..
5.198.d:
अपि वर्षशतेनापि किं पुनः स्तोकवासरैः..
तस्माद्वद महाभाग सुखोपायं च देहिनाम् ..42..
5.198.m: even in a hundred years, how much less in a few days! / Therefore, O highly fortunate one, tell an easy means for embodied beings.

5.198.s:
ekasminnapi ca snātastīrthe prāpnoti mānavaḥ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ sakalaṃ phalam .. 43 ..
5.198.d:
एकस्मिन्नपि च स्नातस्तीर्थे प्राप्नोति मानवः..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां स्नानजं सकलं फलम् .. 43 ..
5.198.m: [so that] a person, bathed in even a single sacred ford, / obtains the entire fruit born of bathing in all sacred fords?

5.198.s:
tathaikasminsure dṛṣṭe sarvadevasamudbhavam ..
phalaṃ darśanajaṃ bhāvi narāṇāṃ dvijasattama .. 49 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā suciraṃ dhyātvā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
abravīcchṛṇu rājeṃdra sarahasyaṃ vadāmi te .. 45 ..
catvāryatra prakṛṣṭāni mukhyatīrthāni pārthiva ..
yeṣu snāne kṛte rājañchrāddhe ca tadanaṃtaram ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ snānajaṃ labhyate phalam .. 46 ..
saptaviṃśatiliṃgāni tathātraiva sthitāni ca ..
siddheśvaraprapūrvāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca .. 47 ..
teṣu sarveṣu dṛṣṭeṣu bhaktyā pūtena cetasā ..
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ bhaveddarśanajaṃ phalam .. 48 ..
ekasminnapi saṃdṛṣṭe pūjite vā surottame ..
saptaviṃśatiliṃgānāṃ pūjā tena kṛtā bhavet .. 49 ..
5.198.d:
तथैकस्मिन्सुरे दृष्टे सर्वदेवसमुद्भवम् ..
फलं दर्शनजं भावि नराणां द्विजसत्तम .. 49 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सुचिरं ध्यात्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ..
अब्रवीच्छृणु राजेंद्र सरहस्यं वदामि ते .. 45 ..
चत्वार्यत्र प्रकृष्टानि मुख्यतीर्थानि पार्थिव ..
येषु स्नाने कृते राजञ्छ्राद्धे च तदनंतरम् ..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां स्नानजं लभ्यते फलम् .. 46 ..
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानि तथात्रैव स्थितानि च ..
सिद्धेश्वरप्रपूर्वाणि सर्वपापहराणि च .. 47 ..
तेषु सर्वेषु दृष्टेषु भक्त्या पूतेन चेतसा ..
सर्वेषामेव देवानां भवेद्दर्शनजं फलम् .. 48 ..
एकस्मिन्नपि संदृष्टे पूजिते वा सुरोत्तमे ..
सप्तविंशतिलिंगानां पूजा तेन कृता भवेत् .. 49 ..
5.198.m:
Likewise, when a single god is seen, what fruit arises from all the gods / born of darśana shall come to men, O best of the twice-born?
Sūta said:
Having heard that and meditated for a long time, the great sage Viśvāmitra / spoke: “Listen, O lord of kings; I tell you a secret.
Here there are four excellent, principal sacred fords, O king. / When bathing is performed in them, O king, and thereafter a śrāddha, / the fruit born of bathing in all sacred fords is obtained.
Likewise, twenty-seven liṅgas are situated right here, / beginning with Siddheśvara, which remove all sins.
When all of them are seen with devotion and a purified mind, / the fruit born of the darśana of all the gods is obtained.
Even when a single foremost god [among them] is seen or worshipped, / the worship of the twenty-seven liṅgas is performed by him.”

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
kāni catvāri tīrthāni tatra mukhyāni sanmune ..
yeṣu snāto naraḥ samyaksarveṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 6.199.50 ..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
कानि चत्वारि तीर्थानि तत्र मुख्यानि सन्मुने ..
येषु स्नातो नरः सम्यक्सर्वेषां लभते फलम् .. 6.199.50 ..
5.198.m:
The king said:
“Which four sacred fords are the principal ones there, O virtuous sage, / bathed in which a person properly obtains the fruit of all of them?”

5.198.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
atrāsti kūpikā puṇyā yasyāṃ saṃśrayate gayā ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmamāvāsyādine tathā .. 51 ..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अत्रास्ति कूपिका पुण्या यस्यां संश्रयते गया ..
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्याममावास्यादिने तथा .. 51 ..
5.198.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“Here there is a holy small well in which Gayā takes refuge / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight and on the day of the new moon,

5.198.s:
viśeṣeṇa mahābhāga kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ..
nirviṇṇā bhūmilokānāṃ kṛtaiḥ śrāddhairanekadhā .. 52 ..
5.198.d:
विशेषेण महाभाग कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
निर्विण्णा भूमिलोकानां कृतैः श्राद्धैरनेकधा .. 52 ..
5.198.m: especially, O highly fortunate one, when the sun is in the sign of Virgo. / Wearied by the many śrāddhas performed by the people of the earth,

5.198.s: yastasyāṃ kurute śrāddhaṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 53 ..
5.198.d: यस्तस्यां कुरुते श्राद्धं सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 53 ..
5.198.m: whoever performs a śrāddha in it, properly endowed with faith,

5.198.s:
tasminnahani rājeṃdra sa saṃtārayate pitṝn ..
tathā tīrthaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śaṃkhatīrthamiti smṛtam.. .. 54 ..
5.198.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि राजेंद्र स संतारयते पितॄन् ..
तथा तीर्थं द्वितीयं तु शंखतीर्थमिति स्मृतम्.. .. 54 ..
5.198.m: on that day, O king of kings, he delivers his ancestors. / And the second sacred ford is remembered as Śaṅkhatīrtha.

5.198.s:
tatra snātvā naro yastu paśyecchaṃkheśvaraṃ tataḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ phalamāpnoti māghasya prathame'hani .. 55 ..
5.198.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो यस्तु पश्येच्छंखेश्वरं ततः ..
सर्वेषां फलमाप्नोति माघस्य प्रथमेऽहनि .. 55 ..
5.198.m: Having bathed there, the man who then sees Śaṅkheśvara / on the first day of Māgha obtains the fruit of all of them.

5.198.s:
tathā mannāmakaṃ tīrthe tṛtīyaṃ mukhyatāṃ gatam ..
atra snātvā tu yaḥ paśyenmayā saṃsthāpitaṃ haram .. 56 ..
5.198.d:
तथा मन्नामकं तीर्थे तृतीयं मुख्यतां गतम् ..
अत्र स्नात्वा तु यः पश्येन्मया संस्थापितं हरम् .. 56 ..
5.198.m: Likewise, the third sacred ford bearing my name has attained preeminence. / But having bathed here, whoever beholds Hara installed by me,

5.198.s:
viśvāmitreśvaraṃ nāma sarveṣāṃ sa phalaṃ labhet ..
nabhasyasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ sarveṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 57 ..
5.198.d:
विश्वामित्रेश्वरं नाम सर्वेषां स फलं लभेत् ..
नभस्यस्य सिताष्टम्यां सर्वेषां लभते फलम् .. 57 ..
5.198.m: named Viśvāmitreśvara, he shall obtain the fruit of all of them. / On the bright eighth day of Nabhasya, he obtains the fruit of all of them.

5.198.s:
śakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ caturthaṃ bālamaṇḍanam ..
tatra snātvā ca paṃcāhaṃ śakreśvaramavekṣya ca ..
āśvinasya site'ṣṭamyāṃ sarveṣāṃ labhate phalam .. 58 ..
5.198.d:
शक्रतीर्थमिति ख्यातं चतुर्थं बालमण्डनम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा च पंचाहं शक्रेश्वरमवेक्ष्य च ..
आश्विनस्य सितेऽष्टम्यां सर्वेषां लभते फलम् .. 58 ..
5.198.m: The fourth, renowned as Śakratīrtha, is an ornament for children. / Having bathed there for five days and having looked upon Śakreśvara / on the bright eighth day of Āśvina, he obtains the fruit of all of them.”

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
vidhānaṃ vada me vipra gayākūpyāḥ samudbhavam ..
vistareṇa mahābhāga śraddhā me mahatī sthitā .. 59 .. ..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
विधानं वद मे विप्र गयाकूप्याः समुद्भवम् ..
विस्तरेण महाभाग श्रद्धा मे महती स्थिता .. 59 .. ..
5.198.m:
The king said:
“Tell me, O brahmin, the rule regarding the origin of Gayākūpī / in detail, O highly fortunate one; great faith has arisen in me.”

5.198.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
amāvāsyādine prāpte tatra kanyāgate ravau ..
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute bhaktyā sa pitṝṃstārayennijān .. 6.199.60 ..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अमावास्यादिने प्राप्ते तत्र कन्यागते रवौ ..
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते भक्त्या स पितॄंस्तारयेन्निजान् .. 6.199.60 ..
5.198.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
“When the day of the new moon has arrived, with the sun situated in Virgo, / he who performs a śrāddha with devotion delivers his ancestors,

5.198.s:
bhartṛyajñavidhānena śuddhaiḥ sthānodbhavairdvijaiḥ ..
bhartṛyajñavidhiṃ tyaktvā yo'nyena vidhinā naraḥ .. 61 ..
5.198.d:
भर्तृयज्ञविधानेन शुद्धैः स्थानोद्भवैर्द्विजैः ..
भर्तृयज्ञविधिं त्यक्त्वा योऽन्येन विधिना नरः .. 61 ..
5.198.m: according to the rule of Bhartṛyajña, with pure brahmins born of the place. / A man who, abandoning the rule of Bhartṛyajña, by another rule

5.198.s:
śrāddhaṃ karoti mūḍhātmā vihīnaṃ sthānajairdvijaiḥ ..
sthānajairapi vā'śuddhaistasya tadvyarthatāṃ vrajet 62 ..
5.198.d:
श्राद्धं करोति मूढात्मा विहीनं स्थानजैर्द्विजैः ..
स्थानजैरपि वाऽशुद्धैस्तस्य तद्व्यर्थतां व्रजेत् 62 ..
5.198.m: performs a śrāddha, foolish-minded, lacking brahmins born of the place, / or [performed] with impure ones, even if born of the place, that becomes futile for him.

5.198.s:
vṛṣṭiḥ syādūṣare yadvatsatyametanmayoditam ..
aṃdhasyāgre yathā nṛtyaṃ pragītaṃ badhirasya ca ..
tathā ca vyarthatāṃ yāti anyasthānodbhavairdvijaiḥ .. 63 ..
5.198.d:
वृष्टिः स्यादूषरे यद्वत्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
अंधस्याग्रे यथा नृत्यं प्रगीतं बधिरस्य च ..
तथा च व्यर्थतां याति अन्यस्थानोद्भवैर्द्विजैः .. 63 ..
5.198.m: It is like rain upon barren ground; this truth is spoken by me. / Just as a dance before a blind man, and singing for a deaf man, / so it goes to futility when performed with brahmins born of another place.

5.198.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kārayecchrāddhaṃ mūrkhairapi dvijottamāḥ ..
caturvedā api tyājyā anyasthānasamudbhavāḥ ..64..
5.198.d:
ब्राह्मणैः कारयेच्छ्राद्धं मूर्खैरपि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चतुर्वेदा अपि त्याज्या अन्यस्थानसमुद्भवाः ..64..
5.198.m: One should have the śrāddha performed by brahmins, even if ignorant, O best of the twice-born; / even knowers of the four Vedas are to be abandoned if born of another place.

5.198.s:
dave karmaṇi pitrye vā somapāne viśeṣataḥ..
deśāṃtaragato yastu śrāddhaṃ ca kurute naraḥ ..
vaiśvānarapurastena kāryaṃ nānyadvijasya ca .. 65..
5.198.d:
दवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये वा सोमपाने विशेषतः..
देशांतरगतो यस्तु श्राद्धं च कुरुते नरः ..
वैश्वानरपुरस्तेन कार्यं नान्यद्विजस्य च .. 65..
5.198.m: In a rite for the gods or for the ancestors, especially at the drinking of soma— / but a man who has gone to another country and performs a śrāddha / must perform it before Agni, and not with another twice-born.

5.198.s:
saṃniveśya darbhabaṭūñchrāddhaṃ kuryāddvijottamāḥ ..
dakṣiṇā bhojanaṃ deyaṃ sthānikānāṃ cirādapi .. 66 ..
5.198.d:
संनिवेश्य दर्भबटूञ्छ्राद्धं कुर्याद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
दक्षिणा भोजनं देयं स्थानिकानां चिरादपि .. 66 ..
5.198.m: Having seated darbha effigies, he should perform the śrāddha, O best of the twice-born. / The priestly fee and food should be given to the local brahmins, even after a long time.

5.198.s:
paṃcagavyasya saṃpūrṇo yathā kumbhaḥ praduṣyati ..
biṃdunaikena madyasya patitena nṛpottama .. 67 ..
5.198.d:
पंचगव्यस्य संपूर्णो यथा कुम्भः प्रदुष्यति ..
बिंदुनैकेन मद्यस्य पतितेन नृपोत्तम .. 67 ..
5.198.m: Just as a vessel full of the five products of the cow is polluted / by a single drop of liquor fallen [into it], O best of kings,

5.198.s:
ekenāpi ca bāhyena bahūnāmapi bhūpate ..
madhye samupaviṣṭena tacchrāddhaṃ doṣamāpnuyāt .. 68 ..
5.198.d:
एकेनापि च बाह्येन बहूनामपि भूपते ..
मध्ये समुपविष्टेन तच्छ्राद्धं दोषमाप्नुयात् .. 68 ..
5.198.m: even by a single outsider seated in the midst / of many, O king, that śrāddha would incur defilement.

5.198.s:
sthānajo'pi caturvedo yadyapi syānna śuddhibhāk ..
bahūnāmapi śuddhānāṃ madhye śrāddhaṃ vināśayet .. 69 ..
5.198.d:
स्थानजोऽपि चतुर्वेदो यद्यपि स्यान्न शुद्धिभाक् ..
बहूनामपि शुद्धानां मध्ये श्राद्धं विनाशयेत् .. 69 ..
5.198.m: Even a native of the place knowing the four Vedas, if he does not possess purity, / will ruin the śrāddha [if seated] in the midst of many pure ones.

5.198.s: tasmātsarvaprayatnena śuddhaṃ brāhmaṇamānayet .. 6.199.70 ..
5.198.d: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन शुद्धं ब्राह्मणमानयेत् .. 6.199.70 ..
5.198.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should bring a pure brahmin,

5.198.s:
sthānikaṃ mūrkhamapyevamalābhe guṇināmapi ..
hīnāṃgamadhikāṃgaṃ vā dūṣitaṃ no tathā param .. 71 ..
5.198.d:
स्थानिकं मूर्खमप्येवमलाभे गुणिनामपि ..
हीनांगमधिकांगं वा दूषितं नो तथा परम् .. 71 ..
5.198.m: even an ignorant local one, in the absence of virtuous ones; / not one with a missing limb or an extra limb, or otherwise corrupted.

5.198.s:
kanyādāne tathā śrāddhe kulīno brāhmaṇaḥ sadā ..
āhartavyaḥ prayatnena ya icchecchubhamātmanaḥ ..
so'pi śuddhisamāyukto yadi syānnṛpasattama .. 72 ..
5.198.d:
कन्यादाने तथा श्राद्धे कुलीनो ब्राह्मणः सदा ..
आहर्तव्यः प्रयत्नेन य इच्छेच्छुभमात्मनः ..
सोऽपि शुद्धिसमायुक्तो यदि स्यान्नृपसत्तम .. 72 ..
5.198.m: In giving away a maiden and in a śrāddha, a well-born brahmin / should always be brought with effort by one who desires his own welfare, / if he too is endowed with purity, O best of kings.

5.198.s:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca yathā'śvattho devatānāṃ yathā hariḥ..
śreṣṭhasthānajaviprāṇāṃ tathā cāṣṭakulodbhavaḥ .. 73 ..
5.198.d:
वृक्षाणां च यथाऽश्वत्थो देवतानां यथा हरिः..
श्रेष्ठस्थानजविप्राणां तथा चाष्टकुलोद्भवः .. 73 ..
5.198.m: As the aśvattha tree among trees, as Hari among deities, / so is one born of eight noble families among the brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
āyudhānāṃ yathā vajraṃ sarasāṃ sāgaro yathā ..
śreṣṭhasthānajaviprāṇāṃ tathāṣṭakulasaṃbhavaḥ .. 74 ..
5.198.d:
आयुधानां यथा वज्रं सरसां सागरो यथा ..
श्रेष्ठस्थानजविप्राणां तथाष्टकुलसंभवः .. 74 ..
5.198.m: As the thunderbolt among weapons, as the ocean among bodies of water, / so is one born of eight noble families among the brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
uccaiḥśravā yathā'śvānāṃ gajānāṃ śakravāhanaḥ ..
śreṣṭhasthānajaviprāṇāṃ tathāṣṭakulasaṃbhavaḥ .. 75 ..
5.198.d:
उच्चैःश्रवा यथाऽश्वानां गजानां शक्रवाहनः ..
श्रेष्ठस्थानजविप्राणां तथाष्टकुलसंभवः .. 75 ..
5.198.m: As Uccaiḥśravas among horses, as Indra's mount among elephants, / so is one born of eight noble families among the brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā satīnāṃ cāpyaruṃdhatī ..
tadvatsthānajaviprāṇāṃ śreṣṭho'ṣṭakulikaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 76 ..
5.198.d:
नदीनां च यथा गंगा सतीनां चाप्यरुंधती ..
तद्वत्स्थानजविप्राणां श्रेष्ठोऽष्टकुलिकः स्मृतः .. 76 ..
5.198.m: As the Gaṅgā among rivers, and as Arundhatī among chaste wives, / likewise one belonging to eight families is remembered as the best among brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
grahāṇāṃ bhāskaro yadvannakṣatrāṇāṃ niśākaraḥ ..
tadvatsthānajaviprāṇāṃ śreṣṭho'ṣṭakulikaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 77 ..
5.198.d:
ग्रहाणां भास्करो यद्वन्नक्षत्राणां निशाकरः ..
तद्वत्स्थानजविप्राणां श्रेष्ठोऽष्टकुलिकः स्मृतः .. 77 ..
5.198.m: Just as the sun among planets, and the moon among constellations, / likewise one belonging to eight families is remembered as the best among brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
parvatānāṃ yathā merurdvipadānāṃ dvijottamaḥ ..
sthānajānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ śreṣṭho'ṣṭakulikastathā .. 78 ..
5.198.d:
पर्वतानां यथा मेरुर्द्विपदानां द्विजोत्तमः ..
स्थानजानां तु विप्राणां श्रेष्ठोऽष्टकुलिकस्तथा .. 78 ..
5.198.m: As Meru among mountains, and a brahmin among two-footed beings, / so one belonging to eight families is the best among brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yadvatsiṃho'raṇyanivāsinām ..
sthānajānāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ śreṣṭho'ṣṭakulikastathā .. 79 ..
5.198.d:
पक्षिणां गरुडो यद्वत्सिंहोऽरण्यनिवासिनाम् ..
स्थानजानां तु विप्राणां श्रेष्ठोऽष्टकुलिकस्तथा .. 79 ..
5.198.m: Just as Garuḍa among birds, and the lion among forest dwellers, / so one belonging to eight families is the best among brahmins born of the place.

5.198.s:
evaṃ jñātvā prayatnena śrāddhe yajñe ca pārthiva .
kanyādāne viśeṣeṇa yojyaścāṣṭakulodbhavaḥ .. 6.199.80 ..
5.198.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा प्रयत्नेन श्राद्धे यज्ञे च पार्थिव .
कन्यादाने विशेषेण योज्यश्चाष्टकुलोद्भवः .. 6.199.80 ..
5.198.m: Knowing this, one born of eight noble families should be employed with effort, O king, / in a śrāddha and in a sacrifice, and especially in giving away a maiden.

5.198.s:
nṛtyaṃti pitarastasya garjaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ ..
vedimūle samālokya prāptamaṣṭakulaṃ nṛpa .. 81 ..
5.198.d:
नृत्यंति पितरस्तस्य गर्जंति च पितामहाः ..
वेदिमूले समालोक्य प्राप्तमष्टकुलं नृप .. 81 ..
5.198.m: His ancestors dance and his grandfathers roar, / seeing one of eight noble families arrived at the base of the altar, O king.

5.198.s:
punarvadaṃti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ kimasmākaṃ pradāsyati ..
dauhitraścāpasavyena jalaṃ darbhatilānvitam .. 82 ..
5.198.d:
पुनर्वदंति संहृष्टाः किमस्माकं प्रदास्यति ..
दौहित्रश्चापसव्येन जलं दर्भतिलान्वितम् .. 82 ..
5.198.m: Overjoyed, they say again: “What will the daughter’s son give us / with his sacred thread over the right shoulder—water with darbha grass and sesame seeds?”

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śraiṣṭhyamaṣṭakulodbhavam ..
sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ ca tatkiṃ vada mahāmate ..83..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं श्रैष्ठ्यमष्टकुलोद्भवम् ..
सर्वेषां नागराणां च तत्किं वद महामते ..83..
5.198.m:
The king said:
What is this pre-eminence of those born of the eight lineages
over all the Nāgaras that you have spoken of? Tell me that, O noble-minded one!

5.198.s: na hyatra kāraṇaṃ svalpaṃ bhaviṣyati dvijottama .. 84 ..
5.198.d: न ह्यत्र कारणं स्वल्पं भविष्यति द्विजोत्तम .. 84 ..
5.198.m: For surely the reason for this cannot be a small one, O best of the twice-born.

5.198.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahārāja yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ..
anye'pi nāgarāḥ saṃti vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ..85..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाराज यत्त्वया व्याहृतं वचः ..
अन्येऽपि नागराः संति वेदवेदांगपारगाः..85..
5.198.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
What you have said, O great king, is true.
There are other Nāgaras as well who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

5.198.s:
śrāddhārhā yajñayogyāśca kanyāyogyā viśeṣataḥ..
paraṃ te sthāpitā rājansvayamiṃdreṇa tatra ca .. 86 ..
5.198.d:
श्राद्धार्हा यज्ञयोग्याश्च कन्यायोग्या विशेषतः..
परं ते स्थापिता राजन्स्वयमिंद्रेण तत्र च .. 86 ..
5.198.m:
worthy of śrāddha, fit for sacrifices, and especially fit for taking brides.
Yet those [eight] were installed there, O king, by Indra himself

5.198.s:
pradhānatvena sarveṣāṃ nāgaraiścāpi kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
tena te gauravaṃ prāptāḥ sthānetraiva viśeṣataḥ .. 87 ..
5.198.d:
प्रधानत्वेन सर्वेषां नागरैश्चापि कृत्स्नशः ..
तेन ते गौरवं प्राप्ताः स्थानेत्रैव विशेषतः .. 87 ..
5.198.m:
as foremost among all [the brahmins], and by all the Nāgaras collectively.
Therefore they have attained respect, especially in this very place.

5.198.s:
tasmācchrūāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ viprai ścāṣṭakulodbhavaiḥ ..
aprāptau caiva teṣāṃ tu kāryaṃ nāgarasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 88 ..
5.198.d:
तस्माच्छ्रूआद्धं प्रकर्तव्यं विप्रै श्चाष्टकुलोद्भवैः ..
अप्राप्तौ चैव तेषां तु कार्यं नागरसंभवैः .. 88 ..
5.198.m:
Therefore a śrāddha should be performed with brahmins born of the eight lineages;
and if they are not obtained, it should be done with those born of Nāgara lineage,

5.198.s:
nānyasthānasamudbhūtaiścaturvedairapi dvijaiḥ ..
bhartṛyajñena maryādā kṛtā hyeṣā mahā tmanā .. 89 ..
5.198.d:
नान्यस्थानसमुद्भूतैश्चतुर्वेदैरपि द्विजैः ..
भर्तृयज्ञेन मर्यादा कृता ह्येषा महा त्मना .. 89 ..
5.198.m:
not with twice-born who come from other places, even if they know the four Vedas.
Indeed, this ordinance was established by the great-souled Bhartṛyajña:

5.198.s:
muktvā tu nāgaraṃ vipraṃ yo'nyenātra kariṣyati ..
śrāddhaṃ vā yadi vā yajñaṃ vyarthaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati ..6.199.90 ..
5.198.d:
मुक्त्वा तु नागरं विप्रं योऽन्येनात्र करिष्यति ..
श्राद्धं वा यदि वा यज्ञं व्यर्थं तस्य भविष्यति ..6.199.90 ..
5.198.m:
Whoever performs here a śrāddha or a sacrifice
excluding a Nāgara brahmin with any other, for him it will be fruitless.

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
saṃtyanye vividhā viprā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ ..
madhyadeśodbhavāḥ śāntāstathānye tīrthasaṃbhavāḥ .. 91 ..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
संत्यन्ये विविधा विप्रा वेदवेदांगपारगाः ..
मध्यदेशोद्भवाः शान्तास्तथान्ये तीर्थसंभवाः .. 91 ..
5.198.m:
The king said:
There are various other brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
peaceful ones born in the Madhyadeśa, as well as others born in tīrthas,

5.198.s:
bhartṛyajñena ye tyaktāḥ śrāddhe yajñe viśeṣataḥ ..
hīnāṃgāścādhikāṃgāśca dvirnagnāḥ śyāvadaṃtakāḥ .. 92 ..
5.198.d:
भर्तृयज्ञेन ये त्यक्ताः श्राद्धे यज्ञे विशेषतः ..
हीनांगाश्चाधिकांगाश्च द्विर्नग्नाः श्यावदंतकाः .. 92 ..
5.198.m:
who were rejected by Bhartṛyajña, especially in śrāddha and sacrifice;
and those who have defective limbs, redundant limbs, are twice naked, or have dark teeth,

5.198.s:
kunakhāḥ kuṣṭhasaṃyuktā mūrkhā api vigarhitāḥ ..
śrāddhārhāḥ sūcitāstena etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ vada .. 93 ..
5.198.d:
कुनखाः कुष्ठसंयुक्ता मूर्खा अपि विगर्हिताः ..
श्राद्धार्हाः सूचितास्तेन एतं मे संशयं वद .. 93 ..
5.198.m:
have diseased nails, are afflicted with leprosy, or are fools and contemptible,
were indicated by him as worthy of śrāddha. Resolve this doubt of mine!

5.198.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
kīrtayiṣye naravyāghra kāraṇāni bahūni ca ..
camatkārasya patnyāśca dānena patitā yataḥ.. 94 ..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
कीर्तयिष्ये नरव्याघ्र कारणानि बहूनि च ..
चमत्कारस्य पत्न्याश्च दानेन पतिता यतः.. 94 ..
5.198.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
I shall tell you, O tiger among men, the many reasons
why they became fallen through the gift of Camatkāra's wife,

5.198.s:
strīṇāṃ pratigraheṇaiva vipreṣu proṣiteṣu ca ..
pṛthaktvaṃ ca tato jātaṃ bāhyābhyantarasaṃjñakam .. 95 ..
5.198.d:
स्त्रीणां प्रतिग्रहेणैव विप्रेषु प्रोषितेषु च ..
पृथक्त्वं च ततो जातं बाह्याभ्यन्तरसंज्ञकम् .. 95 ..
5.198.m:
and through the acceptance [of gifts] by women while the brahmins were abroad,
from which arose a division designated as outer and inner.

5.198.s:
durvāsasā tataḥ śaptā ruṣṭenevāhinā yathā ..
vidyādhanābhimānena śāpena patitāḥ sadā .. 96 ..
5.198.d:
दुर्वाससा ततः शप्ता रुष्टेनेवाहिना यथा ..
विद्याधनाभिमानेन शापेन पतिताः सदा .. 96 ..
5.198.m:
Then, cursed by Durvāsas as if by an angry serpent,
they were permanently fallen through his curse on account of their pride in learning and wealth.

5.198.s:
kuśe rājyagate rājanrākṣasānāṃ mahābhayam ..
prajayā''veditaṃ sarvaṃ tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ .. 97 ..
5.198.d:
कुशे राज्यगते राजन्राक्षसानां महाभयम् ..
प्रजया'ऽवेदितं सर्वं तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः .. 97 ..
5.198.m:
When Kuśa came to the throne, O king, a great fear of rākṣasas
was reported entirely by the subjects to that great-souled king.

5.198.s:
vibhīṣaṇasya laṃkāyāṃ dūtaśca preṣitastadā ..
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prajānāṃ bhayasaṃbhavam .. 98 ..
5.198.d:
विभीषणस्य लंकायां दूतश्च प्रेषितस्तदा ..
सर्वं निवेदयामास प्रजानां भयसंभवम् .. 98 ..
5.198.m:
A messenger was then sent to Vibhīṣaṇa in Laṅkā,
and he made known all the fear that had arisen among the people.

5.198.s:
abhivandya kuśādeśaṃ rāmasya caritaṃ smaran ..
puryāṃ vilokayāmāsa laṅkāyāṃ rāmaśāsanāt .. 99 ..
5.198.d:
अभिवन्द्य कुशादेशं रामस्य चरितं स्मरन् ..
पुर्यां विलोकयामास लङ्कायां रामशासनात् .. 99 ..
5.198.m:
Paying homage to Kuśa's command and remembering Rāma's conduct,
[Vibhīṣaṇa] inspected [the matter] in the city of Laṅkā by Rāma's authority.

5.198.s:
upaplavasya kartāro naṣṭāḥ sarve diśo daśa ..
gandharvāṇāṃ ca lokaṃ hi bhayena mahatā gatāḥ .. 6.199.100 ..
5.198.d:
उपप्लवस्य कर्तारो नष्टाः सर्वे दिशो दश ..
गन्धर्वाणां च लोकं हि भयेन महता गताः .. 6.199.100 ..
5.198.m:
The perpetrators of the affliction fled in all ten directions;
in great fear, they went to the world of the gandharvas.

5.198.s:
sthātuṃ tatra na śaktāste vibhīṣaṇabhayena ca ..
pṛthivyāṃ samanuprāptāḥ sthānānyapi bahūni ca .. 101 ..
5.198.d:
स्थातुं तत्र न शक्तास्ते विभीषणभयेन च ..
पृथिव्यां समनुप्राप्ताः स्थानान्यपि बहूनि च .. 101 ..
5.198.m:
Unable to stay there because of the fear of Vibhīṣaṇa,
they arrived on earth and [spread to] many places.

5.198.s:
bhayena mahatā tatra kuśasyaiva tu śāsane ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rūpāṇi kṛtvā tatra samāgatāḥ .. 102 ..
5.198.d:
भयेन महता तत्र कुशस्यैव तु शासने ..
ब्राह्मणानां च रूपाणि कृत्वा तत्र समागताः .. 102 ..
5.198.m:
Out of great fear, in the realm under Kuśa's rule,
they assumed the forms of brahmins and came there.

5.198.s:
vāḍavānāṃ mahimnā ca madhye sthātuṃ na te'śakan ..
patitānāṃ ca saṃsthānaṃ camatkārapuraṃ gatāḥ .. 103 ..
5.198.d:
वाडवानां महिम्ना च मध्ये स्थातुं न तेऽशकन् ..
पतितानां च संस्थानं चमत्कारपुरं गताः .. 103 ..
5.198.m:
Unable to remain among [the faithful] because of the glory of the brahmins,
they went to Camatkārapura, the dwelling-place of the fallen.

5.198.s:
māyāviśāradaistaiśca dhanena vidyayā tataḥ ..
adha jagdhaṃ tatastaistu teṣāṃ madhye sthitaṃ ca taiḥ .. 104 ..
5.198.d:
मायाविशारदैस्तैश्च धनेन विद्यया ततः ..
अध जग्धं ततस्तैस्तु तेषां मध्ये स्थितं च तैः .. 104 ..
5.198.m:
Skilled in deception, by means of wealth and learning,
they consumed food together and dwelt among them.

5.198.s:
tataḥprabhṛti te sarve rākṣasatvaṃ prapedire ..
krūrāṇyapi ca karmāṇi kurvaṃti ca padepade .. 105 ..
5.198.d:
ततःप्रभृति ते सर्वे राक्षसत्वं प्रपेदिरे ..
क्रूराण्यपि च कर्माणि कुर्वंति च पदेपदे .. 105 ..
5.198.m:
From then on, they all assumed the nature of rākṣasas
and committed cruel deeds at every step.

5.198.s:
tataste sarvathā rājanvarjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ ..
śrāddhe yajñe naravyāghra narake pātayaṃti ca .. .. 106 ..
5.198.d:
ततस्ते सर्वथा राजन्वर्जनीयाः प्रयत्नतः ..
श्राद्धे यज्ञे नरव्याघ्र नरके पातयंति च .. .. 106 ..
5.198.m:
Therefore, O king, tiger among men, they must be avoided in every way
at a śrāddha and a sacrifice; they cause one to fall into hell.

5.198.s:
anyacca dūṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ kīrtayiṣye tavā'nagha ..
trijātāḥ sthāpitā rājansarpāṇāṃ garanāśanāt .. 107 ..
5.198.d:
अन्यच्च दूषणं तेषां कीर्तयिष्ये तवाऽनघ ..
त्रिजाताः स्थापिता राजन्सर्पाणां गरनाशनात् .. 107 ..
5.198.m:
I shall mention another fault of theirs to you, O sinless one:
They were established as of threefold birth, O king, for destroying the poison of serpents.

5.198.s:
nagaratvaṃ tato jātaṃ camatkāra purasya tu ..
trijātatvaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jātaṃ tatra viśeṣataḥ .. 108 ..
5.198.d:
नगरत्वं ततो जातं चमत्कार पुरस्य तु ..
त्रिजातत्वं तु सर्वेषां जातं तत्र विशेषतः .. 108 ..
5.198.m:
Thence Camatkārapura attained its status as a city,
and all of them there especially came to have a threefold birth.

5.198.s:
etebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyaśca bhartṛyajñena varjitāḥ ..
punaśca kāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ sparśādapi na śuddhibhāk .. 109 ..
5.198.d:
एतेभ्यः कारणेभ्यश्च भर्तृयज्ञेन वर्जिताः ..
पुनश्च कारणं तेषां स्पर्शादपि न शुद्धिभाक् .. 109 ..
5.198.m:
For these reasons they were avoided by Bhartṛyajña.
And there is yet another reason: even by their touch one does not attain purity,

5.198.s: kumbhakotthaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ mahaccaṇḍālasaṃbhavam .. 6.199.110 ..
5.198.d: कुम्भकोत्थं च संप्राप्तं महच्चण्डालसंभवम् .. 6.199.110 ..
5.198.m: and [the fault] stemming from Kumbhaka, originating from a great caṇḍāla, was incurred.

5.198.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
etacca kāraṇaṃ vipra kathayasva prasādataḥ ..
sthāvarasya carasyaiva jagato jñānamasti te .. 111 ..
5.198.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
एतच्च कारणं विप्र कथयस्व प्रसादतः ..
स्थावरस्य चरस्यैव जगतो ज्ञानमस्ति ते .. 111 ..

5.198.s:
