.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttakathāṃtaram ..
bhartṛyajena ye tyaktāḥ sarvenye brāhmaṇottamāḥ .. 112 ..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि पूर्ववृत्तकथांतरम् ..
भर्तृयजेन ये त्यक्ताः सर्वेन्ये ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः .. 112 ..
5.198.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
In this regard I will narrate to you another tale of past events,
concerning why all those other best brahmins were rejected by Bhartṛyajña.

5.198.s:
vardhamāne pure pūrvamāsīdaṃtyajajātijaḥ ..
caṇḍālaḥ kuṃbhakonāma nirdayaḥ pāpakarmakṛt .. 113 ..
5.198.d:
वर्धमाने पुरे पूर्वमासीदंत्यजजातिजः ..
चण्डालः कुंभकोनाम निर्दयः पापकर्मकृत् .. 113 ..
5.198.m:
Formerly, in the city of Vardhamāna, there was a man born of an outcaste class,
a caṇḍāla named Kumbhaka, pitiless and a committer of sinful deeds.

5.198.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tasya putro babhūva ha ..
virūpasyāpi rūpāḍhyaḥ pūrvakarmaprabhāvataḥ .. 114 ..
5.198.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तस्य पुत्रो बभूव ह ..
विरूपस्यापि रूपाढ्यः पूर्वकर्मप्रभावतः .. 114 ..
5.198.m:
After some time, a son was born to him;
though [the father] was deformed, [the son] was endowed with beauty by the power of past deeds.

5.198.s:
piṃgākṣasya sukṛṣṇasya vayomadhyasya pārthiva ..
dakṣaḥ sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 115 ..
5.198.d:
पिंगाक्षस्य सुकृष्णस्य वयोमध्यस्य पार्थिव ..
दक्षः सर्वेषु कृत्येषु सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः .. 115 ..
5.198.m:
To him who had reddish-brown eyes, was very black, and was in middle age, O ruler of the earth,
[was born a son] capable in all tasks and endowed with all auspicious marks.

5.198.s:
sa vṛddhiṃ drutamabhyeti śuklapakṣe yathoḍurāṭ ..
tathā'sau śaṃsyamānastu sarvalokaiḥ surūpabhāk ..
dṛṣṭvā kuṭuṃbakaṃ nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..116..
5.198.d:
स वृद्धिं द्रुतमभ्येति शुक्लपक्षे यथोडुराट् ..
तथाऽसौ शंस्यमानस्तु सर्वलोकैः सुरूपभाक् ..
दृष्ट्वा कुटुंबकं नित्यं वैराग्यं परमं गतः ..116..

5.198.s:
tato deśāṃtaraṃ duḥkhādbhramamāṇa itastataḥ ..
camatkārapuraṃ prāpto dvijarūpaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
sa snāti sarvakṛtyeṣu bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ .. 117 ..
5.198.d:
ततो देशांतरं दुःखाद्भ्रममाण इतस्ततः ..
चमत्कारपुरं प्राप्तो द्विजरूपं समाश्रितः ..
स स्नाति सर्वकृत्येषु भिक्षान्नकृतभोजनः .. 117 ..
5.198.m:
Then, wandering here and there out of sorrow into another country,
he reached Camatkārapura, having assumed the form of a twice-born.
He took ritual ablutions before all rites, eating only food gathered as alms.

5.198.s:
etasminneva kāle tu brāhmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ ..
chāṃdogyagotravikhyātaḥ subhadronāma pārthivaḥ .. 118 ..
5.198.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ब्राह्मणः शंसितव्रतः ..
छांदोग्यगोत्रविख्यातः सुभद्रोनाम पार्थिवः .. 118 ..
5.198.m:
At that very time, there was a brahmin celebrated for his vows,
renowned in the Chāndogya lineage, named Subhadra, O ruler of the earth.

5.198.s:
nāgaro varṣayājī ca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ..
tatrāsīttasya sañjātā kanyakā dviguṇai radaiḥ .. 119 ..
5.198.d:
नागरो वर्षयाजी च वेदवेदांगपारगः ..
तत्रासीत्तस्य सञ्जाता कन्यका द्विगुणै रदैः .. 119 ..
5.198.m:
A Nāgara who sacrificed every year and had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
he lived there; and a daughter was born to him with a double row of teeth,

5.198.s:
tathā tribhiḥstanai raudrā pṛṣṭhyāvartakasaṃyutā ..
daridro'pi suduḥstho'pi kulahīnopi pārthiva..6.199.120...
5.198.d:
तथा त्रिभिःस्तनै रौद्रा पृष्ठ्यावर्तकसंयुता ..
दरिद्रोऽपि सुदुःस्थोऽपि कुलहीनोपि पार्थिव..6.199.120...
5.198.m:
and likewise dreadful with three breasts and possessed of a whorl of hair upon her back.
Though [a suitor might be] poor, in great distress, or base-born, O ruler of the earth,

5.198.s:
dīyamānāmapi na tāṃ pratigṛhṇāti kaścana ..
yadbhakṣayati bhartāraṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare hi sā ..121..
5.198.d:
दीयमानामपि न तां प्रतिगृह्णाति कश्चन ..
यद्भक्षयति भर्तारं षण्मासाभ्यंतरे हि सा ..121..
5.198.m:
no one would accept her even when offered;
for she would devour her husband within six months!

5.198.s:
yasyāḥ syurdviguṇā daṃtā evaṃ sāmudrikā jaguḥ ..
tristanī kanyakā yā tu śvaśurasya kulakṣayam ..
saṃdhatte nātra sandehastasmāttāṃ dūratastyajet ..122..
5.198.d:
यस्याः स्युर्द्विगुणा दंता एवं सामुद्रिका जगुः ..
त्रिस्तनी कन्यका या तु श्वशुरस्य कुलक्षयम् ..
संधत्ते नात्र सन्देहस्तस्मात्तां दूरतस्त्यजेत् ..122..
5.198.m:
A woman who has double teeth—thus have the physiognomists declared—
and a maiden with three breasts brings about the destruction of her father-in-law's family,
there is no doubt about this; therefore one should abandon her from afar.

5.198.s:
pṛṣṭhyāvarto bhavedyasyā asatī sā bhaveddrutam ..
bahupāpasamācārā tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet .. 123 ..
5.198.d:
पृष्ठ्यावर्तो भवेद्यस्या असती सा भवेद्द्रुतम् ..
बहुपापसमाचारा तस्मात्तां परिवर्जयेत् .. 123 ..
5.198.m:
A woman who has a whorl of hair upon her back will quickly become unchaste,
practising many sins; therefore one should avoid her.

5.198.s:
atha tāṃ vṛddhimāpannāṃ dṛṣṭvā vipraḥ subhadrakaḥ ..
cintācakraṃ samārūḍho na śāṃtimadhigacchati .. 124 ..
5.198.d:
अथ तां वृद्धिमापन्नां दृष्ट्वा विप्रः सुभद्रकः ..
चिन्ताचक्रं समारूढो न शांतिमधिगच्छति .. 124 ..
5.198.m:
Now, seeing her grown to maturity, the brahmin Subhadra
mounted a wheel of anxiety and found no peace.

5.198.s:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathamasyāḥ patirbhavet ..
na kaścitpratigṛhṇāti prārthito'pi muhurmuhuḥ .. 125 ..
5.198.d:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथमस्याः पतिर्भवेत् ..
न कश्चित्प्रतिगृह्णाति प्रार्थितोऽपि मुहुर्मुहुः .. 125 ..
5.198.m: “What shall I do? Where shall I go? How will she get a husband? / Even though asked again and again, no one accepts her.

5.198.s:
daridro vyādhito vā'pi vṛddho'pi brāhmaṇo hi saḥ ..
smṛtau yasmādidaṃ proktaṃ kanyārthe prāṅmaharṣibhiḥ .. 126 ..
5.198.d:
दरिद्रो व्याधितो वाऽपि वृद्धोऽपि ब्राह्मणो हि सः ..
स्मृतौ यस्मादिदं प्रोक्तं कन्यार्थे प्राङ्महर्षिभिः .. 126 ..
5.198.m: [Whether] poor, diseased, or even old, as long as he is a brahmin; / for this was declared in the smṛti by the great seers of old regarding a maiden:

5.198.s:
aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā ca rohiṇī ..
daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā .. 127 ..
5.198.d:
अष्टवर्षा भवेद्गौरी नववर्षा च रोहिणी ..
दशवर्षा भवेत्कन्या अत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला .. 127 ..
5.198.m: ‘At eight years she is Gaurī, and at nine years she is Rohiṇī; / at ten years she is a maiden (kanyā), and beyond that she is a menstruating woman (rajasvalā).

5.198.s:
mātā caiva pitā caiva jyeṣṭho bhrātā tathaiva ca ..
trayaste narakaṃ yāṃti dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ rajasvalām .. 128 ..
5.198.d:
माता चैव पिता चैव ज्येष्ठो भ्राता तथैव च ..
त्रयस्ते नरकं यांति दृष्ट्वा कन्यां रजस्वलाम् .. 128 ..
5.198.m: Mother, father, and likewise the eldest brother— / all three go to hell upon seeing a maiden become a rajasvalā.’ ”

5.198.s:
evaṃ cintayatastasya soṃ'tyajo dvijarūpadhṛk ..
bhikṣārthaṃ tadgṛhaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭastena mahātmanā .. 129 ..
5.198.d:
एवं चिन्तयतस्तस्य सोंऽत्यजो द्विजरूपधृक् ..
भिक्षार्थं तद्गृहं प्राप्तो दृष्टस्तेन महात्मना .. 129 ..
5.198.m: While he was thinking thus, that outcaste (antyaja), wearing the form of a twice-born, / arrived at his house to beg for alms, and was seen by that noble man.

5.198.s:
pṛṣṭaśca vismayāttena dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ tathāvidham ..
kutastvamiha samprāptaḥ kva yāsyasi ca bhikṣuka .. 6.199.130 ..
5.198.d:
पृष्टश्च विस्मयात्तेन दृष्ट्वा रूपं तथाविधम् ..
कुतस्त्वमिह सम्प्राप्तः क्व यास्यसि च भिक्षुक .. 6.199.130 ..
5.198.m: And seeing such an appearance, he asked him out of wonder: / “Whence have you arrived here, and where will you go, mendicant?

5.198.s:
īdṛgbhavyataro bhūtvā kasmānmādhukarīṃ gataḥ ..
kiṃ gotraṃ tava me brūhi katamaḥ pravaraśca te .. 131 ..
5.198.d:
ईदृग्भव्यतरो भूत्वा कस्मान्माधुकरीं गतः ..
किं गोत्रं तव मे ब्रूहि कतमः प्रवरश्च ते .. 131 ..
5.198.m: Being so very handsome, why have you resorted to collecting alms? / Tell me, what is your lineage (gotra), and which is your ancestral lineage (pravara)?”

5.198.s:
so'bravīdgauḍadeśīyaṃ sthānaṃ me sumahattaram ..
nāmnā bhojakaṭaṃ khyātaṃ nānādvijasamāśritam .. 132 ..
5.198.d:
सोऽब्रवीद्गौडदेशीयं स्थानं मे सुमहत्तरम् ..
नाम्ना भोजकटं ख्यातं नानाद्विजसमाश्रितम् .. 132 ..
5.198.m: He said: “My very eminent dwelling place is in the Gauḍa country, / renowned by the name Bhojakaṭa, inhabited by various twice-born.

5.198.s:
tatrāsīnmādhavonāma brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ ..
vasiṣṭhagotravikhyāta ekapravarasūcitaḥ .. .. 133 ..
5.198.d:
तत्रासीन्माधवोनाम ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः ..
वसिष्ठगोत्रविख्यात एकप्रवरसूचितः .. .. 133 ..
5.198.m: There was a brahmin named Mādhava, who had mastered the Vedas, / renowned in the Vasiṣṭha gotra, distinguished by a single pravara.

5.198.s: tasyāhaṃ tanayo nāmnā caṃdraprabha iti smṛtaḥ .. 134 ..
5.198.d: तस्याहं तनयो नाम्ना चंद्रप्रभ इति स्मृतः .. 134 ..
5.198.m: I am his son, known by the name Candraprabha.

5.198.s:
tato'hamaṣṭame varṣe yadā vratadharaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tadā paṃcatvamāpannaḥ pitā me vedapāragaḥ .. 135 ..
5.198.d:
ततोऽहमष्टमे वर्षे यदा व्रतधरः स्थितः ..
तदा पंचत्वमापन्नः पिता मे वेदपारगः .. 135 ..
5.198.m: Then, when in my eighth year I was observing my vow [of studenthood], / my father, the master of the Vedas, met his death.

5.198.s:
mātā me saha tenaiva praviṣṭā havyavāhanam ..
tato vairāgyamāpanno niṣkrāṃto'haṃ nijālayāt .. 136 ..
5.198.d:
माता मे सह तेनैव प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम् ..
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नो निष्क्रांतोऽहं निजालयात् .. 136 ..
5.198.m: My mother entered the fire together with him. / Then, overcome with dispassion, I departed from my own home.

5.198.s:
tīrthāni bhramamāṇo'tra saṃprāptastu puraṃ tava ..
adhunā saṃprayāsyāmi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam .. 137 ..
5.198.d:
तीर्थानि भ्रममाणोऽत्र संप्राप्तस्तु पुरं तव ..
अधुना संप्रयास्यामि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 137 ..
5.198.m: Wandering among sacred fords, I arrived here at your city. / Now I will proceed to Prabhāsa, the supreme sacred field,

5.198.s:
yatra someśvaro devastyaktvā kailāsamāgataḥ ..
na mayā paṭhitā vedā na ca śāstraṃ nṛpottama..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tena bhikṣāṃ carāmyaham .. 138 ..
5.198.d:
यत्र सोमेश्वरो देवस्त्यक्त्वा कैलासमागतः ..
न मया पठिता वेदा न च शास्त्रं नृपोत्तम..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन तेन भिक्षां चराम्यहम् .. 138 ..
5.198.m: where Lord Someśvara came after leaving Kailāsa. / I have not studied the Vedas, nor the scriptures, O best of kings; / for the purpose of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, therefore, I wander for alms.”

5.198.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa cetasi ..
brāhmaṇo'yaṃ sudeśīyastathā bhavyatamākṛtiḥ ..
yadi gṛhṇāti me kanyāṃ tadasmai pradadāmyaham .. 139 ..
5.198.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिन्तयामास चेतसि ..
ब्राह्मणोऽयं सुदेशीयस्तथा भव्यतमाकृतिः ..
यदि गृह्णाति मे कन्यां तदस्मै प्रददाम्यहम् .. 139 ..
5.198.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Hearing that speech of his, he reflected in his mind: / “This brahmin is from a good country, and his appearance is very handsome. / If he will accept my daughter, then I shall give [her] to him,

5.198.s:
yāvadrajasvalā naiva jāyate sā nirūpitā ..
kṛtsnaṃ dūṣayati kṣipraṃ naiva vaṃśaṃ mamādhamā .. 6.199.140 ..
5.198.d:
यावद्रजस्वला नैव जायते सा निरूपिता ..
कृत्स्नं दूषयति क्षिप्रं नैव वंशं ममाधमा .. 6.199.140 ..
5.198.m: so long as she is not yet seen to have become a rajasvalā, / lest that base girl quickly disgrace my entire family.”

5.198.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ mlecchaṃ saṃmaṃtrya saha bhāryayā ..
yadi gṛhṇāsi me kanyāṃ tava yacchāmyahaṃ dvija .. 141 ..
5.198.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं म्लेच्छं संमंत्र्य सह भार्यया ..
यदि गृह्णासि मे कन्यां तव यच्छाम्यहं द्विज .. 141 ..
5.198.m: Then, having deliberated with his wife, he said to that outcaste: / “If you will accept my daughter, O twice-born, I shall give [her] to you.

5.198.s: bharaṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ kariṣyāmi sadaiva hi ..142..
5.198.d: भरणं पोषणं द्वाभ्यां करिष्यामि सदैव हि ..142..
5.198.m: I will indeed provide maintenance and nourishment for both of you at all times.”

5.198.s:
tacchrutvā harṣitaḥ prāha soṃ'tyajo nṛpasattamam ..
tavādeśaṃ kariṣyāmi yaccha me kanyakāṃ nṛpa .. 143 ..
5.198.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा हर्षितः प्राह सोंऽत्यजो नृपसत्तमम् ..
तवादेशं करिष्यामि यच्छ मे कन्यकां नृप .. 143 ..
5.198.m: Hearing that, delighted, the outcaste said to the best of kings: / “I will carry out your command; give me your daughter, O king.”

5.198.s:
tathetyuktvā gatastena tasmai dattā nijā sutā ..
gṛhyoktena vidhānena vivāho vihitastataḥ .. 144 ..
5.198.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा गतस्तेन तस्मै दत्ता निजा सुता ..
गृह्योक्तेन विधानेन विवाहो विहितस्ततः .. 144 ..
5.198.m: Having said “So be it,” he went and gave his own daughter to him; / then the wedding was performed according to the rule prescribed in the Gṛhya texts.

5.198.s:
tato dadau dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ kṣetraṃ ca godhanam ..
tasmai tuṣṭisamāyukto manyamānaḥ kṛtārthatām .. 145 ..
5.198.d:
ततो ददौ धनं धान्यं गृहं क्षेत्रं च गोधनम् ..
तस्मै तुष्टिसमायुक्तो मन्यमानः कृतार्थताम् .. 145 ..
5.198.m: Then, filled with satisfaction and considering himself to have achieved his purpose, / he gave him wealth, grain, a house, a field, and wealth in cattle.

5.198.s:
atha so'pi ca tāṃ prāpya vilāsānakarodbahūn ..
khādyaiḥ pānaiḥ suvastraiśca gandhamālyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 146 ..
5.198.d:
अथ सोऽपि च तां प्राप्य विलासानकरोद्बहून् ..
खाद्यैः पानैः सुवस्त्रैश्च गन्धमाल्यैर्विभूषणैः .. 146 ..
5.198.m: Then he too, having obtained her, indulged in many pleasures, / with foods, drinks, fine garments, perfumes, garlands, and ornaments.

5.198.s:
paraṃ sa vrajati prāyo yena mārgeṇa kenacit ..
sārameyāḥ saśabdāśca pṛṣṭhato'nuvrajaṃti vai .. 147 ..
5.198.d:
परं स व्रजति प्रायो येन मार्गेण केनचित् ..
सारमेयाः सशब्दाश्च पृष्ठतोऽनुव्रजंति वै .. 147 ..
5.198.m: Yet along whatever path he generally walked, / barking dogs followed behind him,

5.198.s:
anyeṣāmaṃtyajātyānāṃ yadvattasya viśeṣataḥ ..
vedābhyāsaparaścaiva yadi saṃjāyate kvacit ..
raktaṃ patati vaktreṇa tatkṣaṇāttasya durmateḥ .. 148 ..
5.198.d:
अन्येषामंत्यजात्यानां यद्वत्तस्य विशेषतः ..
वेदाभ्यासपरश्चैव यदि संजायते क्वचित् ..
रक्तं पतति वक्त्रेण तत्क्षणात्तस्य दुर्मतेः .. 148 ..
5.198.m: just as [they do] to other outcastes, and especially to him. / And if ever he engaged in the study of the Veda, / blood immediately fell from the mouth of that evil-minded one.

5.198.s:
etasminnaṃtare lokaḥ sarva eva praśaṃkitaḥ ..
abravīcca mitho'bhyetya caṃḍālo'yamasaṃśayam .. 149 ..
5.198.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे लोकः सर्व एव प्रशंकितः ..
अब्रवीच्च मिथोऽभ्येत्य चंडालोऽयमसंशयम् .. 149 ..
5.198.m: Meanwhile, all the people became suspicious, / and approaching one another, they said: “This man is undoubtedly a caṇḍāla,

5.198.s:
yadete pṛṣṭhato yāṃti bhaṣamāṇāḥ śunīsutāḥ ..
subhadro'pi ca tatteṣāṃ śrutvā cintāparo'bhavat .. 6.199.150 ..
5.198.d:
यदेते पृष्ठतो यांति भषमाणाः शुनीसुताः ..
सुभद्रोऽपि च तत्तेषां श्रुत्वा चिन्तापरोऽभवत् .. 6.199.150 ..
5.198.m: since these sons of bitches follow behind [him] barking.” / Subhadra too, hearing that [talk] of theirs, became filled with anxiety.

5.198.s:
manyamānaśca tatsatyaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ ..
nūnamaṃtyajajātīyo bhaviṣyati sutāpatiḥ .. 151 ..
5.198.d:
मन्यमानश्च तत्सत्यं दुःखेन महतान्वितः ..
नूनमंत्यजजातीयो भविष्यति सुतापतिः .. 151 ..
5.198.m: Considering that to be true, filled with great sorrow, [he thought]: / “Surely my daughter's husband must be of the outcaste class.

5.198.s: jñāyate ceṣṭitaiḥ sarvairyathā'yaṃ jalpate janaḥ .. 152 ..
5.198.d: ज्ञायते चेष्टितैः सर्वैर्यथाऽयं जल्पते जनः .. 152 ..
5.198.m: It is known by all his actions, just as the people say.”

5.198.s:
evaṃ rātriṃdivaṃ tasya cintayānasya bhūpateḥ ..
lokāpavādayuktasya kiyānkālo'bhyavartata .. 153 ..
5.198.d:
एवं रात्रिंदिवं तस्य चिन्तयानस्य भूपतेः ..
लोकापवादयुक्तस्य कियान्कालोऽभ्यवर्तत .. 153 ..
5.198.m: Thus, while that king, subject to public scandal, / was worrying day and night, some time passed.

5.198.s:
anyasminnahani prāpte ādyādyā dvijasattamāḥ ..
madhyagena samāyuktā brahmasthānaṃ samāgatāḥ ..
tasya śuddhikṛte procuryena śaṃkā praṇaśyati .. 154 ..
5.198.d:
अन्यस्मिन्नहनि प्राप्ते आद्याद्या द्विजसत्तमाः ..
मध्यगेन समायुक्ता ब्रह्मस्थानं समागताः ..
तस्य शुद्धिकृते प्रोचुर्येन शंका प्रणश्यति .. 154 ..
5.198.m: When another day arrived, the foremost twice-born sages, / accompanied by an arbiter, came to the Brahmasthāna; / for the sake of his purification, they spoke so that doubt might be destroyed.

5.198.s:
athocustaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā brahmasthānasya madhyagam ..
madhyagasya tu vaktreṇa vivarṇavadanaṃ sthitam .. 155 ..
5.198.d:
अथोचुस्तं द्विजश्रेष्ठा ब्रह्मस्थानस्य मध्यगम् ..
मध्यगस्य तु वक्त्रेण विवर्णवदनं स्थितम् .. 155 ..
5.198.m: Then the best of the twice-born said to him who stood before the arbiter of the Brahmasthāna, / who stood with a pale face spoken to by the arbiter:

5.198.s:
kulaṃ gotraṃ nijaṃ brūhi pravarāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ..
sthānaṃ deśaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ yena śuddhiḥ pradīyate .. 156 ..
5.198.d:
कुलं गोत्रं निजं ब्रूहि प्रवरांश्च विशेषतः ..
स्थानं देशं च विप्राणां येन शुद्धिः प्रदीयते .. 156 ..
5.198.m: “State your family, your gotra, and especially your pravaras, / and the dwelling place and country of the brahmins, so that purification may be granted.”

5.198.s:
athāsau vepamānastu prasvinnavadanastathā ..
adhodṛṣṭiruvācedaṃ gadgadaṃ vihitāñjaliḥ .. 157 ..
5.198.d:
अथासौ वेपमानस्तु प्रस्विन्नवदनस्तथा ..
अधोदृष्टिरुवाचेदं गद्गदं विहिताञ्जलिः .. 157 ..
5.198.m: Then he, trembling, with a sweating face / and downcast eyes, with joined palms, said this in a faltering voice:

5.198.s:
garbhāṣṭame pitā mahyaṃ varṣe mṛtyuṃ gatastataḥ ..
tataḥ sā taṃ samādāya jananī me pativratā ..
māṃ tyaktvā duḥkhitaṃ dīnaṃ praviṣṭā havyavāhanam .. 158 ..
5.198.d:
गर्भाष्टमे पिता मह्यं वर्षे मृत्युं गतस्ततः ..
ततः सा तं समादाय जननी मे पतिव्रता ..
मां त्यक्त्वा दुःखितं दीनं प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहनम् .. 158 ..
5.198.m: “In the eighth year from my conception my father met his death. / Then my devoted mother, taking him [in her lap] / and abandoning me, afflicted and wretched, entered the fire.

5.198.s:
ahaṃ vairāgyamāpannastīrthayātrāṃ samāśritaḥ ..
bālabhāve piturduḥkhāttāpasairaparaiḥ saha .. 159 ..
5.198.d:
अहं वैराग्यमापन्नस्तीर्थयात्रां समाश्रितः ..
बालभावे पितुर्दुःखात्तापसैरपरैः सह .. 159 ..
5.198.m: Overcome with dispassion in my childhood out of grief for my father, / I undertook a pilgrimage to sacred fords along with other ascetics.

5.198.s:
na mayā paṭhito vedo na ca śāstraṃ nirūpitam..
tīrthayātrāparo'haṃ ca samāyāto bhavatpuram .. 6.199.160
abhadreṇa subhadreṇa śvaśureṇa durātmanā ..
etajjānāmyahaṃ viprā gotraṃ vāsiṣṭhameva vā .. 161 ..
5.198.d:
न मया पठितो वेदो न च शास्त्रं निरूपितम्..
तीर्थयात्रापरोऽहं च समायातो भवत्पुरम् .. 6.199.160
अभद्रेण सुभद्रेण श्वशुरेण दुरात्मना ..
एतज्जानाम्यहं विप्रा गोत्रं वासिष्ठमेव वा .. 161 ..
5.198.m: I did not study the Veda, nor have I examined the scriptures. / Dedicated to pilgrimages to sacred fords, I arrived at your city, / [taken in] by my father-in-law, the base-minded Subhadra, who is [in truth] un-auspicious (abhadra). / This [much] I know, O brahmins: either [my] gotra is indeed Vāsiṣṭha,

5.198.s:
athaikapravaro deśo gauḍo madhupuraṃ puram ..
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ procuryasya no jñāyate kulam ..
tasya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā dhaṭadvāreṇa kevalā ..162..
5.198.d:
अथैकप्रवरो देशो गौडो मधुपुरं पुरम् ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः प्रोचुर्यस्य नो ज्ञायते कुलम् ..
तस्य शुद्धिः प्रदातव्या धटद्वारेण केवला ..162..
5.198.m: and with one pravara, [my] country is Gauḍa, and [my] city is Madhupura.” / Then those brahmins said: “He whose lineage is not known, / to him purification must be granted solely by means of the balance (dhaṭa).

5.198.s:
sa tvaṃ dhaṭaṃ samāruhya brāhmaṇyārthaṃ ca kevalam ..
śuddhiṃ prāpya tato bhogānbhuṃkṣvātrastho'pi kevalam .. 163 ..
5.198.d:
स त्वं धटं समारुह्य ब्राह्मण्यार्थं च केवलम् ..
शुद्धिं प्राप्य ततो भोगान्भुंक्ष्वात्रस्थोऽपि केवलम् .. 163 ..
5.198.m: Therefore, having mounted the balance solely for the sake of brahminhood, / and having thereby obtained purification, then enjoy pleasures, remaining right here.”

5.198.s:
so'bravītsāhasaṃ kṛtvā sarvāneva ddvijottamān ..
pratigṛhṇāmyahaṃ kāmaṃ taptamāṣakameva ca..164..
5.198.d:
सोऽब्रवीत्साहसं कृत्वा सर्वानेव द्द्विजोत्तमान् ..
प्रतिगृह्णाम्यहं कामं तप्तमाषकमेव च..164..
5.198.m: Gathering courage, he said to all the best twice-born: / “I will willingly accept even the heated coin (taptamāṣaka),

5.198.s: praviśāmi hutāśaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ viṣam..165..
5.198.d: प्रविशामि हुताशं वा भक्षयिष्याम्यहं विषम्..165..
5.198.m: or I will enter fire, or I will consume poison.

5.198.s:
kiṃ punardhaṭadivyaṃ ca kriyamāṇe sukhāvaham ..
brāhmaṇasya kṛte viprāścitte no māmake ghṛṇā .. 166 ..
5.198.d:
किं पुनर्धटदिव्यं च क्रियमाणे सुखावहम् ..
ब्राह्मणस्य कृते विप्राश्चित्ते नो मामके घृणा .. 166 ..
5.198.m: How much more the ordeal of the balance (dhaṭadivya), which brings ease when performed! / For the sake of brahminhood, O brahmins, there is no aversion in my mind.”

5.198.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāstasya dhaṭārohaṇasaṃbhavam ..
śuddhiṃ nirdiśya vāraṃ ca sūryasya ca tataḥ param ..
jagmuḥ svaṃsvaṃ gṛhaṃ sarve so'pi viproṃ'tyajo dvijāḥ .. 167 ..
5.198.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणास्तस्य धटारोहणसंभवम् ..
शुद्धिं निर्दिश्य वारं च सूर्यस्य च ततः परम् ..
जग्मुः स्वंस्वं गृहं सर्वे सोऽपि विप्रोंऽत्यजो द्विजाः .. 167 ..
5.198.m: Then those brahmins, having prescribed his purification / through the balance ordeal on a Sunday after that, / all went to their respective homes; and that outcast [posing as a] brahmin also went [home], O twice-born ones.

5.198.s:
tataḥ prāha nijāṃ bhāryāṃ rahasye nṛpasattama..
jñāto'haṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvairaṃtyajātisamudbhavaḥ ..
deśātaraṃ gamiṣyāmi tvamāgaccha mayā saha .. 168 ..
5.198.d:
ततः प्राह निजां भार्यां रहस्ये नृपसत्तम..
ज्ञातोऽहं ब्राह्मणैः सर्वैरंत्यजातिसमुद्भवः ..
देशातरं गमिष्यामि त्वमागच्छ मया सह .. 168 ..
5.198.m: Then in secret he said to his own wife, O best of kings: / “I have been recognized by all the brahmins as an outcast by birth. / I will go to another country; you come with me.”

5.198.s:
.. bhāryovāca .. ..
ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi na yāsyāmi tvayā saha ..
pāpabuddhe patiṣyāmi na cāhaṃ narakāgniṣu .. 169 ..
5.198.d:
.. भार्योवाच .. ..
अहमग्निं प्रवेक्ष्यामि न यास्यामि त्वया सह ..
पापबुद्धे पतिष्यामि न चाहं नरकाग्निषु .. 169 ..
5.198.m: The wife said: / “I will enter fire; I will not go with you. / O evil-minded one, I will not fall into the fires of hell.

5.198.s:
budhyamānā na seviṣye tvāmaṃtyajasamudbhavam ..
pāpa saṃdūṣitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayaitatsthānamuttamam .. 6.199.170 ..
5.198.d:
बुध्यमाना न सेविष्ये त्वामंत्यजसमुद्भवम् ..
पाप संदूषितं सर्वं त्वयैतत्स्थानमुत्तमम् .. 6.199.170 ..
5.198.m: Knowing [it], I will not serve you who are born of an outcaste. / O sinner, this entire excellent place has been corrupted by you,

5.198.s:
tathā mama piturharmyaṃ saṃvatsaraprayājinaḥ ..
tasmāddrutataraṃ gaccha yāvanno vetti kaścana .. 171 ..
5.198.d:
तथा मम पितुर्हर्म्यं संवत्सरप्रयाजिनः ..
तस्माद्द्रुततरं गच्छ यावन्नो वेत्ति कश्चन .. 171 ..
5.198.m: as well as the mansion of my father, who performs sacrifices for a year. / Therefore, go very swiftly, as long as no one knows;

5.198.s: no cetpāpasamācāra saṃprāpsyasi mahā''padam .. 172 ..
5.198.d: नो चेत्पापसमाचार संप्राप्स्यसि महा'ऽपदम् .. 172 ..
5.198.m: otherwise, O worker of evil, you will meet with great misfortune.”

5.198.s:
tato niśāmukhe prāpte kaupīnāvaraṇānvitaḥ ..
naṣṭo'bhīṣṭāṃ diśaṃ prāpya tadā jīvitajādbhayāt .. 173 ..
5.198.d:
ततो निशामुखे प्राप्ते कौपीनावरणान्वितः ..
नष्टोऽभीष्टां दिशं प्राप्य तदा जीवितजाद्भयात् .. 173 ..
5.198.m: Then, when nightfall arrived, wearing only a loincloth, / having fled toward his desired direction, he vanished out of fear for his life.

5.198.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgarāṣṭakulaśraiṣṭhyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 199 .. .. cha ..
5.198.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागराष्टकुलश्रैष्ठ्यवर्णनंनामैकोनद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 199 .. .. छ ..
5.198.m: Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-ninth chapter, named ‘Description of the Pre-eminence of the Eight Families of Nāgaras’, in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.199.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte prodgate ravimaṇḍale ..
sā cāpi duhitā tasya dīkṣitasya mahātmanaḥ .. 1 ..
5.199.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
ततः प्रभाते संजाते प्रोद्गते रविमण्डले ..
सा चापि दुहिता तस्य दीक्षितस्य महात्मनः .. 1 ..
5.199.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Then, when morning had arrived and the orb of the sun had risen, / that daughter of the great-souled Dīkṣita,

5.199.s:
rorūyamāṇā'bhyagamatpitaraṃ mātaraṃ prati ..
provāca gadgadaṃ vākyaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanā .. 2 ..
5.199.d:
रोरूयमाणाऽभ्यगमत्पितरं मातरं प्रति ..
प्रोवाच गद्गदं वाक्यं बाष्पव्याकुललोचना .. 2 ..
5.199.m: weeping piteously, went to her father and mother / and, with eyes overflowing with tears, spoke in a choked voice:

5.199.s:
tātāmba kimidaṃ pāpaṃ yuvābhyāṃ samanuṣṭhitam ..
antyajasya pradattā'haṃ yatpāpasya durātmanaḥ .. 3 ..
5.199.d:
ताताम्ब किमिदं पापं युवाभ्यां समनुष्ठितम् ..
अन्त्यजस्य प्रदत्ताऽहं यत्पापस्य दुरात्मनः .. 3 ..
5.199.m: “Father! Mother! What is this sin performed by the two of you, / that I was given to an outcast, to an evil, wicked soul?

5.199.s:
sa naṣṭo rajanīvaktre mamāvedya nijaṃ kulam..
tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi pradīpte havyavāhane .. 4 ..
5.199.d:
स नष्टो रजनीवक्त्रे ममावेद्य निजं कुलम्..
तस्मादहं प्रवेक्ष्यामि प्रदीप्ते हव्यवाहने .. 4 ..
5.199.m: He fled at the beginning of the night after revealing his family to me. / Therefore, I shall enter the kindled fire.”

5.199.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dīkṣitaḥ sa subhadrakaḥ ..
niśceṣṭaḥ patito bhūmau vātabhagna iva drumaḥ .. 5 ..
5.199.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दीक्षितः स सुभद्रकः ..
निश्चेष्टः पतितो भूमौ वातभग्न इव द्रुमः .. 5 ..
5.199.m: Hearing her words, the Dīkṣita Subhadra / fell motionless to the earth like a tree broken by the wind.

5.199.s:
tataḥ sa śītatoyena saṃsiktaśca punaḥpunaḥ ..
labdhvāśu cetanāṃ kṛcchrātsvajanaiḥ parivāritaḥ ..
pralāpānvividhāṃścakre tāḍayansvaśiro muhuḥ .. 6 ..
5.199.d:
ततः स शीततोयेन संसिक्तश्च पुनःपुनः ..
लब्ध्वाशु चेतनां कृच्छ्रात्स्वजनैः परिवारितः ..
प्रलापान्विविधांश्चक्रे ताडयन्स्वशिरो मुहुः .. 6 ..
5.199.m: Then, sprinkled again and again with cold water, / surrounded by his kinsmen, he quickly regained consciousness with difficulty / and, beating his own head repeatedly, uttered various laments.

5.199.s:
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve tasya saṃparkadūṣitāḥ ..
bhartṛyajñaṃ samāsādya tenaiva sahitāstataḥ .. 7 ..
5.199.d:
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे तस्य संपर्कदूषिताः ..
भर्तृयज्ञं समासाद्य तेनैव सहितास्ततः .. 7 ..
5.199.m: Then all those brahmins, defiled by contact with him, / approached Bhartṛyajña and, accompanied by him,

5.199.s:
procurvinayasaṃyuktāḥ proccaistatsutayā saha ..
subhadreṇa nije harmye sutāṃ dattvā niveśitaḥ .. 8 ..
5.199.d:
प्रोचुर्विनयसंयुक्ताः प्रोच्चैस्तत्सुतया सह ..
सुभद्रेण निजे हर्म्ये सुतां दत्त्वा निवेशितः .. 8 ..
5.199.m: together with his daughter, spoke aloud with humility: / “Having given his daughter, Subhadra settled [a man] in his mansion.

5.199.s: caṇḍālo dvijarūpotra caṃdraprabha iti smṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
5.199.d: चण्डालो द्विजरूपोत्र चंद्रप्रभ इति स्मृतः .. 9 ..
5.199.m: Here [was] a caṇḍāla in the guise of a twice-born, known as Candraprabha.

5.199.s:
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ sārdhaṃ daive pitrye ca yojitaḥ ..
pāpakarmā na vijñātaḥ so'dhunā prakaṭo'bhavat .. 6.200.10 ..
5.199.d:
यावत्संवत्सरं सार्धं दैवे पित्र्ये च योजितः ..
पापकर्मा न विज्ञातः सोऽधुना प्रकटोऽभवत् .. 6.200.10 ..
5.199.m: He was employed in rites for gods and ancestors for a year and a half. / That worker of sin was not recognized; he has now been exposed.

5.199.s:
subhadrasyānuṣaṃgeṇa sthānaṃ sarvaṃ pradūṣitam ..
antyajena mahābhāga tatkuruṣva vinigraham.. 11 ..
5.199.d:
सुभद्रस्यानुषंगेण स्थानं सर्वं प्रदूषितम् ..
अन्त्यजेन महाभाग तत्कुरुष्व विनिग्रहम्.. 11 ..
5.199.m: Through association with Subhadra, the entire place has been defiled / by the outcast, O fortunate one; therefore, decree a restrainment.

5.199.s:
kaiścittasya gṛhe bhuktaṃ jalaṃ pītaṃ tathā paraiḥ ..
anyaiśca gṛhamānīya pradattaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā .. 12 ..
5.199.d:
कैश्चित्तस्य गृहे भुक्तं जलं पीतं तथा परैः ..
अन्यैश्च गृहमानीय प्रदत्तं भोजनं तथा .. 12 ..
5.199.m: By some food was eaten in his house, and water was drunk by others; / and by others, having brought him to their house, food was likewise given.

5.199.s:
kiṃ vā te bahunoktena na sa ko'sti dvijottama ..
saṃkaro yasya no jātastasya pāpasya saṃbhavaḥ .. 13 ..
5.199.d:
किं वा ते बहुनोक्तेन न स कोऽस्ति द्विजोत्तम ..
संकरो यस्य नो जातस्तस्य पापस्य संभवः .. 13 ..
5.199.m: What need of many words to you? There is no one, O best of the twice-born, / for whom mixture did not occur, born from that sin.

5.199.s:
tvayā sthānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāmate ..
sarveṣāṃ ca gurustvaṃ hi tasmācchuddhiṃ vadasva naḥ .. 14 ..
5.199.d:
त्वया स्थानमिदं पुण्यं कृतं पूर्वं महामते ..
सर्वेषां च गुरुस्त्वं हि तस्माच्छुद्धिं वदस्व नः .. 14 ..
5.199.m: Formerly this sacred place was established by you, O high-minded one, / and you indeed are the guru of all; therefore, tell us the purification.”

5.199.s:
tataḥ saṃcintya suciraṃ smṛtiśāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ ..
prāyaścittaṃ dadau teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ sa dvijanmanām .. 15 ..
5.199.d:
ततः संचिन्त्य सुचिरं स्मृतिशास्त्राण्यनेकशः ..
प्रायश्चित्तं ददौ तेषां सर्वेषां स द्विजन्मनाम् .. 15 ..
5.199.m: Then, having pondered over many codes of law for a long time, / he prescribed the penance for all those twice-born:

5.199.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇaśataṃ prādātsubhadrāyāhitāgnaye ..
sarvabhaṃḍaparityāgaṃ punarādhānameva ca .. 16 ..
5.199.d:
चांद्रायणशतं प्रादात्सुभद्रायाहिताग्नये ..
सर्वभंडपरित्यागं पुनराधानमेव च .. 16 ..
5.199.m: He prescribed a hundred cāndrāyaṇas for Subhadra, who maintains sacred fires, / the discarding of all vessels, and the reconsecration of the sacred fires;

5.199.s:
lakṣahomavidhānaṃ ca gṛhamadhyaviśuddhaye ..
vahnipraveśanaṃ tasyāstatsutāyāḥ prakīrtitam .. 17 ..
5.199.d:
लक्षहोमविधानं च गृहमध्यविशुद्धये ..
वह्निप्रवेशनं तस्यास्तत्सुतायाः प्रकीर्तितम् .. 17 ..
5.199.m: and the performance of a hundred thousand oblations for the purification of the inside of the house; / entering the fire was prescribed for that daughter of his.

5.199.s:
yena yāvaṃti bhojyāni tasya bhuktāni maṃdire ..
tasya tāvaṃti kṛcchrāṇi tenoktāni mahātmanā .. 18 ..
5.199.d:
येन यावंति भोज्यानि तस्य भुक्तानि मंदिरे ..
तस्य तावंति कृच्छ्राणि तेनोक्तानि महात्मना .. 18 ..
5.199.m: As many meals as were eaten by anyone in his house, / so many kṛcchra penances were declared for him by that great soul.

5.199.s:
yairjalāni prapītāni yāvanmātrāṇi tadgṛhe ..
prājāpatyāni dattāni tebhyastāvaṃti pārthiva .. 19 ..
5.199.d:
यैर्जलानि प्रपीतानि यावन्मात्राणि तद्गृहे ..
प्राजापत्यानि दत्तानि तेभ्यस्तावंति पार्थिव .. 19 ..
5.199.m: As many drinks of water as were drunk by people in his house, / so many prājāpatya penances were assigned to them, O king.

5.199.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ tatra sthāne nivāsinām ..
tatsparśadūṣitānāṃ ca prājāpatyaṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 6.200.20 ..
5.199.d:
ब्राह्मणानां तथान्येषां तत्र स्थाने निवासिनाम् ..
तत्स्पर्शदूषितानां च प्राजापत्यं पृथक्पृथक् .. 6.200.20 ..
5.199.m: And for other brahmins residing in that place, / who were defiled by his touch, an individual prājāpatya [was assigned] for each.

5.199.s:
strīśūdrāṇāṃ tadardhaṃ ca tadardha bālavṛddhayoḥ ..
mṛnmayānāṃ ca bhāṃḍānāṃ parityāgo niveditaḥ .. 21 ..
5.199.d:
स्त्रीशूद्राणां तदर्धं च तदर्ध बालवृद्धयोः ..
मृन्मयानां च भांडानां परित्यागो निवेदितः .. 21 ..
5.199.m: Half of that was for women and śūdras, and half of that for children and the aged; / and the discarding of earthenware vessels was declared.

5.199.s:
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ rasatyāgastathaiva ca ..
koṭihomastu nirdiṣṭo brahmasthāne yathoditaḥ ..
sarvasthānaviśuddhyarthaṃ sthānavittena kevalam .. .. 22 ..
5.199.d:
सर्वेषामेव लोकानां रसत्यागस्तथैव च ..
कोटिहोमस्तु निर्दिष्टो ब्रह्मस्थाने यथोदितः ..
सर्वस्थानविशुद्ध्यर्थं स्थानवित्तेन केवलम् .. .. 22 ..
5.199.m: Likewise, the abandonment of flavored liquids for all people; / and ten million oblations were prescribed in the brahmasthāna as laid down, / solely with the resources of the settlement, for the purification of the whole place.

5.199.s:
athovāca punarviprānsa kṛtvā cocchritaṃ bhujama ..
tāranādena mahatā sarvāṃstānnāgarodbhavān .. 23 ..
5.199.d:
अथोवाच पुनर्विप्रान्स कृत्वा चोच्छ्रितं भुजम ..
तारनादेन महता सर्वांस्तान्नागरोद्भवान् .. 23 ..
5.199.m: Then, having raised his arm, he spoke again to the brahmins, / in a loud and mighty voice, to all those born of the Nāgaras:

5.199.s:
subhadreṇa ca sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ viprebhya eva ca ..
caturthāṃśaśca yairbhuktaṃ tadgṛhe svadhanasya ca .. 24 ..
5.199.d:
सुभद्रेण च सर्वस्वं देयं विप्रेभ्य एव च ..
चतुर्थांशश्च यैर्भुक्तं तद्गृहे स्वधनस्य च .. 24 ..
5.199.m: “And all his wealth must be given by Subhadra to the brahmins; / and a fourth part of their own wealth by those who ate in his house;

5.199.s:
aṣṭāṃśaṃ yairjalaṃ pītaṃ godānaṃ sparśasaṃbhavam ..
śeṣāṇāmapi lokānāṃ yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇā .. 25 ..
5.199.d:
अष्टांशं यैर्जलं पीतं गोदानं स्पर्शसंभवम् ..
शेषाणामपि लोकानां यथाशक्त्या तु दक्षिणा .. 25 ..
5.199.m: an eighth part by those who drank water; the gift of a cow for defilement by touch; / and a sacrificial fee according to capacity for the rest of the people.

5.199.s:
dīkṣitena japaḥ kāryo lakṣagāyatrisaṃbhavaḥ ..
śeṣairviprairyathā vittaṃ tathā kāryo japo'khilaḥ .. 26 ..
5.199.d:
दीक्षितेन जपः कार्यो लक्षगायत्रिसंभवः ..
शेषैर्विप्रैर्यथा वित्तं तथा कार्यो जपोऽखिलः .. 26 ..
5.199.m: A recitation of a hundred thousand Gāyatrīs must be performed by the Dīkṣita; / the entire recitation must be done by the rest of the brahmins according to their means.

5.199.s:
ahaṃ caiva kariṣyāmi prāṇāyāmaśatatrayam ..
nityameva dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ ṣaṣṭhakālakṛtāśanaḥ .. 27 ..
5.199.d:
अहं चैव करिष्यामि प्राणायामशतत्रयम् ..
नित्यमेव द्विजश्रेष्ठाः षष्ठकालकृताशनः .. 27 ..
5.199.m: And I myself shall perform three hundred breath-controls / every day, O best of the twice-born, eating only at the sixth mealtime,

5.199.s:
yāvatsaṃvatsarasyāṃtaṃ tataḥ śuddhirbhaviṣyati ..
jana saṃparkasaṃjātā saivaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ .. 28 ..
5.199.d:
यावत्संवत्सरस्यांतं ततः शुद्धिर्भविष्यति ..
जन संपर्कसंजाता सैवं तस्य दुरात्मनः .. 28 ..
5.199.m: until the end of a year; then purification will come to pass / for the defilement arising from contact with that wicked-souled person.”

5.199.s:
evamuktvā tato bhūyaḥ sa provāca dvijottamān ..
athā''dyānmadhyagāsyena brahmasthānasamāśrayān .. .. 29 ..
5.199.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो भूयः स प्रोवाच द्विजोत्तमान् ..
अथा'ऽद्यान्मध्यगास्येन ब्रह्मस्थानसमाश्रयान् .. .. 29 ..
5.199.m: Having spoken thus, he spoke further to the best of the twice-born, / to those residing in the brahmasthāna, with his face in their midst:

5.199.s:
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kanyāmaviditvā tu nāgaram ..
nāgaro dāsyati kvāpi patitaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ..6.200. 30 ..
5.199.d:
अद्यप्रभृति यः कन्यामविदित्वा तु नागरम् ..
नागरो दास्यति क्वापि पतितः स भविष्यति ..6.200. 30 ..
5.199.m: “From this day forward, any Nāgara who gives his daughter anywhere / without knowing [the groom to be] a Nāgara, he shall become fallen.

5.199.s: aśrāddheyo hyapāṃkteyo nāgarāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
5.199.d: अश्राद्धेयो ह्यपांक्तेयो नागराणां विशेषतः .. 31 ..
5.199.m: Indeed, he is unfit for śrāddha and unfit to sit in the row, especially among Nāgaras.

5.199.s:
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ nāgaraṃ muktvā hyanyasmai saṃpradāsyati ..
vimukhāstasya yāsyaṃti pitaro vibudhaiḥ saha .. 32 ..
5.199.d:
यः श्राद्धं नागरं मुक्त्वा ह्यन्यस्मै संप्रदास्यति ..
विमुखास्तस्य यास्यंति पितरो विबुधैः सह .. 32 ..
5.199.m: He who shall give a śrāddha to anyone else, leaving aside a Nāgara, / his ancestors, along with the gods, will turn their faces away from him.

5.199.s:
nāgareṇa vinā yastu somapānaṃ kariṣyati ..
sa kariṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ madyapānaṃ tu nāgaraḥ ..
tanmatena vinā yastu śrāddhakarma kariṣyati 33 ..
5.199.d:
नागरेण विना यस्तु सोमपानं करिष्यति ..
स करिष्यत्यसंदिग्धं मद्यपानं तु नागरः ..
तन्मतेन विना यस्तु श्राद्धकर्म करिष्यति 33 ..
5.199.m: A Nāgara who drinks soma without a Nāgara / will undoubtedly drink wine; / as also one who performs a śrāddha rite without his approval.”

5.199.s:
tataḥ sarvaṃ vṛthā tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ..
viśuddhirahitaṃ yastu nāgaraṃ bhojayiṣyati .. 34 ..
5.199.d:
ततः सर्वं वृथा तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः ..
विशुद्धिरहितं यस्तु नागरं भोजयिष्यति .. 34 ..
5.199.m: Then everything of his will become useless; of this there is no doubt. / But whoever feeds a Nāgara devoid of purification,

5.199.s:
śrāddhe tasyāpi tatsarvaṃ vyarthatāṃ saṃprayāsyati ..
sarveṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ ca maryādeyaṃ kṛtā mayā .. 35 ..
5.199.d:
श्राद्धे तस्यापि तत्सर्वं व्यर्थतां संप्रयास्यति ..
सर्वेषां नागराणां च मर्यादेयं कृता मया .. 35 ..
5.199.m: at his ancestral rite too, all that will go in vain. / And this rule has been established by me for all Nāgaras.

5.199.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śuddhiḥ kāryā dvijottamaiḥ ..
varṣevarṣe tu saṃprāpte svasthānasya viśuddhaye .. 36 ..
5.199.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन शुद्धिः कार्या द्विजोत्तमैः ..
वर्षेवर्षे तु संप्राप्ते स्वस्थानस्य विशुद्धये .. 36 ..
5.199.m: Therefore, purification must be performed with every effort by the best of the twice-born / every year that arrives, for the purification of one's own standing.

5.199.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi nṛpottama ..
śrāddhārhā nāgarā yena nāgarāṇāṃ vyavasthitāḥ ..
bhartṛyajñena maryādā kṛtā teṣāṃ yathā purā .. 37 ..
5.199.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नृपोत्तम ..
श्राद्धार्हा नागरा येन नागराणां व्यवस्थिताः ..
भर्तृयज्ञेन मर्यादा कृता तेषां यथा पुरा .. 37 ..
5.199.m: Viśvāmitra said: / All this has been related to you as I was asked, O best of kings, / by which the Nāgaras are determined as worthy of ancestral rites among the Nāgaras, / just as their rule was established by Bhartṛyajña long ago.

5.199.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhartṛyajñakṛtanāgarajñātimaryādāvarṇanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 200 .. .. cha ..
5.199.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भर्तृयज्ञकृतनागरज्ञातिमर्यादावर्णनं नाम द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 200 .. .. छ ..
5.199.m: Thus ends the two-hundredth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Community Rule of the Nāgaras Established by Bhartṛyajña,' in the glorification of Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the eighty-one-thousand-[verse] collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.200.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhartṛyajñaṃ mahāmatim ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhūtvā stutiṃ kṛtvā vaco'bruvan .. 1 ..
5.200.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
अथ ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे भर्तृयज्ञं महामतिम् ..
कृतांजलिपुटा भूत्वा स्तुतिं कृत्वा वचोऽब्रुवन् .. 1 ..
5.200.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Then all those brahmins, joining their palms in reverence, / uttered praise to the great-minded Bhartṛyajña and spoke these words:

5.200.s:
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śodhito yo bhaveddvijaḥ ..
śrāddhasya kanyakāyāśca somapānasya so'rhati .. 2 ..
5.200.d:
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं शोधितो यो भवेद्द्विजः ..
श्राद्धस्य कन्यकायाश्च सोमपानस्य सोऽर्हति .. 2 ..
5.200.m: As this has been stated by you: 'That twice-born who has been purified / is worthy of the ancestral rite, of a maiden, and of the drinking of soma,'—

5.200.s:
kathaṃ śuddhiḥ prakartavyā tasya sarvaṃ bravīhi naḥ ..
nāgarasya samastasya deśāṃtaragatasya ca ..3..
5.200.d:
कथं शुद्धिः प्रकर्तव्या तस्य सर्वं ब्रवीहि नः ..
नागरस्य समस्तस्य देशांतरगतस्य च ..3..
5.200.m: how must the purification of such a person be performed? Tell us all of that: / of all Nāgaras, and of one who has gone to another country,

5.200.s:
deśāṃtaraprajātasya tatra jātasya vā punaḥ ..
ajñātapitṛvargasya sāmā nyaṃ padamicchataḥ .. 4 ..
5.200.d:
देशांतरप्रजातस्य तत्र जातस्य वा पुनः ..
अज्ञातपितृवर्गस्य सामा न्यं पदमिच्छतः .. 4 ..
5.200.m: or of one born in another country, or born there again, / whose paternal lineage is unknown, desiring common standing.

5.200.s: etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate .. 5 ..
5.200.d: एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामते .. 5 ..
5.200.m: Explain all this to us in detail, O noble-minded one.

5.200.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpottama ..
abravīdbhartṛyajñastu svābhiprāyaṃ susaṃmatam .. 6 ..
5.200.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणानां नृपोत्तम ..
अब्रवीद्भर्तृयज्ञस्तु स्वाभिप्रायं सुसंमतम् .. 6 ..
5.200.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Hearing those words of the brahmins, O best of kings, / Bhartṛyajña then stated his well-considered view:

5.200.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
praśnabhāro mahāneṣa bhavadbhiḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ..
tathāpi kathayiṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayaṃbhuvam.. 7..
5.200.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
प्रश्नभारो महानेष भवद्भिः समुदाहृतः ..
तथापि कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्य स्वयंभुवम्.. 7..
5.200.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / A great burden of inquiry has been raised by you; / nevertheless, having bowed down to the self-manifest [lord], I shall explain it.

5.200.s:
ajñātapitṛvaṃśo yo dūrādapi samāgataḥ ..
sāmānyaṃ vāṃchate padyaṃ nāgaro'smīti kīrtayan .. 8 ..
5.200.d:
अज्ञातपितृवंशो यो दूरादपि समागतः ..
सामान्यं वांछते पद्यं नागरोऽस्मीति कीर्तयन् .. 8 ..
5.200.m: One whose paternal lineage is unknown, who has come even from afar, / and desires common standing, proclaiming, 'I am a Nāgara,'—

5.200.s:
tasya śuddhiḥ pradā tavyā mukhyaiḥ śāṃtaiḥ śubhairdvijaiḥ ..
gartātīrthodbhavaṃ vipraṃ kṛtvā caiva puraḥsaram ..9 ..
5.200.d:
तस्य शुद्धिः प्रदा तव्या मुख्यैः शांतैः शुभैर्द्विजैः ..
गर्तातीर्थोद्भवं विप्रं कृत्वा चैव पुरःसरम् ..9 ..
5.200.m: purification should be granted to him by the foremost, tranquil, and auspicious twice-born, / having placed in front a vipra originating from Gartātīrtha.

5.200.s:
viśuddhiṃ yācamānasya yadi yacchaṃti no dvijāḥ ..
kāmādvā yadi vā krodhātpradveṣādvā cyuterbhayāt .. 6.201.10 ..
5.200.d:
विशुद्धिं याचमानस्य यदि यच्छंति नो द्विजाः ..
कामाद्वा यदि वा क्रोधात्प्रद्वेषाद्वा च्युतेर्भयात् .. 6.201.10 ..
5.200.m: If the twice-born do not grant purification to him when he begs for it, / whether through desire, anger, malice, or fear of loss of status,

5.200.s:
brahmahatyodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra jāyate ..
tasmādabhyāgato yastu dūrādapi viśeṣataḥ .. 11 ..
5.200.d:
ब्रह्महत्योद्भवं पापं सर्वेषां तत्र जायते ..
तस्मादभ्यागतो यस्तु दूरादपि विशेषतः .. 11 ..
5.200.m: the sin born of killing a brahmin arises for all of them there. / Therefore, when one has arrived even from afar in particular,

5.200.s:
tasya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā prayatnena dvijottamaiḥ ..
śuddhiṃ tu trividhāṃ prāpto mama vākyasamudbhavām .. 12 ..
5.200.d:
तस्य शुद्धिः प्रदातव्या प्रयत्नेन द्विजोत्तमैः ..
शुद्धिं तु त्रिविधां प्राप्तो मम वाक्यसमुद्भवाम् .. 12 ..
5.200.m: purification must be granted to him with effort by the best of the twice-born. / One who has attained the threefold purification that originates from my word,

5.200.s:
sa śuddho nāgaro jñeyo jāto deśāṃtareṣvapi ..
pūrvaṃ viśodhayedvaṃśaṃ tato mātṛkulaṃ smṛtam .. 13 ..
5.200.d:
स शुद्धो नागरो ज्ञेयो जातो देशांतरेष्वपि ..
पूर्वं विशोधयेद्वंशं ततो मातृकुलं स्मृतम् .. 13 ..
5.200.m: he is to be known as a purified Nāgara, even if born in another country. / First, one should purify his paternal lineage; after that, the maternal family is prescribed.

5.200.s: tataḥ śīlaṃ tribhiḥ śuddhaḥ sāmānyaṃ padamarhati .. 14 ..
5.200.d: ततः शीलं त्रिभिः शुद्धः सामान्यं पदमर्हति .. 14 ..
5.200.m: Then his conduct: purified by these three, he is worthy of common standing.

5.200.s:
sarveṣāmapi viprāṇāṃ varṣāṃte samupasthite ..
śuddhiḥ kāryā prayatnena svasthānasya viśuddhaye .. 15 ..
5.200.d:
सर्वेषामपि विप्राणां वर्षांते समुपस्थिते ..
शुद्धिः कार्या प्रयत्नेन स्वस्थानस्य विशुद्धये .. 15 ..
5.200.m: For all vipras also, when the end of the year has arrived, / purification must be performed with effort for the purification of one's own standing.

5.200.s:
tadarthaṃ śaradaścāṃte śubharttau brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
cātuścaraṇasaṃpannāḥ saṃsthāpyāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu .. 16 ..
5.200.d:
तदर्थं शरदश्चांते शुभर्त्तौ ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
चातुश्चरणसंपन्नाः संस्थाप्याः षोडशैव तु .. 16 ..
5.200.m: For that purpose, at the end of autumn, in the auspicious season, O best of brahmins, / sixteen [brahmins] endowed with [mastery of] four Vedic branches are indeed to be seated,

5.200.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ purataḥ sarve śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ ..
garttātīrthodbhavaṃ vipraṃ teṣāṃ madhye niveśayet .. 17 ..
5.200.d:
ब्राह्मणाः पुरतः सर्वे शांता दांता जितेंद्रियाः ..
गर्त्तातीर्थोद्भवं विप्रं तेषां मध्ये निवेशयेत् .. 17 ..
5.200.m: all of them brahmins seated in front, tranquil, self-restrained, and with senses conquered. / Among them he should seat a vipra originating from Gartātīrtha.

5.200.s:
tadagre pīṭhikā deyāścatasro lakṣaṇānvitāḥ ..
yāvatkārttikaparyaṃtaṃ cātuścaraṇakalpitāḥ .. 18 ..
5.200.d:
तदग्रे पीठिका देयाश्चतस्रो लक्षणान्विताः ..
यावत्कार्त्तिकपर्यंतं चातुश्चरणकल्पिताः .. 18 ..
5.200.m: In front of them, four auspiciously marked small seats are to be set, / arranged for the four branches [of the Vedas] up until [the month of] Kārttika:

5.200.s:
prathamā bahvṛcasyārthe yājuṣasya tathā'parā ..
sāmagasya tathaivānyā tathā''dyasya caturthikā .. .. 19 ..
5.200.d:
प्रथमा बह्वृचस्यार्थे याजुषस्य तथाऽपरा ..
सामगस्य तथैवान्या तथा'ऽद्यस्य चतुर्थिका .. .. 19 ..
5.200.m: the first for the Ṛgvedic scholar, another likewise for the Yajurvedic scholar, / another likewise for the Sāmavedic singer, and the fourth for the first [Atharvavedic priest].

5.200.s:
mudrikārthaṃ tathaivānyā paṃcamī parikīrtitā ..
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca śākunaṃ viṣṇudaivatam.. 6.201.20 ..
5.200.d:
मुद्रिकार्थं तथैवान्या पंचमी परिकीर्तिता ..
श्रीसूक्तं पावमानं च शाकुनं विष्णुदैवतम्.. 6.201.20 ..
5.200.m: Likewise, a fifth is proclaimed for the seal. / The Śrīsūkta, the Pāvamānasūkta, the Śākunasūkta, and that which has Viṣṇu as its deity,

5.200.s:
pārāvataṃ tathā sūktaṃ jīvasūktena saṃyutam..
bahvṛcaḥ kīrtayettatra śāṃtikaṃ ca tathāparam .. 21 ..
5.200.d:
पारावतं तथा सूक्तं जीवसूक्तेन संयुतम्..
बह्वृचः कीर्तयेत्तत्र शांतिकं च तथापरम् .. 21 ..
5.200.m: the Pārāvatasūkta, along with the Jīvasūkta: / there the Ṛgvedic scholar should recite [these], and also other pacifying hymns.

5.200.s:
śāṃtikaṃ śivasaṃkalpamṛṣikalpaṃ caturvidham ..
maṃḍalaṃbrāhmaṇaṃ caiva gāyatrībrāhmaṇaṃ tathā .. 22 ..
tathā puruṣasūktaṃ ca madhubrāhmaṇameva ca ..
adhvaryuḥ kīrtayettatra rudrānpaṃcāṃgasaṃyutān .. 23 ..
5.200.d:
शांतिकं शिवसंकल्पमृषिकल्पं चतुर्विधम् ..
मंडलंब्राह्मणं चैव गायत्रीब्राह्मणं तथा .. 22 ..
तथा पुरुषसूक्तं च मधुब्राह्मणमेव च ..
अध्वर्युः कीर्तयेत्तत्र रुद्रान्पंचांगसंयुतान् .. 23 ..
5.200.m: The pacifying [hymn], the Śivasaṅkalpa, the fourfold Ṛṣikalpa, / the Maṇḍalabrāhmaṇa, the Gāyatrībrāhmaṇa, / and also the Puruṣasūkta and the Madhubrāhmaṇa— / there the Adhvaryu priest should recite the Rudra hymns endowed with five parts.

5.200.s:
devavrataṃ ca gāyatraṃ somasūryavrate tathā ..
ekaviṃśatiparyaṃtaṃ tathānyacca rathaṃtaram .. 24 ..
5.200.d:
देवव्रतं च गायत्रं सोमसूर्यव्रते तथा ..
एकविंशतिपर्यंतं तथान्यच्च रथंतरम् .. 24 ..
5.200.m: The Devavrata, the Gāyatra, and the Somavrata and Sūryavrata, / [the chants] ending at the twenty-first, and also the other, the Rathaṃtara,

5.200.s:
sauvrataṃ saṃhitā viṣṇorjyeṣṭhasāma tathaiva ca ..
sāmavedoktarudrāṃśca bhāruṃḍaiḥ sāmabhiryutān .. 25 ..
5.200.d:
सौव्रतं संहिता विष्णोर्ज्येष्ठसाम तथैव च ..
सामवेदोक्तरुद्रांश्च भारुंडैः सामभिर्युतान् .. 25 ..
5.200.m: the Sauvrata, the Saṃhitā of Viṣṇu, and likewise the Jyeṣṭhasāman, / and the Rudra hymns declared in the Sāmaveda accompanied by the Bhāruṇḍa chants—

5.200.s:
chaṃdogaḥ kīrtayettatra yaccānyacchāṃtikaṃ bhavet ..
garbhopaniṣadaṃ caiva skaṃdasūktaṃ tathāparam .. 26 ..
5.200.d:
छंदोगः कीर्तयेत्तत्र यच्चान्यच्छांतिकं भवेत् ..
गर्भोपनिषदं चैव स्कंदसूक्तं तथापरम् .. 26 ..
5.200.m: there the Chandoga priest should recite [these], and whatever else may be pacifying. / And the Garbhopaniṣad, and also the Skandasūkta,

5.200.s:
nīlarudraiḥ samopetānprāṇarudrāṃstathāparān ..
navarudrāṃśca kṣurikānādyastatra prakīrtayet .. 27 ..
5.200.d:
नीलरुद्रैः समोपेतान्प्राणरुद्रांस्तथापरान् ..
नवरुद्रांश्च क्षुरिकानाद्यस्तत्र प्रकीर्तयेत् .. 27 ..
5.200.m: the Nīlarudra hymns along with the Prāṇarudra hymns, and others: / the nine Rudras and the Kṣurikā—the prime [priest] should recite these there.

5.200.s:
tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ..
śuklamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śuklacaṃdanacarcitaḥ 28 ..
5.200.d:
ततः पुण्याहघोषेण गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः ..
शुक्लमाल्यांबरधरः शुक्लचंदनचर्चितः 28 ..
5.200.m: Then, with the proclamation of an auspicious day, accompanied by sounds of singing and musical instruments, / wearing white garlands and garments, anointed with white sandalwood,

5.200.s:
śuddhikāmo vrajettatra yatra te brāhmaṇāḥ sthitāḥ ..
praṇamya śirasā teṣāṃ tatovācyastu madhyagaḥ .. 29 ..
5.200.d:
शुद्धिकामो व्रजेत्तत्र यत्र ते ब्राह्मणाः स्थिताः ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा तेषां ततोवाच्यस्तु मध्यगः .. 29 ..
5.200.m: the person desiring purification should go there where those brahmins are seated. / Having bowed to them with his head, he who sits in the middle should then be addressed:

5.200.s:
madarthaṃ prārthaya tvaṃ hi sarvānetāndvijottamān ..
yataḥ śuddhiṃ prayacchaṃti prasādaṃ kartumarhasi .. 6.201.30 ..
5.200.d:
मदर्थं प्रार्थय त्वं हि सर्वानेतान्द्विजोत्तमान् ..
यतः शुद्धिं प्रयच्छंति प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 6.201.30 ..
5.200.m: 'Do pray on my behalf to all these best of the twice-born, / so that they may grant purification; please bestow this grace.'

5.200.s:
tatastu prārthayedviprāṃstadarthaṃ ca viśuddhaye ..
gartātīrthodbhavo vipro vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 31 ..
5.200.d:
ततस्तु प्रार्थयेद्विप्रांस्तदर्थं च विशुद्धये ..
गर्तातीर्थोद्भवो विप्रो विनयावनतः स्थितः .. 31 ..
5.200.m: Then the vipra originating from Gartātīrtha, standing bowed in humility, / should pray to the vipras for his sake, for his purification.

5.200.s:
gocarmaṇi samālagnaḥ śuddhikāmasya tasya ca ..
praṣṭavyāstu tatastena sarva eva dvijottamāḥ .. 32 ..
5.200.d:
गोचर्मणि समालग्नः शुद्धिकामस्य तस्य च ..
प्रष्टव्यास्तु ततस्तेन सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 32 ..
5.200.m: Remaining seated upon a hide of ox-hide, for that person who desires purification, / all the best of the twice-born should then be asked by him:

5.200.s:
eṣa śuddhikṛte prāptaḥ sudūrānnāgaro dvijaḥ ..
asya śuddhiḥ pradātavyā yuṣmākaṃ rocate yadi .. 33 ..
5.200.d:
एष शुद्धिकृते प्राप्तः सुदूरान्नागरो द्विजः ..
अस्य शुद्धिः प्रदातव्या युष्माकं रोचते यदि .. 33 ..
5.200.m: 'This twice-born Nāgara has arrived from very far for the sake of purification. / Purification should be granted to him, if it pleases you.'

5.200.s:
atha tairvedasūktena niṣedho vā pravartanam ..
vaktavyaṃ vacasā naiva mama vākyamidaṃ sthitam.. 34 ..
5.200.d:
अथ तैर्वेदसूक्तेन निषेधो वा प्रवर्तनम् ..
वक्तव्यं वचसा नैव मम वाक्यमिदं स्थितम्.. 34 ..
5.200.m: Then, either prohibition or permission must be pronounced by them by means of Vedic hymns, / not merely in ordinary words; this is my established decree.

5.200.s:
tataśca bahulāndṛṣṭvā ṛgadhvaryūṃstataḥ param ..
chādogyāṃśca tathādyāṃśca krameṇa tu dvijottamāḥ .. 35 ..
5.200.d:
ततश्च बहुलान्दृष्ट्वा ऋगध्वर्यूंस्ततः परम् ..
छादोग्यांश्च तथाद्यांश्च क्रमेण तु द्विजोत्तमाः .. 35 ..
5.200.m: And then, having looked upon the numerous Ṛgvedins and Adhvaryus thereafter, / and the Chāndogyas and the foremost ones in succession, O best of the twice-born,

5.200.s:
yadi teṣāṃ manastuṣṭirjāyate dvijasattamāḥ ..
tataḥ sūktāni vākyāni saumyāni suśubhāni ca ..
vāruṇāni tathaiṃdrāṇi māṃgalyaprabhavāṇi ca .. 36 ..
5.200.d:
यदि तेषां मनस्तुष्टिर्जायते द्विजसत्तमाः ..
ततः सूक्तानि वाक्यानि सौम्यानि सुशुभानि च ..
वारुणानि तथैंद्राणि मांगल्यप्रभवाणि च .. 36 ..
5.200.m: if contentment of their minds arises, O best among the twice-born, / then [they recite] Vedic hymns and words that are gentle, highly auspicious, / dedicated to Varuṇa, dedicated to Indra, and yielding blessings.

5.200.s:
śreṣṭhāni maṃtraliṃgāni vṛddhituṣṭikarāṇi ca ..
yadi no mānasī tuṣṭi steṣāṃ caiva prajāyate .. 37 ..
5.200.d:
श्रेष्ठानि मंत्रलिंगानि वृद्धितुष्टिकराणि च ..
यदि नो मानसी तुष्टि स्तेषां चैव प्रजायते .. 37 ..
5.200.m: [They recite] excellent mantra-indicators that cause growth and satisfaction. / If, however, mental satisfaction is not produced in them,

5.200.s:
tadā raudrāṇi yāmyāni nairṛtyāni viśeṣataḥ ..
āgneyāni tvaniṣṭāni tathā nāśakarāṇi ca .. 38 ..
5.200.d:
तदा रौद्राणि याम्यानि नैरृत्यानि विशेषतः ..
आग्नेयानि त्वनिष्टानि तथा नाशकराणि च .. 38 ..
5.200.m: then [they recite mantras] sacred to Rudra, Yama, and especially Nirṛti, / or belonging to Agni, which are unfavorable and bring about destruction.

5.200.s:
atha ye tatra mūrkhāḥ syurna vedapaṭhane ratāḥ ..
puṣpadānaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ taiḥ saṃtuṣṭairdvijottamaiḥ .. 39 ..
5.200.d:
अथ ये तत्र मूर्खाः स्युर्न वेदपठने रताः ..
पुष्पदानं तु वक्तव्यं तैः संतुष्टैर्द्विजोत्तमैः .. 39 ..
5.200.m: Now, those who might be foolish there and not devoted to reciting the Veda, / a gift of flowers should be declared by those best among brahmins when pleased.

5.200.s:
sītkāraḥ kupitaiḥ kāryaḥ saṃtoṣeṇa vivarjitaiḥ ..
evaṃ sarveṣu kṛtyeṣu na ca kāryo vinirṇayaḥ .. 6.201.40 ..
5.200.d:
सीत्कारः कुपितैः कार्यः संतोषेण विवर्जितैः ..
एवं सर्वेषु कृत्येषु न च कार्यो विनिर्णयः .. 6.201.40 ..
5.200.m: When angered and devoid of satisfaction, a hiss must be made. / Thus in all matters, no decision should be made

5.200.s:
prākṛtairvacanaiścaiva yathā kurvaṃti mānavāḥ ..
tathaiva nirṇayasyāṃte madhyagena vipaścitā .. 41 ..
5.200.d:
प्राकृतैर्वचनैश्चैव यथा कुर्वंति मानवाः ..
तथैव निर्णयस्यांते मध्यगेन विपश्चिता .. 41 ..
5.200.m: with ordinary vernacular words, as common men do. / Likewise, at the conclusion of a decision, the wise arbiter,

5.200.s: deyaṃ tālatrayaṃ samyaksarveṣāṃ nirṇayodbhave .. 42 ..
5.200.d: देयं तालत्रयं सम्यक्सर्वेषां निर्णयोद्भवे .. 42 ..
5.200.m: when the decision of all emerges, should properly give three claps of the hands.

5.200.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgara praśnanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 201 ..
5.200.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागर प्रश्ननिर्णयवर्णनंनामैकोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 201 ..
5.200.m: Thus ends the two hundred and first chapter, entitled “Description of the Determination of Queries of the Nāgaras,” in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the section on the greatness of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.201.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vinayāvanatāḥ sthitāḥ ..
taṃ papracchurnaraśreṣṭha kautukāviṣṭacetasaḥ .. 1 ..
5.201.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे विनयावनताः स्थिताः ..
तं पप्रच्छुर्नरश्रेष्ठ कौतुकाविष्टचेतसः .. 1 ..
5.201.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Having heard that, all the brahmins bowed in humility, / and filled with curiosity, O best of men, questioned him:

5.201.s:
kasyacinnirṇayo deyo madhyasthasya dvijottamaiḥ ..
vedavākyena saṃtyajya vākyaṃ manujasaṃbhavam o. 2 ..
kasmāttālatrayaṃ deyaṃ madhyagena mahātmanā ..
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 3 ..
5.201.d:
कस्यचिन्निर्णयो देयो मध्यस्थस्य द्विजोत्तमैः ..
वेदवाक्येन संत्यज्य वाक्यं मनुजसंभवम् ओ. 2 ..
कस्मात्तालत्रयं देयं मध्यगेन महात्मना ..
एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 3 ..
5.201.m: “How is a decision of an arbiter given by the best among brahmins / by means of Vedic speech, abandoning human speech? / Why should three claps of the hands be given by the high-souled arbiter? / Tell us all this, for our curiosity is indeed great.”

5.201.s:
tacchrutvā bhartṛyajñastu tānuvāca dvijottamān ..
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi yadetatkāraṇaṃ sthitam .. 4 ..
5.201.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भर्तृयज्ञस्तु तानुवाच द्विजोत्तमान् ..
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि यदेतत्कारणं स्थितम् .. 4 ..
5.201.m: Hearing that, Bhartṛyajña said to those best of brahmins: / “Listen, I will tell the reason for this.

5.201.s:
nāsatyaṃ jāyate vākyaṃ nāgarāṇāṃ kathaṃcana ..
brahmaśālāsthitānāṃ ca śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham .. 5 ..
5.201.d:
नासत्यं जायते वाक्यं नागराणां कथंचन ..
ब्रह्मशालास्थितानां च शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम् .. 5 ..
5.201.m: The speech of the Nāgaras situated in the Vedic assembly never becomes false, / whether [it indicates] auspiciousness or inauspiciousness.

5.201.s:
vedokteḥ savanaistasmāddarśayaṃti dvijottamāḥ ..
iṣṭaṃ vā yadi vāniṣṭaṃ pṛcchamānasya cā rthinaḥ .. 6 ..
5.201.d:
वेदोक्तेः सवनैस्तस्माद्दर्शयंति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
इष्टं वा यदि वानिष्टं पृच्छमानस्य चा र्थिनः .. 6 ..
5.201.m: Therefore, through the utterances of the Veda, the best of brahmins point out / favorable or unfavorable [outcomes] to the inquirer who is seeking an answer.

5.201.s:
bhūyobhūyastataḥ kuryānmadhyasthaḥ sa dvijanmanām ..
praśnaṃ tasya nimittaṃ ca yāvattasya vinirṇayaḥ .. 7 ..
5.201.d:
भूयोभूयस्ततः कुर्यान्मध्यस्थः स द्विजन्मनाम् ..
प्रश्नं तस्य निमित्तं च यावत्तस्य विनिर्णयः .. 7 ..
5.201.m: The arbiter should then present the question and its omen again and again / to those brahmins, until the final determination is reached.

5.201.s:
brahmaśālopaviṣṭānāṃ yadi vākyaṃ vṛthā bhavet ..
māhātmyaṃ naśyate teṣāṃ tataḥ krodhaḥ prajāyate .. 8 ..
5.201.d:
ब्रह्मशालोपविष्टानां यदि वाक्यं वृथा भवेत् ..
माहात्म्यं नश्यते तेषां ततः क्रोधः प्रजायते .. 8 ..
5.201.m: If the word of those seated in the Vedic assembly were to become futile, / their greatness would be destroyed, and thence anger would arise.

5.201.s:
krodhātsañjāyate droho drohātpāpasya saṃgamaḥ ..
etasmātkāraṇādviprā madhyasthaḥ pṛcchyate muhuḥ .. 9 ..
5.201.d:
क्रोधात्सञ्जायते द्रोहो द्रोहात्पापस्य संगमः ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्रा मध्यस्थः पृच्छ्यते मुहुः .. 9 ..
5.201.m: From anger hostility arises; from hostility comes association with sin. / For this reason, O brahmins, the arbiter asks repeatedly.

5.201.s:
samudāyaḥ samastānāṃ yathā caiva prajāyate ..
tadā tālatrayaṃ yacca madhyasthaḥ saṃprayacchati .. 6.202.10 ..
5.201.d:
समुदायः समस्तानां यथा चैव प्रजायते ..
तदा तालत्रयं यच्च मध्यस्थः संप्रयच्छति .. 6.202.10 ..
5.201.m: And when consensus among all is achieved, / then the arbiter gives three claps of the hands.

5.201.s:
tāsāṃ tu pūrvayā kāmaṃ haṃti pṛcchāpradāyinām ..
dvitīyayā tathā krodhaṃ haṃti lobhaṃ tṛtīyayā .. 11 ..
5.201.d:
तासां तु पूर्वया कामं हंति पृच्छाप्रदायिनाम् ..
द्वितीयया तथा क्रोधं हंति लोभं तृतीयया .. 11 ..
5.201.m: With the first of them, he destroys the desire of the questioners; / with the second, he destroys anger; with the third, he destroys greed.
For this reason, O brahmins, three claps must be given by him.”

5.201.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
ātharvaṇaścaturthastu brāhmaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
sa kasmātprathamaḥ praśno nāgarāṇāṃ prakīrtitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.201.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
आथर्वणश्चतुर्थस्तु ब्राह्मणः परिकीर्तितः ..
स कस्मात्प्रथमः प्रश्नो नागराणां प्रकीर्तितः .. 13 ..
5.201.m: The brahmins said: / “The Ātharvaṇa is renowned as the fourth brahmin. / Why has his question been proclaimed as first among the Nāgaras?”

5.201.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
ātharvaḥ prathamaḥ praśno yasmātprokto mayā dvijāḥ ..
tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ .. 14 ..
5.201.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
आथर्वः प्रथमः प्रश्नो यस्मात्प्रोक्तो मया द्विजाः ..
तदहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः .. 14 ..
5.201.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / “Since the Ātharvaṇa question was declared first by me, O brahmins, / I will explain that; listen attentively.

5.201.s:
nerṣyā caivātra kartavyā svasthānasya vināśanī ..
nirūpitaṃ mayā samyaksthānasthasya viśuddhaye .. 15 ..
5.201.d:
नेर्ष्या चैवात्र कर्तव्या स्वस्थानस्य विनाशनी ..
निरूपितं मया सम्यक्स्थानस्थस्य विशुद्धये .. 15 ..
5.201.m: Jealousy, which destroys one’s own place, must not be harbored here; / this was properly ascertained by me for the purity of the occupant of the place.

5.201.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñākhyā agniṣṭomādikā makhāḥ ..
pāratrikāḥ pravartaṃte naihikāścābhicārikāḥ .. 16 ..
5.201.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामसंज्ञाख्या अग्निष्टोमादिका मखाः ..
पारत्रिकाः प्रवर्तंते नैहिकाश्चाभिचारिकाः .. 16 ..
5.201.m: Sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma, known by the names of Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman, / promote otherworldly welfare; they are neither worldly nor meant for magical rites.

5.201.s:
atharvavede taccoktaṃ sarvaṃ caivābhicārikam ..
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā .. 17 ..
5.201.d:
अथर्ववेदे तच्चोक्तं सर्वं चैवाभिचारिकम् ..
हिताय सर्वलोकानां ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा .. 17 ..
5.201.m: And in the Atharvaveda, all magical rites are proclaimed / by Brahmā, the maker of the world, for the benefit of all worlds.

5.201.s:
atharvavedaḥ prathamaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye ..
etasmātkāraṇādādyaḥ sa caturtho'pi saṃsthitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.201.d:
अथर्ववेदः प्रथमं द्रष्टव्यः कार्यसिद्धये ..
एतस्मात्कारणादाद्यः स चतुर्थोऽपि संस्थितः .. 18 ..
5.201.m: The Atharvaveda must be consulted first for the accomplishment of worldly affairs. / For this reason, though being the fourth, it stands as the first.

5.201.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
pṛcchā saṃbaṃdhajaṃ sarvamekaṃ kāryaṃ sadaiva hi .. 19 ..
5.201.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पृच्छा संबंधजं सर्वमेकं कार्यं सदैव हि .. 19 ..
5.201.m: All this has been related to you as I was asked, O best of brahmins; / everything arising from this inquiry must always be carried out as one.”

5.201.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bhartṛyajñavākyanirṇayavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 202 ..
5.201.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भर्तृयज्ञवाक्यनिर्णयवर्णनंनाम द्व्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 202 ..
5.201.m: Thus ends the two hundred and second chapter, entitled “Description of the Determination of Words by Bhartṛyajña,” in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses, in the section on the greatness of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara.

5.202.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ śuddhyarthamāyāto nāgarāṇāṃ puraḥ sthitaḥ ..
nāgaraḥ śuddhimāproti yathā tanme vada dvijaḥ .. 1 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .1 ..
5.202.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
एवं शुद्ध्यर्थमायातो नागराणां पुरः स्थितः ..
नागरः शुद्धिमाप्रोति यथा तन्मे वद द्विजः .. 1 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .1 ..
5.202.m:
Ānarta said: / “O brahmin, tell me how a N膩gara, who has approached for purification / and stands before the Nāgaras, attains purification.”
Viśvāmitra said:

5.202.s:
evaṃ madhyasthavacanātsamudāye sthire sati ..
sa praṣṭavyaḥ piturmātā katamā te vadasva naḥ .. 2 ..
5.202.d:
एवं मध्यस्थवचनात्समुदाये स्थिरे सति ..
स प्रष्टव्यः पितुर्माता कतमा ते वदस्व नः .. 2 ..
5.202.m: “When the assembly has become steady through the word of the arbiter, / he should be asked: ‘Tell us, which was your father’s mother?

5.202.s:
kiṃ gotraḥ katamastasyāḥ pitā kiṃpravaraḥ smṛtaḥ ..
evaṃ tasyānvayaṃ jñātvā gotrapravarasaṃyutam .. 3..
5.202.d:
किं गोत्रः कतमस्तस्याः पिता किंप्रवरः स्मृतः ..
एवं तस्यान्वयं ज्ञात्वा गोत्रप्रवरसंयुतम् .. 3..
5.202.m: Of what gotra was she? Who was her father, and what was his pravara remembered to be?’ / Having thus ascertained her lineage, along with gotra and pravara,

5.202.s:
praṣṭavyā ca tato mātā tasyāścāpi ca yā bhavet ..
jananī cāpi praṣṭavyā tasyāścāpi ca yā bhavet .. 4 ..
5.202.d:
प्रष्टव्या च ततो माता तस्याश्चापि च या भवेत् ..
जननी चापि प्रष्टव्या तस्याश्चापि च या भवेत् .. 4 ..
5.202.m: then her mother should be questioned, / and the mother who bore her should also be questioned,

5.202.s: jñātavyā sāpi yatnena brāhmaṇaiḥ śuddhi karmaṇi..5..
5.202.d: ज्ञातव्या सापि यत्नेन ब्राह्मणैः शुद्धि कर्मणि..5..
5.202.m: and she too must be diligently investigated by the brahmins in the rite of purification.

5.202.s:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ..
śodhanīyāḥ prayatnena trayaścaite'pi tasya ca..6..
5.202.d:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः..
शोधनीयाः प्रयत्नेन त्रयश्चैतेऽपि तस्य च..6..
5.202.m: The father, the paternal grandfather, and likewise the paternal great-grandfather— / these three of his must also be carefully verified.

5.202.s:
tathā pitāmahīpakṣe traya ete dvijottamāḥ..
mātāmahastatastasya pitā tasyāpi yaḥ pitā..7..
5.202.d:
तथा पितामहीपक्षे त्रय एते द्विजोत्तमाः..
मातामहस्ततस्तस्य पिता तस्यापि यः पिता..7..
5.202.m: Likewise on the paternal grandmother’s side, these three [generations], O best of brahmins; / then his maternal grandfather, that man's father, and whoever was his father;

5.202.s:
mātā mātāmahī caiva tathaivānyā prapūrvikā..
pitāmahyāśca yā mātā sāpi śodhyā sabhartṛkā .. 8 ..
5.202.d:
माता मातामही चैव तथैवान्या प्रपूर्विका..
पितामह्याश्च या माता सापि शोध्या सभर्तृका .. 8 ..
5.202.m: the mother, the maternal grandmother, and likewise the one preceding her; / and the mother of the paternal grandmother must also be verified, along with her husband.

5.202.s:
evaṃ śākhā'gamaṃ jñātvā tasya sarvaṃ yathākramam ..
mūlavaṃśādadhiṣṭhānaṃ nyagrodhasyeva sarvataḥ .. 9 ..
5.202.d:
एवं शाखाऽगमं ज्ञात्वा तस्य सर्वं यथाक्रमम् ..
मूलवंशादधिष्ठानं न्यग्रोधस्येव सर्वतः .. 9 ..
5.202.m: Having thus ascertained his tradition and lineage in due order, / extending on all sides from the root lineage like [the branches and roots of] a banyan tree,

5.202.s:
tataḥ śuddhiḥ pradātavyā sindūrati lakena tu ..
cātuścaraṇamaṃtraiśca dattvāśīrvacanaṃ kramāt .. 6.203.10 ..
5.202.d:
ततः शुद्धिः प्रदातव्या सिन्दूरति लकेन तु ..
चातुश्चरणमंत्रैश्च दत्त्वाशीर्वचनं क्रमात् .. 6.203.10 ..
5.202.m: purification should then be granted by applying a red-lead mark / and reciting benedictions in order, with the four-footed mantras.

5.202.s:
tato vācyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha madhyasthena tadagrataḥ ..
dattvā tālatrayaṃ rājañchuddho'yaṃ nāgaro dvijaḥ ..
sāmānyapadayogyaśca saṃjātaḥ sāṃprataṃ dvijaḥ .. 11 ..
5.202.d:
ततो वाच्यं नृपश्रेष्ठ मध्यस्थेन तदग्रतः ..
दत्त्वा तालत्रयं राजञ्छुद्धोऽयं नागरो द्विजः ..
सामान्यपदयोग्यश्च संजातः सांप्रतं द्विजः .. 11 ..
5.202.m: Then, O best of kings, after giving three claps of the hands in front of him, / the arbiter should proclaim: ‘O king, this Nāgara brahmin is purified; / now this brahmin has become worthy of common status.’

5.202.s:
tato'gniśaraṇaṃ gatvā saṃtarpya ca hutāśanam ..
pañcavaktreṇa maṃtreṇa dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ..
viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsvaśaktyā bhojanānvitām .. 12 ..
5.202.d:
ततोऽग्निशरणं गत्वा संतर्प्य च हुताशनम् ..
पञ्चवक्त्रेण मंत्रेण दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं ततः..
विप्रेभ्यो दक्षिणां दद्यात्स्वशक्त्या भोजनान्विताम् .. 12 ..
5.202.m: Then, having gone to the fire sanctuary and propitiated the fire, / having offered the final full oblation with the five-faced mantra, / he should give a sacrificial fee to the brahmins according to his ability, accompanied by a meal.

5.202.s:
sindūratilake jāte brahmāgre dvijavākyataḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tuṣṭirvaṃśo no'dya pratiṣṭhi taḥ .. 13 ..
5.202.d:
सिन्दूरतिलके जाते ब्रह्माग्रे द्विजवाक्यतः ..
पितॄणां जायते तुष्टिर्वंशो नोऽद्य प्रतिष्ठि तः .. 13 ..
5.202.m: When the red-lead mark has been applied before Brahmā by the word of the brahmins, / satisfaction arises among the ancestors: ‘Our lineage is established today.’

5.202.s:
yasya no jāyate śuddhiḥ śākhābhirmūlavaṃśagā ..
nigrahastasya kartavyo dvijārho dvijasattamaiḥ .. 14 ..
5.202.d:
यस्य नो जायते शुद्धिः शाखाभिर्मूलवंशगा ..
निग्रहस्तस्य कर्तव्यो द्विजार्हो द्विजसत्तमैः .. 14 ..
5.202.m: He whose purification through the branches belonging to the root lineage does not take place / must receive from the best of brahmins the restraint appropriate for a twice-born.”

5.202.s:
yathā nānyo hi jāyeta śuddhi stasya prakalpitā..
evaṃ saṃśodhito vipraḥ śrāddhārho jāyate tataḥ..15..
5.202.d:
यथा नान्यो हि जायेत शुद्धि स्तस्य प्रकल्पिता..
एवं संशोधितो विप्रः श्राद्धार्हो जायते ततः..15..
5.202.m: In such a way that no other [unworthy one] may arise, his purification is ordained. / Thus purified, the brahmin then becomes fit for śrāddha rites. // 15

5.202.s:
api cāṣṭakulotpannaḥ sāmānyaḥ kiṃ punarhi yaḥ..
aśuddhena tu vipreṇa yaḥ śrāddhā dyaṃ karoti hi ..
tasya bhasmahutaṃ yadvatsarvaṃ tajjāyate vṛthā ..16..
5.202.d:
अपि चाष्टकुलोत्पन्नः सामान्यः किं पुनर्हि यः..
अशुद्धेन तु विप्रेण यः श्राद्धा द्यं करोति हि ..
तस्य भस्महुतं यद्वत्सर्वं तज्जायते वृथा ..16..
5.202.m: Even one born in the eight families, how much more so an ordinary one! / Indeed, for one who performs śrāddha and the like with an unpurified brahmin, / all of that becomes futile, like an oblation poured into ashes. // 16

5.202.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena śodhyo'yaṃ nāgaro dvijaḥ ..
svasthānasya viśuddhyarthaṃ tathaiva svaku lasya ca .. 17 ..
5.202.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन शोध्योऽयं नागरो द्विजः ..
स्वस्थानस्य विशुद्ध्यर्थं तथैव स्वकु लस्य च .. 17 ..
5.202.m: Therefore, with every effort, this Nāgara brahmin must be purified, / for the purification of his own settlement and likewise of his own lineage. // 17

5.202.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nāgaraviśuddhiprakāravarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 203 ..
5.202.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागरविशुद्धिप्रकारवर्णनंनाम त्र्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 203 ..
5.202.m: Thus ends the two hundred and third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Mode of Purification of Nāgaras', in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. // 203

5.203.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
proktā'smākaṃ tvayā vipra śuddhirnāgarasaṃbhavā ..
vaṃśajā vistareṇaiva yathā pṛṣṭo'si suvrata .. 1 ..
5.203.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
प्रोक्ताऽस्माकं त्वया विप्र शुद्धिर्नागरसंभवा ..
वंशजा विस्तरेणैव यथा पृष्टोऽसि सुव्रत .. 1 ..
5.203.m: Ānarta said: / The purification of the Nāgara lineage, arising from pedigree, / has been spoken to us in detail by you, O pious brahmin, just as you were asked. // 1

5.203.s:
sāṃprataṃ śīlajāṃ brūhi naṣṭavaṃśaśca yo bhavet ..
pitāmahaṃ na jānāti na ca mātāmahīṃ nijām ..
tasya śuddhiḥ kathaṃ kāryā nāgaro'smīti yo vadet .. 2 ..
5.203.d:
सांप्रतं शीलजां ब्रूहि नष्टवंशश्च यो भवेत् ..
पितामहं न जानाति न च मातामहीं निजाम् ..
तस्य शुद्धिः कथं कार्या नागरोऽस्मीति यो वदेत् .. 2 ..
5.203.m: Now tell of that which arises from conduct, for one whose lineage is lost— / who does not know his paternal grandfather, nor his maternal grandmother; / how should purification be performed for him who says, 'I am a Nāgara'? // 2

5.203.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
etadarthaṃ purā pṛṣṭo bhartṛyajñaśca nāgaraiḥ ..
naṣṭavaṃśakṛte rājanyathā pṛṣṭo'smi vai tva yā .. 3 ..
5.203.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
एतदर्थं पुरा पृष्टो भर्तृयज्ञश्च नागरैः ..
नष्टवंशकृते राजन्यथा पृष्टोऽस्मि वै त्व या .. 3 ..
5.203.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Long ago Bhartṛyajña was asked by the Nāgaras about this matter, / regarding one of lost lineage, O king, just as I have been asked by you. // 3

5.203.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
naṣṭavaṃśastu yo brūyānnāgaro'smīti saṃsadi ..
tasya śīlaṃ pravijñeyaṃ tataḥ śuddhiṃ samādiśet .. 4 ..
5.203.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
नष्टवंशस्तु यो ब्रूयान्नागरोऽस्मीति संसदि ..
तस्य शीलं प्रविज्ञेयं ततः शुद्धिं समादिशेत् .. 4 ..
5.203.m: Bhartṛyajña said: / If one whose lineage is lost should say in the assembly, 'I am a Nāgara', / his conduct must be ascertained; thereafter purification should be ordained. // 4

5.203.s:
nāgarāṇāṃ tu ye dharmā vyavahārāśca kevalāḥ ..
teṣu cedvartate nityaṃ saṃbhāvyo nāgaro hi saḥ .. 5 ..
5.203.d:
नागराणां तु ये धर्मा व्यवहाराश्च केवलाः ..
तेषु चेद्वर्तते नित्यं संभाव्यो नागरो हि सः .. 5 ..
5.203.m: If he always abides in the duties and pure traditional customs of the Nāgaras, / he should indeed be regarded as a Nāgara. // 5

5.203.s:
tasya śuddhikṛte deyaṃ dhaṭaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
dhaṭe tu śuddhimāpanne tato'sau śuddhatāṃ vrajet .. 6 ..
5.203.d:
तस्य शुद्धिकृते देयं धटं ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
धटे तु शुद्धिमापन्ने ततोऽसौ शुद्धतां व्रजेत् .. 6 ..
5.203.m: For his purification, O best of brahmins, the balance ordeal should be administered. / When he has attained purity in the balance ordeal, he then attains purity, // 6

5.203.s:
śrāddhārhaḥ kanyakārhaśca somārhaśca viśeṣataḥ ..
sāmānyapadayogyaśca samaste sthānakarmaṇi .. 7 ..
5.203.d:
श्राद्धार्हः कन्यकार्हश्च सोमार्हश्च विशेषतः ..
सामान्यपदयोग्यश्च समस्ते स्थानकर्मणि .. 7 ..
5.203.m: fit for śrāddha, fit for [receiving] a maiden, and especially fit for soma, / and worthy of ordinary standing in all communal matters. // 7

5.203.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi narottama ..
dvitīyā jāyate śuddhiryathā naṣṭānvaye dvije ..
tasmādvada mahārāja yadbhūyaḥ śrotumarhasi .. 8 ..
5.203.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि नरोत्तम ..
द्वितीया जायते शुद्धिर्यथा नष्टान्वये द्विजे ..
तस्माद्वद महाराज यद्भूयः श्रोतुमर्हसि .. 8 ..
5.203.m: All this has been told to you, as I was asked, O best of men, / how the second purification is accomplished for a brahmin whose lineage is lost. / Therefore speak, O great king, what you wish to hear further. // 8

5.203.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
tasmātte nāgarā bhūtvā viprāścāṣṭakulodbhavāḥ ..
sarveṣāmuttamā jātāḥ prādhānyena vyavasthitāḥ .. 9 ..
5.203.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
तस्मात्ते नागरा भूत्वा विप्राश्चाष्टकुलोद्भवाः ..
सर्वेषामुत्तमा जाताः प्राधान्येन व्यवस्थिताः .. 9 ..
5.203.m: Ānarta said: / Therefore, having become Nāgaras, those brahmins born of the eight families / became the highest of all and were established as paramount. // 9

5.203.s:
tapasaḥ kiṃ prabhāvaḥ sa teṣāṃ vā yajanodbhavaḥ ..
vidyodbhavo'thavā vipra kiṃ vā dānasamudbhavaḥ .. 6.204.10 ..
5.203.d:
तपसः किं प्रभावः स तेषां वा यजनोद्भवः ..
विद्योद्भवोऽथवा विप्र किं वा दानसमुद्भवः .. 6.204.10 ..
5.203.m: Was that the power of their austerity, or arose from their sacrifices, / or arose from sacred learning, O brahmin, or arose from giving gifts? // 10

5.203.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
te sarve guṇasaṃpannā yathānye nāgarāstathā ..
viśeṣaścāparasteṣāṃ te śakreṇa pratiṣṭhitāḥ .. 11 ..
tena te gauravaṃ prāptāḥ sarveṣāṃ tu dvijanmanām .. 12 ..
5.203.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
ते सर्वे गुणसंपन्ना यथान्ये नागरास्तथा ..
विशेषश्चापरस्तेषां ते शक्रेण प्रतिष्ठिताः .. 11 ..
तेन ते गौरवं प्राप्ताः सर्वेषां तु द्विजन्मनाम् .. 12 ..
5.203.m: Viśvāmitra said: / They were all endowed with virtues just like other Nāgaras; / and they had another distinction: they were established by Śakra. / Because of that, they attained prestige among all twice-born. // 11–12

5.203.s:
.. ānarta uvāca .. ..
kasminkāle tu te viprāḥ śakre ṇātra pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
kimarthaṃ ca vadāsmākaṃ vistareṇa mahāmate .. 13 ..
5.203.d:
.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्काले तु ते विप्राः शक्रे णात्र प्रतिष्ठिताः ..
किमर्थं च वदास्माकं विस्तरेण महामते .. 13 ..
5.203.m: Ānarta said: / At what time were those brahmins established here by Śakra, / and for what purpose? Tell us in detail, O highly wise one. // 13

5.203.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
hiraṇyākṣa iti khyātaḥ purā''sīddānavo ttamaḥ ..
abhavattasya saṃgrāmaḥ śakreṇa saha dāruṇaḥ .. 14 ..
5.203.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
हिरण्याक्ष इति ख्यातः पुरा'ऽसीद्दानवो त्तमः ..
अभवत्तस्य संग्रामः शक्रेण सह दारुणः .. 14 ..
5.203.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Formerly there was an eminent Dānava known as Hiraṇyākṣa; / he had a fierce battle with Śakra. // 14

5.203.s:
tatra devāsure yuddhe mṛtā bhūridivaukasaḥ ..
dānavāśca mahārāja parasparajigīṣavaḥ .. 15 ..
5.203.d:
तत्र देवासुरे युद्धे मृता भूरिदिवौकसः ..
दानवाश्च महाराज परस्परजिगीषवः .. 15 ..
5.203.m: In that battle between the gods and asuras, many sky-dwellers / and Dānavas died, O great king, each wishing to conquer the other. // 15

5.203.s:
atha te dānavāḥ saṃkhye śakreṇa vinipātitāḥ ..
vidyābalena tāñchukraḥ sajīvānkurute punaḥ .. 16 ..
5.203.d:
अथ ते दानवाः संख्ये शक्रेण विनिपातिताः ..
विद्याबलेन ताञ्छुक्रः सजीवान्कुरुते पुनः .. 16 ..
5.203.m: Then, as those Dānavas were struck down in battle by Śakra, / Śukra made them alive again by the power of his lore. // 16

5.203.s:
devāśca nidhanaṃ prāptā na jīvaṃti kathaṃcana ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya viṣṇuṃ provāca vṛtrahā .. 17 ..
5.203.d:
देवाश्च निधनं प्राप्ता न जीवंति कथंचन ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विष्णुं प्रोवाच वृत्रहा .. 17 ..
5.203.m: And the gods who met death did not revive by any means. / Then, after some time, the slayer of Vṛtra spoke to Viṣṇu: // 17

5.203.s:
dhārātīrthamṛtānāṃ ca prahāraiḥ sanmukhaiḥ prabho ..
yā gatiśca samādiṣṭā tāṃ me vada janārdana .. .. 18 ..
5.203.d:
धारातीर्थमृतानां च प्रहारैः सन्मुखैः प्रभो ..
या गतिश्च समादिष्टा तां मे वद जनार्दन .. .. 18 ..
5.203.m: Tell me, O Lord, O Janārdana, what destiny is ordained / for those who die in the sacred ford of swords facing the enemy with forward blows; // 18

5.203.s:
parāṅmukhā mṛtā ye ca palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ..
teṣāmapi gatiṃ brūhi yādṛgjāyetavācyuta .. 19 ..
5.203.d:
पराङ्मुखा मृता ये च पलायनपरायणाः ..
तेषामपि गतिं ब्रूहि यादृग्जायेतवाच्युत .. 19 ..
5.203.m: and for those who die with backs turned, intent on fleeing— / tell me also what kind of destiny arises for them, O Acyuta. // 19

5.203.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
dhārātīrthamṛtānāṃ ca sanmukhānāṃ mahāhave ..
yathā cocchinnabījānāṃ punarjanma na vidyate .. 6.204.20 ..
5.203.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
धारातीर्थमृतानां च सन्मुखानां महाहवे ..
यथा चोच्छिन्नबीजानां पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते .. 6.204.20 ..
5.203.m: Viṣṇu said: / For those who die in the sacred ford of swords facing forward in great battle, / there is no rebirth, just as for seeds that have been destroyed. // 20

5.203.s:
ye punaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe tu hanyate bhayaviklavāḥ ..
bhujyamānāḥ paraiste ca pretāḥ syustridaśādhipa .. 21 ..
5.203.d:
ये पुनः पृष्ठदेशे तु हन्यते भयविक्लवाः ..
भुज्यमानाः परैस्ते च प्रेताः स्युस्त्रिदशाधिप .. 21 ..
5.203.m: Those, on the other hand, who are struck in the back, agitated by fear, / being consumed by enemies—they become ghosts, O lord of the thirty [gods]. // 21

5.203.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
keciddevā mṛtā yuddhe yudhyamānāśca sanmukhāḥ ..
tathaivānye mayā dṛṣṭā hanyamānāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ ..
pretatvaṃ dānavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ syānna vā prabho .. 22 ..
5.203.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
केचिद्देवा मृता युद्धे युध्यमानाश्च सन्मुखाः ..
तथैवान्ये मया दृष्टा हन्यमानाः पराङ्मुखाः ..
प्रेतत्वं दानवानां च सर्वेषां स्यान्न वा प्रभो .. 22 ..
5.203.m: Indra said: / Some gods died in battle fighting face to face; / likewise others were seen by me being struck with their backs turned. / Would all the Dānavas also become ghosts or not, O Lord? // 22

5.203.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
asaṃśayaṃ sahasrākṣa hatā yuddhe parāṅmukhāḥ ..
pretatve yāṃti te sarve devā vā mānuṣā yadi .. 23 ..
5.203.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
असंशयं सहस्राक्ष हता युद्धे पराङ्मुखाः ..
प्रेतत्वे यांति ते सर्वे देवा वा मानुषा यदि .. 23 ..
5.203.m: Viṣṇu said: / Undoubtedly, O thousand-eyed one, those slain in battle with backs turned, / whether they are gods or humans, all go into the state of ghosts. // 23

5.203.s:
viṣādagneḥ kulaghnānāṃ tayā caivātmaghātinām ..
daṃṣṭribhirhatadehānāṃ śṛṃgibhiśca sureśvara ..
pretatvaṃ jāyate nūnaṃ satyametadasaṃśayam ..24..
5.203.d:
विषादग्नेः कुलघ्नानां तया चैवात्मघातिनाम् ..
दंष्ट्रिभिर्हतदेहानां शृंगिभिश्च सुरेश्वर ..
प्रेतत्वं जायते नूनं सत्यमेतदसंशयम् ..24..
5.203.m: For those killed by poison, by fire, for killers of their own families, and likewise for suicides, / and for those whose bodies are slain by tusked and horned animals, O lord of gods, / the state of a ghost certainly arises; this is true without doubt. // 24

5.203.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ teṣāṃ bhavenmuktiḥ pretatvāddāruṇādvibho ..
etanme sarvamācakṣva yena yatnaṃ karomyaham ..25..
5.203.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
कथं तेषां भवेन्मुक्तिः प्रेतत्वाद्दारुणाद्विभो ..
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व येन यत्नं करोम्यहम् ..25..
5.203.m: Indra said: / How can their liberation from the terrible state of a ghost come about, O Lord? / Explain all this to me, so that I may make an effort. // 25

5.203.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ saṃyujyate śrāddhaṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasyasya sureśvara .. 26 ..
5.203.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
तेषां संयुज्यते श्राद्धं कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे ..
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां नभस्यस्य सुरेश्वर .. 26 ..
