5.203.m: The Blessed Lord said: / A śrāddha is prescribed for them when the sun is in Virgo, / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, O lord of gods. // 26

5.203.s:
gayāyāṃ bhaktipūrvaṃ tu pitāmahavaco yathā ..
tataḥ prayāṃti te mokṣaṃ satyametadasaṃśayam .. 27 ..
5.203.d:
गयायां भक्तिपूर्वं तु पितामहवचो यथा ..
ततः प्रयांति ते मोक्षं सत्यमेतदसंशयम् .. 27 ..
5.203.m: At Gayā, with devotion, in accordance with the words of Pitāmaha, / they then attain liberation; this is true without doubt. // 27

5.203.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kasmāttatra dine śrāddhaṃ kriyate madhusūdana ..
śastrairvinihatānāṃ ca sarvaṃ me vistarādvada .. 28 ..
5.203.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
कस्मात्तत्र दिने श्राद्धं क्रियते मधुसूदन ..
शस्त्रैर्विनिहतानां च सर्वं मे विस्तराद्वद .. 28 ..
5.203.m: Indra said: / Why is the śrāddha performed on that day, O slayer of Madhu, / for those who have been slain with weapons? Tell me everything in detail. // 28

5.203.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhūtapretapiśācaiśca kūṣmāṃḍai rākṣasairapi ..
purā saṃprārthitaḥ śaṃbhurdine tatra samāgate ..
adyaikaṃ divasaṃ deva kanyāsaṃsthe divākare .. 29 ..
5.203.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
भूतप्रेतपिशाचैश्च कूष्मांडै राक्षसैरपि ..
पुरा संप्रार्थितः शंभुर्दिने तत्र समागते ..
अद्यैकं दिवसं देव कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे .. 29 ..
5.203.m: The Blessed Lord said: / Formerly Śambhu was besought by bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, / kūṣmāṇḍas, and rākṣasas when that day arrived: / 'O god, when the sun is in Virgo, give us this one day today, // 29

5.203.s:
asmākaṃ dehi yena syāttṛptirvarṣasamudbhavā ..
pradatte vaṃśajaiḥ śrāddhe dīnānāṃ tvaṃ dayāṃ kuru .. 6.204.30 .. ..
5.203.d:
अस्माकं देहि येन स्यात्तृप्तिर्वर्षसमुद्भवा ..
प्रदत्ते वंशजैः श्राद्धे दीनानां त्वं दयां कुरु .. 6.204.30 .. ..
5.203.m: so that there may be satisfaction for us lasting for a year, / when śrāddha is offered by descendants of the lineage; take pity on the wretched!' // 30

5.203.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
yaḥ kariṣyati vai śrāddhamasminnahani saṃsthite ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasyasya ca vaṃśajaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati parā prītiryāvatsaṃvatsaraḥ sthitaḥ .. 31 ..
5.203.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
यः करिष्यति वै श्राद्धमस्मिन्नहनि संस्थिते ..
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां नभस्यस्य च वंशजः ..
भविष्यति परा प्रीतिर्यावत्संवत्सरः स्थितः .. 31 ..
5.203.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'A descendant of the lineage who performs a śrāddha on this day, / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, / will experience supreme delight for as long as the year lasts. // 31

5.203.s:
yaḥ punastu gayāṃ gatvā yuṣmadvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ..
kariṣyati tathā śrāddhaṃ tena muktimavāpsyatha .. 32 ..
5.203.d:
यः पुनस्तु गयां गत्वा युष्मद्वंशसमुद्भवः ..
करिष्यति तथा श्राद्धं तेन मुक्तिमवाप्स्यथ .. 32 ..
5.203.m: Moreover, one born of your lineage who goes to Gayā / and performs a śrāddha in this way—through him you will attain liberation.' // 32

5.203.s:
śastreṇa nihatānāṃ ca svargasthānāmapi dhruvam ..
na kariṣyati yaḥ śrāddhaṃ tasminnahani saṃsthite .. 33 ..
5.203.d:
शस्त्रेण निहतानां च स्वर्गस्थानामपि ध्रुवम् ..
न करिष्यति यः श्राद्धं तस्मिन्नहनि संस्थिते .. 33 ..
5.203.m:
And he who does not perform the śrāddha on that appointed day
for those slain by weapons, even though they dwell in heaven,

5.203.s:
kṣutpipāsārtadehāśca pitarastasya duḥkhitāḥ ..
sthāsyaṃti vatsaraṃ yāvadetadāha pitāmahaḥ .. 34 ..
5.203.d:
क्षुत्पिपासार्तदेहाश्च पितरस्तस्य दुःखिताः ..
स्थास्यंति वत्सरं यावदेतदाह पितामहः .. 34 ..
5.203.m:
his ancestors, afflicted in body by hunger and thirst and filled with sorrow,
will remain [so] for a whole year; thus said the grandfather [Brahmā].

5.203.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tasminnahani kārayet ..
anyamuddiśya tatsarvaṃ pretānāmiha jāyate .. 35 ..
5.203.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तस्मिन्नहनि कारयेत् ..
अन्यमुद्दिश्य तत्सर्वं प्रेतानामिह जायते .. 35 ..
5.203.m:
Therefore, one should make every effort to perform [the rite] on that day.
All that is offered intending another turns into that of pretas here.

5.203.s:
tato bhagavatā dattā teṣāṃ caiva tu sā tithiḥ .. śrā
ddhakarmaṇi saṃjāte vinā śastrahataṃ janam .. 36 ..
5.203.d:
ततो भगवता दत्ता तेषां चैव तु सा तिथिः .. श्रा
द्धकर्मणि संजाते विना शस्त्रहतं जनम् .. 36 ..
5.203.m:
Then that lunar day was indeed assigned to them by the Lord,
when the śrāddha rite has taken place, except for a person slain by weapons.

5.203.s:
saṃmukhasyāpi saṃgrāme yudhyamānasya dehinaḥ ..
kadāciccalate cittaṃ tīkṣṇaśastrahatasya ca .. 37 ..
5.203.d:
संमुखस्यापि संग्रामे युध्यमानस्य देहिनः ..
कदाचिच्चलते चित्तं तीक्ष्णशस्त्रहतस्य च .. 37 ..
5.203.m:
Even of an embodied being fighting face-to-face in battle
who is struck down by a sharp weapon, the mind sometimes wavers.

5.203.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetra māhātmye śakraviṣṇusaṃvāde pretaśrāddhakathanaṃnāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 204 ..
5.203.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये शक्रविष्णुसंवादे प्रेतश्राद्धकथनंनाम चतुरधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 204 ..
5.203.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fourth chapter, named 'The Discourse on the Preta-śrāddha in the Conversation between Śakra and Viṣṇu', in the Glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorification of the sacred field of the venerable Hāṭakeśvara. (204)

5.204.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
evaṃ jñātvā sahasrākṣa mama vākyaṃ samācara ..
yadi te vallabhāste ca ye hatā raṇamūrdhani .. 1 ..
5.204.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा सहस्राक्ष मम वाक्यं समाचर ..
यदि ते वल्लभास्ते च ये हता रणमूर्धनि .. 1 ..

5.204.s:
yudhyamānāstavāgre ca gayāśrāddhena tarpaya ..
tānsarvānpretabhāvācca yena muktiṃ bhajaṃti te .. 2 ..
5.204.d:
युध्यमानास्तवाग्रे च गयाश्राद्धेन तर्पय ..
तान्सर्वान्प्रेतभावाच्च येन मुक्तिं भजंति ते .. 2 ..
5.204.m:
who were fighting before you: satisfy them with the Gayā-śrāddha,
so that all of them may attain liberation from the state of being a preta,

5.204.s: palāyanaparā ye ca pṛṣṭhadeśe hatā mṛtāḥ .. 3 ..
5.204.d: पलायनपरा ये च पृष्ठदेशे हता मृताः .. 3 ..
5.204.m: as well as those intent on flight who were struck from behind and died.

5.204.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
varṣevarṣe tadā śrāddhaṃ prakaroti pitāmahaḥ ..
gayāṃ gatvā dine tasminpitṝṇāṃ divyarūpiṇām .. 4 ..
5.204.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
वर्षेवर्षे तदा श्राद्धं प्रकरोति पितामहः ..
गयां गत्वा दिने तस्मिन्पितॄणां दिव्यरूपिणाम् .. 4 ..
5.204.m:
Indra said:
Year after year the grandfather [Brahmā] performs the śrāddha,
having gone to Gayā on that day, for the ancestors of divine form.

5.204.s:
tatkathaṃ deva gacchāmi tatrāhaṃ śrāddhasiddhaye ..
tasmātkathaya me teṣāṃ kiṃcicchrāddhāya bhūtale ..
muktidaṃ yena gacchāmi tava vākyājjanārdana .. 5 ..
5.204.d:
तत्कथं देव गच्छामि तत्राहं श्राद्धसिद्धये ..
तस्मात्कथय मे तेषां किंचिच्छ्राद्धाय भूतले ..
मुक्तिदं येन गच्छामि तव वाक्याज्जनार्दन .. 5 ..
5.204.m:
So how can I go there, O Lord, to accomplish the śrāddha?
Therefore, tell me of something on the earth for their śrāddha
that grants liberation, so that I may go by your word, O Janārdana.

5.204.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā tamuvāca janārdanaḥ ..
asti tīrthaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ tasmādapyadhikaṃ ca yat .. 6 ..
5.204.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
ततः स सुचिरं ध्यात्वा तमुवाच जनार्दनः ..
अस्ति तीर्थं महत्पुण्यं तस्मादप्यधिकं च यत् .. 6 ..
5.204.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
Then Janārdana, having meditated for a long time, said to him:
'There is a great and sacred ford, even superior to that,

5.204.s:
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre kūpikāmadhyasaṃsthitam ..
amāvāsyādine tatra caturdaśyāśca devapa ..
gayā saṃkramate samyaksarvatīrthasamanvitā .. 7 ..
5.204.d:
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे कूपिकामध्यसंस्थितम् ..
अमावास्यादिने तत्र चतुर्दश्याश्च देवप ..
गया संक्रमते सम्यक्सर्वतीर्थसमन्विता .. 7 ..
5.204.m:
situated within a small well in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara.
There, on the day of the new moon and of the fourteenth [tithi], O lord of the gods,
Gayā fully converges, accompanied by all the sacred fords.

5.204.s:
kanyāsaṃsthe ravau tatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
aṣṭavaṃśodbhavairvipraiḥ sa pitṝṃstārayennijān .. 8 ..
5.204.d:
कन्यासंस्थे रवौ तत्र यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
अष्टवंशोद्भवैर्विप्रैः स पितॄंस्तारयेन्निजान् .. 8 ..
5.204.m:
A man who performs a śrāddha there when the sun is in Virgo,
with the brahmins born of the eight lineages, redeems his own ancestors,

5.204.s:
api pretatvamāpannānkiṃ punaḥ svargasaṃsthitān ..
tatkṣetraprabhavā viprā aṣṭavaṃśasamudbhavāḥ .. 9 ..
5.204.d:
अपि प्रेतत्वमापन्नान्किं पुनः स्वर्गसंस्थितान् ..
तत्क्षेत्रप्रभवा विप्रा अष्टवंशसमुद्भवाः .. 9 ..
5.204.m:
even those who have attained the state of pretas, let alone those residing in heaven.
The brahmins originating from that sacred field, born of the eight lineages,

5.204.s:
tapa ugraṃ samāsthāya vartaṃte himaparvate ..
ānartādhipaterdānādbhītāstatra samāgatāḥ .. 6.205.10 ..
5.204.d:
तप उग्रं समास्थाय वर्तंते हिमपर्वते ..
आनर्ताधिपतेर्दानाद्भीतास्तत्र समागताः .. 6.205.10 ..
5.204.m:
dwell on the snow-capped mountain having undertaken fierce austerity,
having arrived there terrified of the gift from the ruler of Ānarta.

5.204.s:
tāngṛhītvā drutaṃ gaccha tatra saṃbodhya gauravāt ..
sāmapūrvairupāyaistaisteṣāmagre samācara .. 11 ..
5.204.d:
तान्गृहीत्वा द्रुतं गच्छ तत्र संबोध्य गौरवात् ..
सामपूर्वैरुपायैस्तैस्तेषामग्रे समाचर .. 11 ..
5.204.m:
Go quickly, bring them, having addressed them with respect there;
proceed before them with those diverse conciliatory means.

5.204.s:
śrāddhaṃ caiva yathānyāyaṃ tataḥ prāpsyasi vāṃchitam ..
te cā'pi sukhinaḥ sarve bhaviṣyaṃti samāgatāḥ .. 12 ..
5.204.d:
श्राद्धं चैव यथान्यायं ततः प्राप्स्यसि वांछितम् ..
ते चाऽपि सुखिनः सर्वे भविष्यंति समागताः .. 12 ..
5.204.m:
And [perform] the śrāddha in proper accordance with the rules; then you will attain what is desired.
And all of them, having assembled, will also become happy.

5.204.s:
tvayā saha prapūjyāśca hyasmābhiḥ śrāddhakāraṇāt ..
tacchrutvā sahasā śakraḥ santoṣaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 13 ..
5.204.d:
त्वया सह प्रपूज्याश्च ह्यस्माभिः श्राद्धकारणात् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सहसा शक्रः सन्तोषं परमं गतः .. 13 ..
5.204.m:
And they are to be worshipped along with you by us for the purpose of the śrāddha.'
Hearing that, Śakra immediately attained the highest contentment.

5.204.s:
himavaṃtaṃ samuddiśya prasthitastvarayā'nvitaḥ ..
vāsudevo'pi rājeṃdra kṣīrābdhimagamattadā .. 14 ..
5.204.d:
हिमवंतं समुद्दिश्य प्रस्थितस्त्वरयाऽन्वितः ..
वासुदेवोऽपि राजेंद्र क्षीराब्धिमगमत्तदा .. 14 ..
5.204.m:
Setting out toward the Himālaya, he departed in haste.
Vāsudeva too, O king of kings, then went to the Ocean of Milk.

5.204.s:
himavantaṃ samāśritya śakro'pi dadṛśe dvijān ..
aṣṭavaṃśasamudbhūtānviṣṇunā samudāhṛtān .. 15 ..
5.204.d:
हिमवन्तं समाश्रित्य शक्रोऽपि ददृशे द्विजान् ..
अष्टवंशसमुद्भूतान्विष्णुना समुदाहृतान् .. 15 ..
5.204.m:
Śakra, reaching the Himālaya, saw the twice-born
born of the eight lineages, who were mentioned by Viṣṇu.

5.204.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śakraviṣṇusaṃvāde gayāśrāddhaphalamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma pañcottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..205..
5.204.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शक्रविष्णुसंवादे गयाश्राद्धफलमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम पञ्चोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..205..
5.204.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fifth chapter, named 'The Description of the Glorification of the Fruit of the Gayā-śrāddha in the Conversation between Śakra and Viṣṇu', in the Glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorification of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara. (205)

5.205.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
iṃdro'pi viṣṇuvākyena himavaṃtaṃ samāgataḥ ..
airāvataṃ samāruhya nāgedraṃ parvatopamam ..1..
5.205.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
इंद्रोऽपि विष्णुवाक्येन हिमवंतं समागतः ..
ऐरावतं समारुह्य नागेद्रं पर्वतोपमम् ..1..
5.205.m:
Viśvāmitra said:
Indra also, at Viṣṇu's word, arrived at the Himālaya,
mounting Airāvata, the lord of elephants, resembling a mountain.

5.205.s:
tatrāpaśyadṛṣīṃstānsa camatkāra samudbhavān ..
niyamaiḥ saṃyamairyuktānsadācāraparāyaṇān ..
vānaprasthāśramopetānkāmakrodhavivarjitān .. 2 ..
5.205.d:
तत्रापश्यदृषींस्तान्स चमत्कार समुद्भवान् ..
नियमैः संयमैर्युक्तान्सदाचारपरायणान् ..
वानप्रस्थाश्रमोपेतान्कामक्रोधविवर्जितान् .. 2 ..
5.205.m:
There he beheld those seers born from Camatkāra,
endowed with restraints and self-control, devoted to right conduct,
established in the forest-dweller stage of life, free from desire and anger.

5.205.s:
eke viprāḥ sthitāsteṣāmekāṃtaritabhojanāḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhakālāśinaścānye cāṃdrāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ .. 3 ..
5.205.d:
एके विप्राः स्थितास्तेषामेकांतरितभोजनाः ..
षष्ठकालाशिनश्चान्ये चांद्रायणपरायणाः .. 3 ..
5.205.m:
Some brahmins among them remained eating on alternate days;
others ate only at the sixth mealtime, and others were devoted to the Cāndrāyaṇa vow.

5.205.s:
aśmakuṭṭāḥ sthitāḥ keciddaṃtolūkhalinaḥ pare ..
śīrṇaparṇāśanāḥ kecijjalāhārāstathā pare ..
vāyubhakṣāstathaivānye tapastepuḥ sudāruṇam ..4..
5.205.d:
अश्मकुट्टाः स्थिताः केचिद्दंतोलूखलिनः परे ..
शीर्णपर्णाशनाः केचिज्जलाहारास्तथा परे ..
वायुभक्षास्तथैवान्ये तपस्तेपुः सुदारुणम् ..4..

5.205.s:
atha śakraṃ samālokya tatrā''yāṃtaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
pūjitaṃ cāraṇaiḥ siddhaistairadṛṣṭaṃ kadācana ..5..
5.205.d:
अथ शक्रं समालोक्य तत्रा'ऽयांतं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पूजितं चारणैः सिद्धैस्तैरदृष्टं कदाचन ..5..
5.205.m:
Then, seeing Śakra arriving there—
worshipped by cāraṇas and siddhas, never before seen by them—

5.205.s: te sarve brāhmaṇāḥ proktāstadāśramasamīpagaiḥ .. 6 ..
5.205.d: ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणाः प्रोक्तास्तदाश्रमसमीपगैः .. 6 ..
5.205.m: all those brahmins were addressed by those living near the hermitage:

5.205.s:
ayaṃ śakraḥ samāyāto bhavatāmāśrame dvijāḥ ..
kriyatāmarhaṇaṃ cāsmai yaccoktaṃ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ .. 7 ..
5.205.d:
अयं शक्रः समायातो भवतामाश्रमे द्विजाः ..
क्रियतामर्हणं चास्मै यच्चोक्तं शास्त्रचिंतकैः .. 7 ..
5.205.m:
'This Śakra has arrived at your hermitage, O twice-born!
Let hospitable homage be offered to him, as stated by the scholars of the scriptures.'

5.205.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vismayotphullalocanāḥ..
saṃmukhāḥ prayayustūrṇaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ .. 8 ..
5.205.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः..
संमुखाः प्रययुस्तूर्णं कृतांजलिपुटाः स्थिताः .. 8 ..
5.205.m:
Then all those brahmins, their eyes wide with wonder,
hastily went out to meet him, standing with palms joined in reverence.

5.205.s:
gṛhyoktavidhinā tasmai saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhā. ..
procuśca vinayātsarve kimāgamanakāraṇam .. 9 ..
5.205.d:
गृह्योक्तविधिना तस्मै संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहा. ..
प्रोचुश्च विनयात्सर्वे किमागमनकारणम् .. 9 ..
5.205.m:
With hair bristling with joy, according to the domestic ritual rules,
they all spoke out of modesty to him: 'What is the reason for your coming?

5.205.s: nirīhasyāpi deveṃdra kautukaṃ no vyavasthitam .. 6.206.10 ..
5.205.d: निरीहस्यापि देवेंद्र कौतुकं नो व्यवस्थितम् .. 6.206.10 ..
5.205.m: Even though we are without desires, O lord of gods, curiosity has arisen within us.'

5.205.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kuśalaṃ vo dvijaśreṣṭhā anihotreṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
tapaścaryāsu sarvāsu vedābhyāse tathā śrute .. 11 ..
5.205.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
कुशलं वो द्विजश्रेष्ठा अनिहोत्रेषु कृत्स्नशः ..
तपश्चर्यासु सर्वासु वेदाभ्यासे तथा श्रुते .. 11 ..
5.205.m:
Indra said:
'Is it well with you, O best of the twice-born, in all your agnihotra fires,
in all your ascetic practices, and likewise in Vedic study and tradition?

5.205.s:
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tyaktvā tīrthamayaṃ śubham ..
kasmādatra samāyātā himārtijanake girau .. 12 ..
5.205.d:
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं त्यक्त्वा तीर्थमयं शुभम् ..
कस्मादत्र समायाता हिमार्तिजनके गिरौ .. 12 ..
5.205.m:
Having left the sacred and auspicious field of Hāṭakeśvara,
why have you come here to this mountain that causes suffering from cold?

5.205.s:
tasmātsarve mayā sārdhaṃ samāgacchaṃtu saddvijāḥ ..
camatkārapure puṇye bahuviprasamākule .. 13 ..
5.205.d:
तस्मात्सर्वे मया सार्धं समागच्छंतु सद्द्विजाः ..
चमत्कारपुरे पुण्ये बहुविप्रसमाकुले .. 13 ..
5.205.m:
Therefore, let all of you virtuous twice-born come with me
to the sacred Camatkārapura, teeming with many brahmins.

5.205.s:
vāsudevasamādeśāttatra gatvātha sāṃpratam ..
gayākūpe kariṣyāmi śrāddhaṃ bhaktyā dvijottamāḥ .. 14 ..
5.205.d:
वासुदेवसमादेशात्तत्र गत्वाथ सांप्रतम् ..
गयाकूपे करिष्यामि श्राद्धं भक्त्या द्विजोत्तमाः .. 14 ..
5.205.m:
Going there now according to the instruction of Vāsudeva,
I shall perform the śrāddha with devotion at Gayākūpa, O best of the twice-born,

5.205.s:
yuṣmadagre caturdaśyāṃ pretapakṣa upasthite ..
khecaratvaṃ samāyātaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavatāṃ sphuṭam .. 15 ..
5.205.d:
युष्मदग्रे चतुर्दश्यां प्रेतपक्ष उपस्थिते ..
खेचरत्वं समायातं सर्वेषां भवतां स्फुटम् .. 15 ..
5.205.m:
in your presence on the fourteenth day, when the fortnight of the departed has arrived.
It is evident that the power of moving through the sky has come to all of you.

5.205.s:
sabālavṛddhapatnīkāḥ sāgnihotrā mayā saha ..
tasmādgacchata bhadraṃ vastatra sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 16 ..
5.205.d:
सबालवृद्धपत्नीकाः साग्निहोत्रा मया सह ..
तस्माद्गच्छत भद्रं वस्तत्र स्थानं भविष्यति .. 16 ..
5.205.m:
With children, elders, and wives, together with your agnihotra fires, with me—
therefore depart, may you be blessed! Your place shall be there.'

5.205.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
na vayaṃ tatra yāsyāmaścamatkārapuraṃ punaḥ..
anye'pi brāhmaṇāstatra vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ .. 17 ..
5.205.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
न वयं तत्र यास्यामश्चमत्कारपुरं पुनः..
अन्येऽपि ब्राह्मणास्तत्र वेदवेदांगपारगाः .. 17 ..

5.205.s:
nāgarā yājñikāḥ saṃti smārtāḥ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ ..
teṣāmagre kuru śrāddhaṃ śraddhā cecchrāddhajā tava .. 18 ..
5.205.d:
नागरा याज्ञिकाः संति स्मार्ताः श्रुतिपरायणाः ..
तेषामग्रे कुरु श्राद्धं श्रद्धा चेच्छ्राद्धजा तव .. 18 ..
5.205.m:
there are Nāgaras, sacrificers, adherents of the Smṛti, devoted to Vedic revelation.
Perform the śrāddha before them, if you have faith arising for the śrāddha.'

5.205.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
tatra ye brāhmaṇāḥ kecidbhavadbhiḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ ..
tathāvidhāśca te sarve vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ .. 19 ..
5.205.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
तत्र ये ब्राह्मणाः केचिद्भवद्भिः संप्रकीर्तिताः ..
तथाविधाश्च ते सर्वे वेदवेदांगपारगाः .. 19 ..
5.205.m: Indra said: / The brahmins there whom you have described, / though all of them are indeed like that, masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,

5.205.s:
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannā yājñikāśca viśeṣataḥ ..
paraṃ dveṣaparāḥ sarve tathā paruṣavādinaḥ .. 6.206.20 ..
5.205.d:
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्ना याज्ञिकाश्च विशेषतः ..
परं द्वेषपराः सर्वे तथा परुषवादिनः .. 6.206.20 ..
5.205.m: accomplished in sacred learning and recitation, and especially performers of sacrifices, / are nonetheless entirely intent on hatred and speak harshly.

5.205.s:
ahaṃkāreṇa saṃyuktāḥ parasparajigīṣavaḥ..
tapasā viprayuktāśca bhogasaktā divāniśam .. 21 ..
5.205.d:
अहंकारेण संयुक्ताः परस्परजिगीषवः..
तपसा विप्रयुक्ताश्च भोगसक्ता दिवानिशम् .. 21 ..
5.205.m: Full of egotism, eager to conquer one another, / destitute of austerity, they are attached to pleasures day and night.

5.205.s:
yūyaṃ sarvaguṇopetā viṣṇunā me prakīrtitāḥ ..
tasmādāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ samastakaiḥ .. 22 ..
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
asmābhistena doṣeṇa tyaktaṃ sthānaṃ nijaṃ hi tat ..
bahutīrthasamopetaṃ svargamārgapradarśakam .. 23 ..
5.205.d:
यूयं सर्वगुणोपेता विष्णुना मे प्रकीर्तिताः ..
तस्मादागमनं कार्यं मया सार्धं समस्तकैः .. 22 ..
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
अस्माभिस्तेन दोषेण त्यक्तं स्थानं निजं हि तत् ..
बहुतीर्थसमोपेतं स्वर्गमार्गप्रदर्शकम् .. 23 ..
5.205.m: You were praised to me by Viṣṇu as endowed with every virtue; / therefore you must come together with me, every one of you. / The brahmins said: / For that very fault we abandoned our own place,

5.205.s:
yadi yāsyāmahe tatra tvayā sārdhaṃ puraṃdara ..
asmākaṃ svajanāḥ sarve rāgadveṣaparāyaṇāḥ .. 24 ..
5.205.d:
यदि यास्यामहे तत्र त्वया सार्धं पुरंदर ..
अस्माकं स्वजनाः सर्वे रागद्वेषपरायणाः .. 24 ..
5.205.m: though it is endowed with many sacred fords and shows the path to heaven. / If we go there with you, O Puraṃdara, / all our kinsmen, intent on passion and hatred,

5.205.s:
aparādhānkariṣyaṃti nityameva padepade ..
īrṣyādharmasamopetāḥ paruṣākṣarajalpakāḥ .. 25 ..
5.205.d:
अपराधान्करिष्यंति नित्यमेव पदेपदे ..
ईर्ष्याधर्मसमोपेताः परुषाक्षरजल्पकाः .. 25 ..
5.205.m: will constantly commit offenses against us at every step, / full of jealousy and unrighteousness, uttering harsh words.

5.205.s:
tataḥ saṃpatsyate krodhaḥ krodhācca tapasaḥ kṣayaḥ ..
tato na prāpyate muktistadgacchāmaḥ kathaṃ vibho .. 26 ..
5.205.d:
ततः संपत्स्यते क्रोधः क्रोधाच्च तपसः क्षयः ..
ततो न प्राप्यते मुक्तिस्तद्गच्छामः कथं विभो .. 26 ..
5.205.m: From that, anger will arise, and from anger comes the destruction of austerity; / then liberation is not attained. How then, O lord, shall we go?

5.205.s:
aparaṃ tatra bhūpo'sti deśe dānaparaḥ sadā ..
ānartādhipatiḥ khyātaḥ sarvabhūmau sadaiva saḥ .. 27 ..
5.205.d:
अपरं तत्र भूपोऽस्ति देशे दानपरः सदा ..
आनर्ताधिपतिः ख्यातः सर्वभूमौ सदैव सः .. 27 ..
5.205.m: Moreover, there is a king in that country who is always intent on gift-giving, / the ruler of Ānarta, renowned over the whole earth at all times.

5.205.s:
dadāti vividhaṃ dānaṃ hastyaśvakanakādikam ..
yadi tatra na gṛhṇīmastadā kopaṃ sa gacchati .. 28 ..
5.205.d:
ददाति विविधं दानं हस्त्यश्वकनकादिकम् ..
यदि तत्र न गृह्णीमस्तदा कोपं स गच्छति .. 28 ..
5.205.m: He gives various gifts: elephants, horses, gold, and the like; / if we do not accept them there, he becomes angry.

5.205.s:
bhūpāle kopamāpanne svajaneṣu virodhiṣu ..
siddhirno tapaso'smākaṃ tena tyaktaṃ nijaṃ puram .. 29 ..
5.205.d:
भूपाले कोपमापन्ने स्वजनेषु विरोधिषु ..
सिद्धिर्नो तपसोऽस्माकं तेन त्यक्तं निजं पुरम् .. 29 ..
5.205.m: When the king becomes angry and our kinsmen are hostile, / there would be no success for our austerity; therefore we abandoned our own town.

5.205.s:
yadi gṛhṇīmahe dānaṃ tasya bhūpasya devapa ..
tapasaḥ saṃpraṇāśaḥ syādyaddhi proktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā .. 6.206.30 ..
5.205.d:
यदि गृह्णीमहे दानं तस्य भूपस्य देवप ..
तपसः संप्रणाशः स्याद्यद्धि प्रोक्तं स्वयंभुवा .. 6.206.30 ..
5.205.m: If we accept the gift of that king, O lord of the gods, / our austerity would be destroyed, as was declared by the self-manifest [Brahmā]:

5.205.s:
daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajī ..
daśadhvaji samā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ .. 31 ..
5.205.d:
दशसूनासमश्चक्री दशचक्रिसमो ध्वजी ..
दशध्वजि समा वेश्या दशवेश्यासमो नृपः .. 31 ..
5.205.m: "An oil-presser is equal to ten slaughterhouses; a tavern-keeper is equal to ten oil-pressers; / a courtesan is equal to ten tavern-keepers; a king is equal to ten courtesans."

5.205.s:
tatkathaṃ tasya gṛhṇīmo dānaṃ pāparatasya ca ..
yathā'nye nāgarāḥ sarve lobhena mahatānvitāḥ .. 32 ..
5.205.d:
तत्कथं तस्य गृह्णीमो दानं पापरतस्य च ..
यथाऽन्ये नागराः सर्वे लोभेन महतान्विताः .. 32 ..
5.205.m: How then can we accept the gift of him who is devoted to sin, / as do all the other Nāgara brahmins, overcome with great greed?

5.205.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
prabhāvo'yaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāstasya kṣetrasya saṃsthitaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñasya sarvadaiva vyavasthitaḥ .. 33 ..
5.205.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
प्रभावोऽयं द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तस्य क्षेत्रस्य संस्थितः ..
हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञस्य सर्वदैव व्यवस्थितः .. 33 ..
5.205.m: Indra said: / This is the power of that sacred field, O best of the twice-born, / of the one known as Hāṭakeśvara; it is perpetually established,

5.205.s:
pitṝṇāṃ ca sutānāṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
śvaśrūṇāṃ ca snuṣāṇāṃ ca bhaginībhrātṛbhāryayoḥ .. 34 ..
5.205.d:
पितॄणां च सुतानां च बंधूनां च विशेषतः ..
श्वश्रूणां च स्नुषाणां च भगिनीभ्रातृभार्ययोः .. 34 ..
5.205.m: especially [causing discord] between fathers and sons, between kinsmen, / between mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law, and between sisters and brothers' wives.

5.205.s:
tasyādhastātsvayaṃ devo hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ ..
purasya vidyate tasya pratāpenākhilā janāḥ .. 35 ..
5.205.d:
तस्याधस्तात्स्वयं देवो हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितः ..
पुरस्य विद्यते तस्य प्रतापेनाखिला जनाः .. 35 ..
5.205.m: Beneath that city is the god himself, known as Hāṭakeśvara; / by his fiery power all the people

5.205.s:
santapyaṃte tato dveṣaṃ prakurvaṃti parasparam ..
kiṃ na śrutaṃ bhavadbhistu yathā rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ..
sītayā saha saṃprāpto virodhaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 36 ..
5.205.d:
सन्तप्यंते ततो द्वेषं प्रकुर्वंति परस्परम् ..
किं न श्रुतं भवद्भिस्तु यथा रामः सलक्ष्मणः ..
सीतया सह संप्राप्तो विरोधं परमं गतः .. 36 ..
5.205.m: are heated, and consequently they bear hatred towards one another. / Have you not heard how Rāma, together with Lakṣmaṇa / and accompanied by Sītā, arrived there and fell into extreme hostility?

5.205.s:
sītayā lakṣmaṇenaiva sārdhaṃ kopena saṃyutaḥ ..
avācyaṃ proktavānviprāstau ca tena samaṃ tadā .. 37 ..
5.205.d:
सीतया लक्ष्मणेनैव सार्धं कोपेन संयुतः ..
अवाच्यं प्रोक्तवान्विप्रास्तौ च तेन समं तदा .. 37 ..
5.205.m: Filled with anger together with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa, / he spoke unspeakable words, O brahmins, and the two spoke likewise to him then.

5.205.s:
api māsaṃ vasettatra yadi kopavivarjitaḥ ..
tadā muktimavāpnoti svargabhākpañcarātrataḥ .. 38 ..
5.205.d:
अपि मासं वसेत्तत्र यदि कोपविवर्जितः ..
तदा मुक्तिमवाप्नोति स्वर्गभाक्पञ्चरात्रतः .. 38 ..
5.205.m: Yet if one should dwell there even for a month free from anger, / one attains liberation, and partakes of heaven after [a stay of] five nights.

5.205.s:
tasmāttatra pragaṃtavyaṃ yuṣmābhistu mayā saha ..
īrṣyādharmaṃ na yuṣmābhiste kariṣyaṃti nāgarāḥ .. 39 ..
5.205.d:
तस्मात्तत्र प्रगंतव्यं युष्माभिस्तु मया सह ..
ईर्ष्याधर्मं न युष्माभिस्ते करिष्यंति नागराः .. 39 ..
5.205.m: Therefore you must go there with me; / those Nāgaras will not behave jealously towards you,

5.205.s:
na caiva bhavatāṃ kopastatrasthānāṃ bhaviṣyati ..
prasādānmama vipreṃdrāḥ satyametanmayoditam .. 6.206.40 ..
5.205.d:
न चैव भवतां कोपस्तत्रस्थानां भविष्यति ..
प्रसादान्मम विप्रेंद्राः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 6.206.40 ..
5.205.m: nor will anger arise in you who dwell there, / by my grace, O chiefs of the twice-born; this truth is spoken by me.

5.205.s:
ānartaḥ pārthivo dāne yojayiṣyati na kvacit ..
yuṣmākaṃ putrapautrebhyo ye dāsyaṃti ca kanyakāḥ .. 41 ..
5.205.d:
आनर्तः पार्थिवो दाने योजयिष्यति न क्वचित् ..
युष्माकं पुत्रपौत्रेभ्यो ये दास्यंति च कन्यकाः .. 41 ..
5.205.m: The king of Ānarta will never press gifts upon you; / and those who give maiden brides to your sons and grandsons,

5.205.s:
sahasraguṇitaṃ teṣāṃ tatphalaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ..
amāvāsyādine śrāddhaṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare .. 42 ..
5.205.d:
सहस्रगुणितं तेषां तत्फलं संभविष्यति ..
अमावास्यादिने श्राद्धं कन्यासंस्थे दिवाकरे .. 42 ..
5.205.m: their fruit shall become multiplied a thousandfold. / On the new moon day, when the sun is in the sign of Virgo, / whoever performs a śrāddha in your presence, O best of the twice-born,

5.205.s:
yuṣmadagre dvijaśreṣṭhā gayā kūpyāṃ kariṣyati ..
yastasya tatphalaṃ bhāvi sahasraśatasaṃmitam .. 43 ..
5.205.d:
युष्मदग्रे द्विजश्रेष्ठा गया कूप्यां करिष्यति ..
यस्तस्य तत्फलं भावि सहस्रशतसंमितम् .. 43 ..
5.205.m: at the Gayā well, his fruit will be measured as a hundred thousand times

5.205.s:
gayāśrāddhānna sandehaḥ satyametanmayoditam ..
yadi śrāddhakṛte tatra nāyāsyatha dvijottamāḥ .. 44 ..
5.205.d:
गयाश्राद्धान्न सन्देहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
यदि श्राद्धकृते तत्र नायास्यथ द्विजोत्तमाः .. 44 ..
5.205.m: that of a śrāddha at Gayā; there is no doubt. This truth is spoken by me. / If you will not come there for the sake of the śrāddha, O best of the twice-born,

5.205.s:
tataḥ śāpaṃ pradāsyāmi tapovighnakaraṃ hi vaḥ ..
evaṃ jñātvā mayā sārdhaṃ tatrā''gacchata satvaram .. 45 ..
5.205.d:
ततः शापं प्रदास्यामि तपोविघ्नकरं हि वः ..
एवं ज्ञात्वा मया सार्धं तत्रा'ऽगच्छत सत्वरम् .. 45 ..
5.205.m: then I shall pronounce a curse upon you that will obstruct your austerity. / Knowing this, come there with me quickly!

5.205.s:
ityuktāstena te sarve śakreṇa saha tatkṣaṇāt ..
kaśyapaścaiva kauṃḍinya ukṣṇāśaḥ śārkavo dviṣaḥ .. 46 ..
5.205.d:
इत्युक्तास्तेन ते सर्वे शक्रेण सह तत्क्षणात् ..
कश्यपश्चैव कौंडिन्य उक्ष्णाशः शार्कवो द्विषः .. 46 ..
5.205.m: Addressed thus by him, all of them at that moment [went] along with Śakra: / Kaśyapa, Kauṇḍinya, Ukṣṇāśa, Śārkavadvik,

5.205.s:
baijavāpaścaiva ṣaṣṭhaḥ kāpiṣṭhalo dvikastathā ..
etatkulāṣṭakaṃ prāptamiṃdreṇa saha pārthiva .. 47 ..
5.205.d:
बैजवापश्चैव षष्ठः कापिष्ठलो द्विकस्तथा ..
एतत्कुलाष्टकं प्राप्तमिंद्रेण सह पार्थिव .. 47 ..
5.205.m: and Baijavāpa as the sixth, and the Kāpiṣṭhala pair likewise. / These eight lineages arrived together with Indra, O king.

5.205.s:
agniṣvāttādikānsarvānpitṝnāhūya kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
viśvedevāṃstathā caiva prasthitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ .. 48 ..
5.205.d:
अग्निष्वात्तादिकान्सर्वान्पितॄनाहूय कृत्स्नशः ..
विश्वेदेवांस्तथा चैव प्रस्थितः पाकशासनः .. 48 ..
5.205.m: Having summoned all the ancestors, the Agniṣvāttas and the rest, in their entirety, / and likewise the Viśvedevas, the smiter of Pāka set out,

5.205.s:
samyakchraddhāsamāviṣṭaścamatkārapuraṃ prati ..
etasminneva kāle tu brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .. 49 ..
5.205.d:
सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमाविष्टश्चमत्कारपुरं प्रति ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .. 49 ..
5.205.m: filled with perfect faith, toward Camatkārapura. / At that very time, however, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds,

5.205.s:
gayāyāṃ prasthitaḥ so'pi śrāddhārthaṃ tatra vāsare ..
viśvedevāḥ pratijñāya gayāyāṃ prasthitā vidhim .. 6.206.50 ..
5.205.d:
गयायां प्रस्थितः सोऽपि श्राद्धार्थं तत्र वासरे ..
विश्वेदेवाः प्रतिज्ञाय गयायां प्रस्थिता विधिम् .. 6.206.50 ..
5.205.m: set out also for Gayā on that day for the sake of a śrāddha. / Having made a pledge for Gayā, the Viśvedevas set out for the rite [there];

5.205.s:
śakra śrāddhaṃ parityajya gatā yatra pitāmahaḥ ..
śakro'pi tatpuraṃ prāpya gayākūpyāmupāgataḥ .. 51 ..
5.205.d:
शक्र श्राद्धं परित्यज्य गता यत्र पितामहः ..
शक्रोऽपि तत्पुरं प्राप्य गयाकूप्यामुपागतः .. 51 ..
5.205.m: abandoning Śakra's śrāddha, they went where the grandfather was. / Śakra too reached that city and approached the Gayā well.

5.205.s:
tataḥ snātvāhvayāmāsa śrāddhārthaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
viśvedevānpitṝṃścaiva kāle kutapasaṃjñite ..52..
5.205.d:
ततः स्नात्वाह्वयामास श्राद्धार्थं श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
विश्वेदेवान्पितॄंश्चैव काले कुतपसंज्ञिते ..52..
5.205.m: Then, having bathed, filled with faith, he summoned for the śrāddha / the Viśvedevas and the ancestors at the time called kutapa.

5.205.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ samāhūtāśca tena ye ..
pitaro devarūpā ye pretarūpāstathaiva ca..53..
5.205.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः समाहूताश्च तेन ये ..
पितरो देवरूपा ये प्रेतरूपास्तथैव च..53..
5.205.m: Meanwhile, those who were summoned by him arrived: / the ancestors who were in the form of gods and likewise those in the form of spirits,

5.205.s:
pratyakṣarūpiṇaḥ sarve dvijopāṃte samāśritāḥ..
viśvedevā na saṃprāptā ye gayāyāṃ gatāstadā..54..
5.205.d:
प्रत्यक्षरूपिणः सर्वे द्विजोपांते समाश्रिताः..
विश्वेदेवा न संप्राप्ता ये गयायां गतास्तदा..54..
5.205.m: all having visible forms, took their places beside the twice-born. / But the Viśvedevas, who had gone to Gayā then, did not arrive.

5.205.s:
tato vilaṃbamakarottadarthaṃ pāka śāsanaḥ ..
viśvedevā yataḥ śrāddhe pūjyāḥ prathamameva ca .. 55 ..
5.205.d:
ततो विलंबमकरोत्तदर्थं पाक शासनः ..
विश्वेदेवा यतः श्राद्धे पूज्याः प्रथममेव च .. 55 ..
5.205.m: Then the smiter of Pāka delayed on their account, / since in a śrāddha the Viśvedevas are to be worshipped first of all.

5.205.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto nārado munisattamaḥ ..
śakraṃ prāha samāgatya viśvedevā'bhikāṃkṣiṇam.. 56 [.
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
viśvedevā gatāḥ śakra śrāddhe paitāmahe'dhunā ..
gayāyāṃ te mayā dṛṣṭā gacchamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ ..57 ..
5.205.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
शक्रं प्राह समागत्य विश्वेदेवाऽभिकांक्षिणम्.. 56 [.
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
विश्वेदेवा गताः शक्र श्राद्धे पैतामहेऽधुना ..
गयायां ते मया दृष्टा गच्छमानाः प्रहर्षिताः ..57 ..
5.205.m: Meanwhile, Nārada, the best of sages, arrived; / having approached Śakra, who was longing for the Viśvedevas, he said: / Nārada said: / The Viśvedevas have gone now to the ancestral rite of the grandfather, O Śakra; / I saw them going to Gayā, exceedingly delighted.

5.205.s:
tacchrutvā tatra kupitasteṣāmupari tatkṣaṇāt ..
abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ viprāṇāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ .. 58 ..
5.205.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्र कुपितस्तेषामुपरि तत्क्षणात् ..
अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं विप्राणां पुरतः स्थितः .. 58 ..
5.205.m: Hearing that, enraged with them at that moment, / he spoke harsh words, standing before the twice-born:

5.205.s:
viśvedevānvinā śrāddhaṃ kariṣyāmyahamadya bhoḥ ..
tathānye mānavāḥ sarve kariṣyaṃti dharātale ..59..
viśvedevānpuraḥ sthāpya yo'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati ..
vyarthatāṃ yāsyate tasya ūṣare varṣitaṃ yathā ..6.206.6...
5.205.d:
विश्वेदेवान्विना श्राद्धं करिष्याम्यहमद्य भोः ..
तथान्ये मानवाः सर्वे करिष्यंति धरातले ..59..
विश्वेदेवान्पुरः स्थाप्य योऽत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यति ..
व्यर्थतां यास्यते तस्य ऊषरे वर्षितं यथा ..6.206.6...
5.205.m:
"I will perform the śrāddha today without the Viśvedevas, O good sirs! / And so all other humans on the surface of the earth shall do.
Whoever performs a śrāddha here placing the Viśvedevas at the head / shall have it go to waste, like rain falling on barren soil!"

5.205.s:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣa ekoddiṣṭāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
cakāra sarvadevānāṃ ye hatā raṇamūrdhani .. 61 ..
5.205.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्ष एकोद्दिष्टानि कृत्स्नशः ..
चकार सर्वदेवानां ये हता रणमूर्धनि .. 61 ..
5.205.m: Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed Indra performed the ekoddiṣṭa rites in full / for all the gods who had been slain at the forefront of battle.

5.205.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
yeṣāmuddiśya tacchrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ nṛpottama .. 62 ..
5.205.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
येषामुद्दिश्य तच्छ्राद्धं कृतं तेषां नृपोत्तम .. 62 ..
5.205.m: At that very moment, a bodiless voice spoke / concerning those for whose sake that śrāddha was performed, O best of kings:

5.205.s:
śakraśakra mahābāho yeṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ..
pretatve saṃsthitānāṃ ca pretatvena vivarjitāḥ .. 63 ..
5.205.d:
शक्रशक्र महाबाहो येषां श्राद्धं कृतं त्वया ..
प्रेतत्वे संस्थितानां च प्रेतत्वेन विवर्जिताः .. 63 ..
5.205.m: "O Śakra, O Śakra, mighty-armed one, those for whom you performed the śrāddha / and who were abiding in the state of ghosts, have been freed from ghosthood.

5.205.s:
gatāḥ svargaprasādātte divyarūpavapurdharāḥ ..
ye punaḥ svargatāḥ pūrvaṃ yudhyamānā mahāhave .. 64 ..
5.205.d:
गताः स्वर्गप्रसादात्ते दिव्यरूपवपुर्धराः ..
ये पुनः स्वर्गताः पूर्वं युध्यमाना महाहवे .. 64 ..
5.205.m: They have gone to heaven by your favor, bearing divine forms and bodies. / And those who had already gone to heaven earlier, fighting in the great battle,

5.205.s:
te ca mokṣaṃ gatāḥ sarve prasādāttava vāsava ..
tacchrutvā vāsavo vākyaṃ toṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ .. 65 ..
5.205.d:
ते च मोक्षं गताः सर्वे प्रसादात्तव वासव ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वासवो वाक्यं तोषेण महतान्वितः .. 65 ..
5.205.m: they too have all attained liberation by your favor, O Vāsava." / Hearing that voice, Vāsava was filled with great joy.

5.205.s:
aho tīrthamaho tīrthaṃ śaṃsamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ..
etasminnantare prāptā viśve devāḥ samutsukāḥ .. 66 ..
5.205.d:
अहो तीर्थमहो तीर्थं शंसमानः पुनःपुनः ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्ता विश्वे देवाः समुत्सुकाः .. 66 ..
5.205.m: Praising again and again, "Ah, what a sacred ford! Ah, what a sacred ford!", / in the meantime the Viśvedevas arrived, eagerly desirous.

5.205.s:
nirvṛtya brahmaṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ gayāyāṃ tatra pārthiva ..
procuśca vṛtrahaṃtāraṃ kuru śrāddhaṃ śatakrato .. 67..
5.205.d:
निर्वृत्य ब्रह्मणः श्राद्धं गयायां तत्र पार्थिव ..
प्रोचुश्च वृत्रहंतारं कुरु श्राद्धं शतक्रतो .. 67..
5.205.m: Having concluded Brahmā's śrāddha at Gayā, O ruler of the earth, / they said to the slayer of Vṛtra: "Perform the śrāddha, O Śatakratu!

5.205.s:
bhūyo'pi na vinā'smābhirlabhyate śrāddhajaṃ phalam ..
vayaṃ dūrātsamāyātāstava śrāddhasya kāraṇāt ..
nirvartya brahmaṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ yena pūrvaṃ nimaṃtritāḥ .. 68 ..
5.205.d:
भूयोऽपि न विनाऽस्माभिर्लभ्यते श्राद्धजं फलम् ..
वयं दूरात्समायातास्तव श्राद्धस्य कारणात् ..
निर्वर्त्य ब्रह्मणः श्राद्धं येन पूर्वं निमंत्रिताः .. 68 ..
5.205.m: Moreover, without us the fruit born of śrāddha cannot be attained. / We have come from afar for the sake of your śrāddha, / having concluded the śrāddha of Brahmā, by whom we were invited first."

5.205.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ kupitaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ..
abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ meghagambhīrayā girā .. 69 ..
5.205.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां कुपितः पाकशासनः ..
अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं मेघगम्भीरया गिरा .. 69 ..
5.205.m: Hearing their words, the punisher of Pāka became enraged / and spoke harsh words in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

5.205.s:
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ śrāddhaṃ martyaloke kariṣyati ..
anyo'pi yo bhavatpūrvaṃ vṛthā tasya bhaviṣyati .. 6.206.70 ..
5.205.d:
अद्यप्रभृति यः श्राद्धं मर्त्यलोके करिष्यति ..
अन्योऽपि यो भवत्पूर्वं वृथा तस्य भविष्यति .. 6.206.70 ..
5.205.m: "From this day forth, whoever performs a śrāddha in the mortal world, / even another, having placed you first, it shall become useless for him.

5.205.s:
ekoddiṣṭāni śrāddhāni kariṣyaṃtyakhilā janāḥ ..
sāṃprataṃ martyaloke'tra maryādeyaṃ kṛtā mayā .. 71 ..
5.205.d:
एकोद्दिष्टानि श्राद्धानि करिष्यंत्यखिला जनाः ..
सांप्रतं मर्त्यलोकेऽत्र मर्यादेयं कृता मया .. 71 ..
5.205.m: All people shall perform ekoddiṣṭa śrāddhas. / Now, in this mortal world, this rule has been established by me.

5.205.s:
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca ye cānye śrāddhahārakāḥ ..
viśvedevaiḥ prarakṣyaṃte rakṣayiṣyāmi tānaham .. 72 ..
5.205.d:
भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश्च ये चान्ये श्राद्धहारकाः ..
विश्वेदेवैः प्ररक्ष्यंते रक्षयिष्यामि तानहम् .. 72 ..
5.205.m: The bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and whatever other stealers of śrāddha / are guarded against by the Viśvedevas—I myself shall guard against them.

5.205.s:
yajamānasya kāye ca śrāddhaṃ saṃyojya yatnataḥ ..
mayā hatāḥ prayāsyaṃti sarve te dūrato drutam .. 73 ..
5.205.d:
यजमानस्य काये च श्राद्धं संयोज्य यत्नतः ..
मया हताः प्रयास्यंति सर्वे ते दूरतो द्रुतम् .. 73 ..
5.205.m: Having carefully fastened the śrāddha to the body of the sacrificer, / smitten by me, they will all swiftly flee far away."

5.205.s:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣo viśvedevāṃstataḥ param ..
provāca brāhmaṇānsarvānviśvedevairvinā kṛtam ..
śrāddhakarma bhavadbhistu kāryamanyaiśca mānavaiḥ .. 74 ..
5.205.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो विश्वेदेवांस्ततः परम् ..
प्रोवाच ब्राह्मणान्सर्वान्विश्वेदेवैर्विना कृतम् ..
श्राद्धकर्म भवद्भिस्तु कार्यमन्यैश्च मानवैः .. 74 ..
5.205.m: Having spoken thus to the Viśvedevas, the thousand-eyed Indra then / said to all the brahmins: "The śrāddha rite must be performed / by you and other men without the Viśvedevas."

5.205.s:
tathetyukte dvijeṃdraiśca viśvedevāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ..
rurudurbāṣpapūreṇa plāvayanto vasundharām.. 79 ..
teṣāmuṣṇāśruṇā tena yatpṛthvī plāvitā nṛpa ..
bhūtānyaṃḍānyanekāni saṃkhyayā rahitāni ca ..76..
tatoṃ'ḍebhyo viniṣkrāṃtāḥ prāṇino raudrarūpiṇaḥ ..
kṛṣṇadaṃtāḥ śaṃkukarṇā ūrdhvakeśā bhayāvahāḥ ..
raktākṣāśca tataḥ procurviśvedevāṃśca te nṛpa .. 77 ..
vayaṃ bubhukṣitāḥ sarve bhojanaṃ dīyatāṃ dhruvam ..
bhavadbhirvihitā yasmādyācayāmo na cāparam .. 78 ..
.. viśvedevā ūcuḥ .. ..
asmābhī rahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kiñcitsaṃjāyate kṣitau..
śraddhayā parayā yacca yuṣmākaṃ bhāvi bhojanam .. 79 ..
5.205.d:
तथेत्युक्ते द्विजेंद्रैश्च विश्वेदेवाः सुदुःखिताः ..
रुरुदुर्बाष्पपूरेण प्लावयन्तो वसुन्धराम्.. 79 ..
तेषामुष्णाश्रुणा तेन यत्पृथ्वी प्लाविता नृप ..
भूतान्यंडान्यनेकानि संख्यया रहितानि च ..76..
ततोंऽडेभ्यो विनिष्क्रांताः प्राणिनो रौद्ररूपिणः ..
कृष्णदंताः शंकुकर्णा ऊर्ध्वकेशा भयावहाः ..
रक्ताक्षाश्च ततः प्रोचुर्विश्वेदेवांश्च ते नृप .. 77 ..
वयं बुभुक्षिताः सर्वे भोजनं दीयतां ध्रुवम् ..
भवद्भिर्विहिता यस्माद्याचयामो न चापरम् .. 78 ..
.. विश्वेदेवा ऊचुः .. ..
अस्माभी रहितं श्राद्धं किञ्चित्संजायते क्षितौ..
श्रद्धया परया यच्च युष्माकं भावि भोजनम् .. 79 ..
5.205.m:
When the foremost twice-born consented, saying "So be it", the Viśvedevas, deeply aggrieved, / wept, drenching the earth with a flood of tears.
Because the earth was inundated with their hot tears, O king, / many eggs, beyond reckoning, came into being.
Then, from those eggs, creatures of terrifying form came forth, / black-toothed, peg-eared, with upright hair, frightful, / and red-eyed; and then, O king, they said to the Viśvedevas:
"We are all hungry; food must certainly be given to us. / Since we were produced by you, we ask of no one else."
The Viśvedevas said: / "Whatever śrāddha is performed on earth without us / with supreme faith, that shall become your food."

5.205.s:
evamuktvā tu te śrāddhaṃ viśvedevā nṛpottama ..
brahmalokaṃ gatāḥ sarve duḥkhena mahatā'nvitāḥ ..
procuśca dīnayā vācā praṇipatya pitāmaham .. 6.206.80 ..
5.205.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु ते श्राद्धं विश्वेदेवा नृपोत्तम ..
ब्रह्मलोकं गताः सर्वे दुःखेन महताऽन्विताः ..
प्रोचुश्च दीनया वाचा प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् .. 6.206.80 ..
5.205.m: Having spoken thus about the śrāddha, O best of kings, all the Viśvedevas, / filled with great sorrow, went to the world of Brahmā, / and bowing down to the Grandfather, said in a plaintive voice:

5.205.s:
vayaṃ bāhyāḥ kṛtā deva śrāddhānāṃ balavidviṣā ..
tava śrāddhe gatā yasmādgayāyāṃ prāṅnimaṃtritāḥ .. .. 81 ..
5.205.d:
वयं बाह्याः कृता देव श्राद्धानां बलविद्विषा ..
तव श्राद्धे गता यस्माद्गयायां प्राङ्निमंत्रिताः .. .. 81 ..
5.205.m: "O Lord, we have been excluded from śrāddhas by the enemy of Bala, / because we went to your śrāddha at Gayā, having been invited first.

5.205.s:
tena ruṣṭaḥ sahasrākṣastava cāṃte samāgatāḥ ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ naḥ śrāddhārhāḥ syāma vai yathā .. 82 ..
5.205.d:
तेन रुष्टः सहस्राक्षस्तव चांते समागताः ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं नः श्राद्धार्हाः स्याम वै यथा .. 82 ..
5.205.m: Enraged by that, the thousand-eyed Indra came at your conclusion. / Therefore, grant us your favor so that we may indeed become worthy of śrāddha."

5.205.s:
tacchrutvā satvaraṃ brahmā kṛpayā parayānvitaḥ ..

5.205.m:
Śakra, too, having performed the śrāddha rites for those dwellers of heaven, / remained right there, devoted to visiting the sacred ford.
At that very time, Brahmā arrived there / accompanied by the Viśvedevas, seated upon his swan vehicle.
Śakra too, seeing the lotus-seated one suddenly arrived, / took water for guest-offering and foot-washing, and quickly went to meet him.
Then, bowing with his head in eight-limbed prostration, filled with humility, / he folded his hands and said: "Welcome to you, O Grandfather! / Merely by your darśana, my three births have become known to me. / As I quickly did auspicious deeds formerly, so I do now,
and I shall do in the next world; this is clear, without doubt.
Even though you are free from desire, O Lord, tell me quickly / the reason for your coming, so that I may do it all."
Brahmā said: / "O best of the gods, those Viśvedevas without whom not even my śrāddha would take place / have today been made by you excluded from śrāddhas.

5.205.m:
That was not good, which you did while performing that rite, / whereby the Vedas and the smṛtis have been rendered unauthoritative.
These were invited first by me, O Śakra, for the purpose of the śrāddha, / and afterwards by you; therefore, there is no fault in these great-souled ones.
Therefore, strive for the release from the curse, O lord of gods, / by which all these who are deeply distressed may become fit for śrāddha.
For formerly this was declared by me to all the twice-born: / that the śrāddha which has this preceded by them shall be fruitful.
Then how can you make my word untrue?"
Indra said: / "I too, filled with anger, cursed them, O Grandfather. / Therefore, act in such a way that I may remain truthful in speech."
Brahmā said: / "In such a manner as your word shall remain true, O Vāsava, / so I will arrange it, precisely for the sake of the Viśvedevas.

As for the śrāddha without the Viśvedevas that was proclaimed by you: / all men shall perform the ekoddiṣṭa rite on earth
on that day, O lord of gods, where it was instituted by you, / on the fourteenth day in the pretapakṣa, and for one slain by a weapon;
and when the day of death has arrived, the auspicious śrāddha of a Nāgara / performed without the Viśvedevas shall be valid by my word."
“But whoever performs a śrāddha at any other time without them, / his [rite] shall become useless by my word, without a doubt.
Except for one slain by a weapon, whatever man performs / a śrāddha in that manner on that day, it shall become food for bhūtas.” / Viśvāmitra said: / When Śakra had agreed, saying “So be it,” Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / was then addressed by the Viśvedevas standing bowed in modesty:
“These sons were born indeed from our tears. / Food was given by me to them when afflicted by hunger, O Lord,

for all these, through your favor, O lotus-born one.”
The lotus-born one said: / “At the time of a śrāddha, [the performers] will draw entirely an ash line / upon the food dishes of the brahmins; indeed, that must be abandoned by these [beings].
Wherever there is any śrāddha performed without the protection of ashes— / whether an ekoddiṣṭa, a pārvaṇa, or a vṛddhiśrāddha—
that is now given by me, well-pleased, to these [beings].” / Having spoken thus, the Grandfather then gave them a name:
“Since the earth is called ku, and it was sprinkled with tears, / eggs were born from it, and from them these dense beings were born; / they will be renowned in the three worlds as Kūṣmāṇḍas.”

5.205.m:
Then, having divided them into three parts, he assigned them in order / to Agni, Vāyu, and Sūrya, and indeed spoke this word:
“By the triad of verses known in the Yajurveda beginning with Yad devāḥ, / a portion should be given to these from the bhaktihoma,
and from the midst of their own share produced in the koṭihoma; / by that they will attain satisfaction, by my word, without a doubt.”
Having spoken thus, the four-faced one vanished from sight; / and the Viśvedevas were delighted, as were the Kūṣmāṇḍas especially.
For this reason, protection made of ashes is made / upon the food dishes of the brahmins at a śrāddha out of fear of the Kūṣmāṇḍas. / Hear why they do not seek a defect in the śrāddha of the Nāgaras:
Because they were born in their place, endowed with courtesy, / protection born of ashes was forbidden by the power of Bhartṛyajña.
Therefore, all the Nāgaras never do [it]. / And when that four-faced one had gone to his own abode, Indra too

.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..

.. आनर्त उवाच .. ..
गयाकूप्याश्च माहात्म्यं भवता मे प्रकीर्तितम् ..
बालमंडनजं वापि सांप्रतं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 124 ..

वदास्माकं महाभाग तस्मिन्दृष्टे तु किं फलम् ..215..
5.205.m:
spoke to all the brahmins born in Camatkārapura, / having folded his hands, standing bowed with modesty:
“Let my words be heard, O brahmins; after that you may act. / I shall install a liṅga of the god of gods, the trident-bearer.”
Then an excellent place was shown to him by those brahmins; / having installed the liṅga, he went to heaven overjoyed.
Viśvāmitra said: / This has all been related to you as I was asked, O lord of men, / the māhātmya of the Gayākūpī which grants all desires.
Ānarta said: / The māhātmya of the Gayākūpī has been recounted to me by you; / now you should also tell of that arising from Bālamaṇḍana.
In what place was that liṅga consecrated by Śakra? / Tell us, O illustrious one, and what is the fruit when it is seen?

5.205.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..

.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..

स्थानं शुभं पवित्रं च सर्वक्षेत्रस्य मध्यगम् .. .. 126 ..
ततस्तैर्दर्शितं लिंगं सुपुण्यं बालमंडनम्..
यत्र बालाः पुरा जाता मरुदाख्या दितेः सुताः ..127..
तेनैव च पुरा ध्वस्ता न च मृत्युमुपागताः ..

माघमासे सिते पक्षे पुष्यर्क्षे रविवासरे .. 131 ..
5.205.m:
Viśvāmitra said: / When those brahmins were asked by the thousand-eyed one for a liṅga, / for an auspicious and holy spot situated in the middle of the whole sacred field,
then they showed the holy liṅga, Bālamaṇḍana, / where formerly the children, the sons of Diti called the Maruts, were born.
By him indeed they were formerly shattered, yet they did not meet death. / And having known that place to be most pure, which was seen formerly,
where austerity was performed by Diti desiring a noble son, / having seen that supreme place, the ruler of the gods said to Jīva:
“O Guru, tell me quickly an auspicious muhūrta now, / and the day on which I may install the good liṅga born of Hara, / where, even when dissolution occurs, destruction does not take place.”
Then, having meditated for a long time, he spoke to that husband of Śacī: / “In the month of Māgha, in the bright fortnight, under the constellation Puṣya, on a Sunday,

ākalpāṃtasamaṃ divyaṃ sthiraṃ te tadbhaviṣyati ..
tacchrutvā devarājastu harṣeṇa mahatā'nvitaḥ .. 133 ..

5.205.d:
त्रयोदश्यामभीष्टे तु संजाते' भ्युदये शुभे ..
संस्थापय विभो लिंगं मम वाक्येन सांप्रतम् .. 132 ..
आकल्पांतसमं दिव्यं स्थिरं ते तद्भविष्यति ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा देवराजस्तु हर्षेण महताऽन्वितः .. 133 ..
बालमंडनसांनिध्ये स्थापयामास तत्तदा ..
विप्रपुण्याहघोषेण गीतवादित्रनिस्वनैः ..' 134 ..
ततो होमावसाने तु तर्पयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान् ..

5.205.m:
on the thirteenth day, when an auspicious, desired rise has occurred, / install the liṅga now, O Lord, according to my word.
It will remain firm and divine for you until the end of the kalpa.” / Hearing that, the king of gods, filled with great joy,
then installed it in the presence of Bālamaṇḍana, / accompanied by the auspicious day-proclamations of the brahmins and sounds of singing and musical instruments.
Then, at the conclusion of the fire offering, having gratified the best of the twice-born, / he gave them an excellent place, an estate, as a sacrificial gift,
which was situated on the bank of the Māṃ, adorned with divine ramparts, / jointly to all the brahmins, O best of kings.
Then, having summoned the eight-family brahmins, he said this: / “You must always take care of the matters pertaining to this liṅga.
For I have granted a livelihood for it lasting as long as the moon and sun; / and that, derived from twelve villages, is to be accepted for its sake.”

5.205.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
न वयं विबुधश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामो वचस्तव ..
लिंगचिंतासमुद्भूतं श्रूयतामत्र कारणम् .. 139 ..
ब्रह्मस्वं विबुधस्वं च तडागोत्थं विशेषतः ..
भक्षितं स्वल्पमप्यत्र नाश येत्सर्वपूर्वजान् .. 6.206.140 ..
यदि कश्चित्कुलेऽस्माकं जातस्तद्भक्षयिष्यति ..

दृष्ट्वाऽन्यमनसं शक्रं कृतपूर्वोपकारिणम् .. 142 ..
देवशर्माभिधानस्तु विख्यातः प्रवरैस्त्रिभिः ..
अहं चिंतां करिष्यामि तव लिंगसमुद्भवाम् .. 143 ..
अपुत्रस्य तु मे पुत्रं यदि यच्छसि वासव ..
यस्मात्संजायते वंशो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 144 ..
धर्मज्ञस्तु कृतज्ञस्तु देवस्वपरिवर्जकः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वासवो हृष्टस्तमुवाच द्विजोत्तमम् ..145..
5.205.m:
The brahmins said: / “O best of gods, we will not carry out your word / arising from care for the liṅga; hear the reason here.
Property of brahmins and property of the gods, especially what comes from a reservoir, / even if a very little of it is consumed here, would destroy all one's ancestors.
If someone born in our lineage consumes it, / he will cause all of us to fall; therefore, that is our great fear.”
Then an excellent twice-born standing in the middle, with folded hands, / seeing Śakra, who had formerly done them favors, to be dejected, spoke to him.
"I, named Devaśarman, renowned by three pravaras, / will take care of your liṅga, O Indra,
if you grant a son to me, who am childless, O Vāsava, / from whom a lineage will continue until the dissolution of all beings—
a son who knows dharma, is grateful, and avoids the property of gods." / Hearing that, Vāsava was pleased and said to that best of brahmins:

.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..

धर्मात्मा सत्यवादी च देवस्वपरिवर्जकः ..146..

ते सर्वेऽत्र भविष्यंति तद्रूपा वेदपारगाः .. 147 ..

तथा शृण्वंतु विप्रेंद्राः सर्वे येऽत्र समागताः ..148..

5.205.m:
Indra said: / "You shall have an auspicious son, an supreme perpetuator of the lineage, / righteous, truthful, and avoiding the property of gods.
And the sons who shall be born in the lineage of that high-souled one / shall all be just like him here, masters of the Vedas.
Hear another word of mine that I shall speak to you, O virtuous brahmin; / likewise let all the lords among brahmins who have assembled here listen.
At the Bālamaṇḍanaka tīrtha this excellent four-faced liṅga / was consecrated by me at the command of the four-faced Brahmā.
Whoever performs the rite of ablution here, at this tīrtha, and satisfies the ancestors with water offerings, / through him the ancestors shall remain gratified for life. / The twelve villages that have been granted by me to this god, O good sir— / and the brahmins who shall dwell [there], when a vṛddhiśrāddha is at hand, / they must first perform the śrāddha to him, and only after that,

5.205.m:
they shall perform its rites freed from all obstacles. / Prosperity will attend them; otherwise an obstacle will arise.
In the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, on the thirteenth lunar day, / the people dwelling in those villages who come here, collected in mind,
and bathe at Bālamaṇḍanaka and, being concentrated, / worship this liṅga with true devotion, will attain the supreme goal.
Those who cause harm to the villages of my liṅga, / even in the course of time, will meet with total destruction.
Whatever sacred fords and lakes there are on earth all the way to the ocean, / will come to the Bālamaṇḍanaka tīrtha on that day."
Viśvāmitra said: / Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed Indra, filled with anger, / then addressed those brahmins of the eight families who stood before him:
"Since my command was not obeyed by the brahmins of these seven families, / I will curse those ungrateful ones because of their ungratefulness; there is no doubt of this.

kariṣyaṃti na sandeho yathā mama suniṣṭhurāḥ ..
dākṣiṇyarahitāḥ sarve tathā bahvāśinaḥ sadā .. 164 ..
evamuktvā'tha tānviprānsaptavaṃśasamudbhavān ..
punaḥ provāca tānviprāñcheṣānnagarasaṃbhavān .. 165 ..
5.205.d:
यस्मादिदंपुरा प्रोक्तं मनुना सत्यवादिना ..
स्वायंभुवेन प्रोद्दिश्य कृतघ्नं सकलं जनम् .. 159 ..
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नवते शठे ..
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः .. 6.206.160 ..
अवध्या ब्राह्मणा गावः स्त्रियो बालास्तपस्विनः ..
तेनाऽहं न वधाम्येताञ्छिद्रेऽपि महति स्थिते .. 161 ..
ततस्तोयं समादाय सदर्भं निजपाणिना ..
शशाप तान्द्विजश्रेष्ठान्कृतघ्नान्पाकशासनः .. 162 ..
मम वाक्यादपि प्राप्य एते लक्ष्मीं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
निर्धनाः संभविष्यंति नीत्वा यद्द्वारतो ऽखिलम् .. 163 ..
भक्तानां च पीरत्यागमेतेषां वंशजा द्विजाः ..
करिष्यंति न सन्देहो यथा मम सुनिष्ठुराः ..
दाक्षिण्यरहिताः सर्वे तथा बह्वाशिनः सदा .. 164 ..
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ तान्विप्रान्सप्तवंशसमुद्भवान् ..
पुनः प्रोवाच तान्विप्राञ्छेषान्नगरसंभवान् .. 165 ..
5.205.m:
For this was declared of old by the truthful Manu, / the son of the self-manifest Brahmā, concerning every ungrateful person:
'For the slayer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the deceitful breaker of vows, / an expiation is prescribed by the virtuous; for the ungrateful person, there is no expiation.'
Brahmins, cows, women, children, and ascetics are not to be killed; / therefore I shall not slay them, even though a great offense exists."
Then, taking up water along with darbha grass in his hand, / Pākaśāsana cursed those best of brahmins who were ungrateful:
"Even after obtaining fortune according to my word, these best of brahmins / will become destitute, having carried everything away from their door!
The brahmins born in the lineages of these men will abandon their devotees, / there is no doubt, just as they were very cruel to me; / they will all be devoid of courtesy and always gluttonous!"
Having spoken thus to those brahmins born of the seven lineages, / he then spoke again to the remaining brahmins born in the city:

5.205.s:
mamātra dīyatāṃ sthānaṃ sthāne'traiva dvijottamāḥ ..
yena saṃvatsarasyāṃte paṃcarātraṃ vasāmyaham .. 166 ..
devasyāsya prapūjārthaṃ martyalokasu khāya ca ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ prapūjārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavatāmiha .. 167 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve tadarthaṃ sthānamuttamam ..
darśayāmāsuḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ procuśca tadanaṃtaram .. 168 ..
brahmasthāne tvayā śakra paṃcarātramupetya ca ..
sthātavyaṃ martyalokasya sukhamāsevyatāṃ prabho .. .. 169 ..
atra sthāne tavā'gre tu kariṣyāmo mahotsavam ..
gītavāditranirghoṣairgaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dvijānāṃ tarpaṇaiścaiva sarvakāmasamṛddhidam .. .. 6.206.170 ..
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ prahṛṣṭaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ..
pūjayitvā dvijānsarvāngato'tha tridivālayam .. 171 ..
5.205.d:
ममात्र दीयतां स्थानं स्थानेऽत्रैव द्विजोत्तमाः ..
येन संवत्सरस्यांते पंचरात्रं वसाम्यहम् .. 166 ..
देवस्यास्य प्रपूजार्थं मर्त्यलोकसु खाय च ..
ब्राह्मणानां प्रपूजार्थं सर्वेषां भवतामिह .. 167 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे तदर्थं स्थानमुत्तमम् ..
दर्शयामासुः संहृष्टाः प्रोचुश्च तदनंतरम् .. 168 ..
ब्रह्मस्थाने त्वया शक्र पंचरात्रमुपेत्य च ..
स्थातव्यं मर्त्यलोकस्य सुखमासेव्यतां प्रभो .. .. 169 ..
अत्र स्थाने तवाऽग्रे तु करिष्यामो महोत्सवम् ..
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्गंधमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
द्विजानां तर्पणैश्चैव सर्वकामसमृद्धिदम् .. .. 6.206.170 ..
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां प्रहृष्टः पाकशासनः ..
पूजयित्वा द्विजान्सर्वान्गतोऽथ त्रिदिवालयम् .. 171 ..
5.205.m:
"Let a place be given to me right in this spot, O best of brahmins, / so that at the end of every year I may dwell [here] for five nights,
for the worship of this god, for the welfare of the mortal world, / and for the worship of all of you brahmins here."
Viśvāmitra said: / Then all those brahmins, delighted, showed him an excellent place / for that purpose and afterwards spoke:
"Having arrived at the Brahmasthāna, O Indra, you should stay / for five nights; enjoy the happiness of the mortal world, O lord!
In this place, before you, we shall celebrate a great festival / with the sounds of singing and musical instruments, with fragrant pastes and garlands, / and with the gratification of brahmins, yielding the fulfillment of all desires."
Viśvāmitra said: / Hearing their word, Pākaśāsana was delighted; / having honoured all the brahmins, he then departed to the abode of heaven.

5.205.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍa hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye bālamaṇḍanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 206 ..
5.205.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्ड हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बालमण्डनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडुत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 206 ..
5.205.m: Thus ends the two hundred and sixth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of the Bālamaṇḍana Tīrtha," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
